349069.objective: 本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向， 並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名， 並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。 依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。 一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。 二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。 期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。 The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application. Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories. 1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity. 2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability. It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

349071.objective: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1. 極限與連續，2. 導數及其應用，3. 不定積分與定積分，4. 超越函數及其反函數，5. 積分法則，6. 不定型與瑕積分，7. 定積分的應用，8. 空間幾何與向量微積分，9. 偏導數，10. 重積分，11. 級數，12. 常微分方程。

349072.objective: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters, and 3 lecture hours per week.

349073.objective: 本課程的目的是為了：1. 驗證物理理論之真實性，2. 培養同學認真的科學態度與方法，3. 培養同學數據處理的能力，4. 啟發同學自行設計解決量度問題的方法。課程之施行分為上下兩學期，每一學期為一學分三小時。上學期的內容偏重力學、波動、熱力、流力之實驗，下學期的內容則偏重電磁、光學、近物之實驗。 The objective of this course is to let students get first-hand knowledge of physical principles through the handling of apparatus designed for these principles including: (a) To acquire training in scientific methods; (b) To acquire techniques in the handling and adjusting of equipment; (c) To gain an understanding of the limitations and strengths of experimentation; (d) To obtain experience of using graphical representation; (e) To collect data and to develop confidence to compute reliable answer.

349074.objective: 瞭解組合邏輯與序向邏輯電路之分析，設計及簡化之方法，內容包含： １. 數系：數位系統所使用之各種數系及其轉換之方法 ２. 布氏代數：了解布氏代數的基本運算法和定律，及認識基本邏輯 及邏輯閘 ３. 布氏代數之簡化：介紹各種布氏代數之簡化方法 ４. 組合邏輯：據布氏代數及邏輯閘，計分析各種組合邏輯電路 ５. 可程式邏輯陣列：介紹ＰＬＡ，ＰＡＬ，ＦＰＧＡ等之設計方法 ６. 正反器：介紹各種正反器電路及了解其基特性 ７. 同步與非同步序向電路：介紹各種同步與非同步序向電路分析與 設計之方法 ８. 遞迴網路：介紹遞迴網路之設計方法 ９.ＶＨＤＬ：介紹如何使用ＶＨＤＬ語言設計數位電路

349084.objective: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生：(一) 認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值 (二) 有效學習 (三) 涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則，工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康，安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。 "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

349085.objective: 本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向， 並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名， 並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。 依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。 一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。 二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。 期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。 The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application. Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories. 1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity. 2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability. It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

349087.objective: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1. 極限與連續，2. 導數及其應用，3. 不定積分與定積分，4. 超越函數及其反函數，5. 積分法則，6. 不定型與瑕積分，7. 定積分的應用，8. 空間幾何與向量微積分，9. 偏導數，10. 重積分。 This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.
349087.schedule: 第一週：函數極限的直觀定義與極限的基本性質 第二週：如何求函數的極限 第三週：夾擠定理與連續 第四週：導數的定義及其基本性質 第五週：隱函數微分法與反函數的導函數 第六週：三角函數，指數函數與對數函數的導函數 第七週：反三角函數的導函數與對數微分法 第八週：相關變化率 第九週：期中考 第十週：函數之極值，單調性，凹性與反曲點 第十一週：函數圖形的描繪與極值應用問題 第十二週：羅必達法則 第十三週：定積分的定義 第十四週：微積分基本定理 第十五週：不定積分及其基本性質 第十六週：變數代換法 第十七週：分部積分法 第十八週：期末考

349088.objective: 此課程旨在使學生理解自然界中常見的物理現象，進而領會物理 - 生活 - 科技之關聯。教學以工程背景學生所需要的物理基礎搭配實務探討來進行。主題涵蓋力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學等物理相關的觀念與應用。 This course aims to enable students to understand common physical phenomena in nature and then understand the connection between physics, life and technology. The teaching is based on the physical foundation required by students with engineering background and practical discussions. Topics cover physics-related concepts and applications such as mechanics, thermodynamics, acoustics, electromagnetism, and optics.

349102.objective: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生：(一) 認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值 (二) 有效學習 (三) 涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。 "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management, so that they may construct the knowledge and imagination that are needed in planning for grand visions of achieving the goals of higher education.

349104.objective: 本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向， 並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名， 並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。 依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。 一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。 二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。 期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。 The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application. Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories. 1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity. 2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability. It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

349106.objective: 本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: ■ 第一年：以建築設計的基礎為範疇。 訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。 ■ 第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。 在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。 ■ 第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。 將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。 第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。 This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows: ■ First year: foundations of architectural design Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space ■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc. ■ Third year: Urban architecture Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings ■ Fourth year: Graduation project Cultivating ca

349107.objective: 本課程目標針對大一新生入門介紹建築專業分支領域。由建築學基本涵構作概略介紹，輔以案例介紹及適當實地參觀研討，進而了解建築學相關知識體系，並對未來四年建築專業課程內容有全盤性認識，進ㄧ步結合未來出路願景。著重訓練思考及觀察能力，以利學生認識建築學之整體關聯性，進而建立其全方位學習藍圖。內容包括建築相關產業與建造程序、體驗建築、建築單位尺寸、建築結構系統之美、建築設計風格、建築教育、新一代建築師、建築構造與材料、建築的社會文化性、建築與環境共生、建築與都市發展、建築相關法令等。
349107.schedule: 一課程與進度簡介、建築的社會文化性 二建築概說、建築相關產業與建造程序 三建築單位尺寸、人體工學 四體驗建築 + 生態校園巡禮 五生態景觀設計 六體驗建築 七建築結構系統之美 八建築設計風格 (建築史概述) 九建築的藝術性（室內設計 + 公共藝術) 十新一代建築師 十一新一代建築師 十二中國傳統建築 十三 BIM + 綠建築 十四建築相關法令建築與使用者（需求與計畫） 十五建築與都市設計 十六學生專題報告 期末考
349107.score_policy: 小作業三次 60%+ 期末考試 30%+ 上課研討 10%+ 專題報告

349108.objective: 本課程整體目標為奠定學生建築製圖基礎能力，以期培育學生成為符合建築業界所需之人才；針對建築製圖之知識、技能、態度進行授課；主要為灌輸學生建築製圖基本常識、觀念；以所學實際運用於各種圖說之實際練習與操作。課程內容有 (1) 製圖用筆、比例尺、三角板、圓規等工具之介紹與應用；(2) 各種線條與工程字傳授與練習；(3) 建築圖說符號之說明與應用；(4) 三視圖與輔助視圖之講解及練習理解；(5) 空間應有尺度介紹與圖說練習；(6) 人物、植栽、舖面等點景之介紹與練習；(7) 建築平、立、剖面之陰影等建築表現法指導與操作。本課程符合系教育目標如下： 1. 訓練學生建築設計與工程基礎專業能力； 2. 透過實作方式彙整建築設計與建築構造之技能； 3. 引導建立建築專業道德倫理態度； 4. 整合建築理論與實務提升就業競爭力。 This is a fundamental course in architecture. The goal of the course is to establish the basic ability in handmade graphics. This class introduces fundamental issues in graphics such as (1) Introduce the graphics tools. (2) The usage of architectural graphic symbols. (3) Lines and fonts. (4) Reading and practicing three-dimensional diagrams. (5) Handling the relationship between space and scale. (6) Drawing practice on Landscape and human figure. (7) Shades and Shadows on the architectural graphics. After this course the students will acquire the following aspects: 1). Basic knowledge in architectural design and engineering. 2). Practical skill in architectural design and structure. 3). Correct attitude in architectural professions moral. 4). Integrate theory and real-life practice.

349109.objective: 以傳授設計原理、平面及立體設計觀念、美的形式原理、平面及立體的構成練習、對各種材料特性的應用經驗以及造形與色彩的研究達到設計感覺的養成並提高計畫性創造能力，是發展實用性及機能性以前之設計訓練的基礎。 This course aims to develop the ability of students to meet specific sensory needs through the creation of abstract visual order in the form of two-dimension and three-dimension. The visual organization of design elements including line, plane, volume, and the analysis of their abstract relationships and principles of order are studied.

349112.objective: 一、從建築史發展過程中，解析不同時期及不同構造形式之建築案例，探討材料、結構及構造方式，對設計者理念之詮釋、空間品質之塑造及建築美學之發展等課題，所產生的影響與關連性。 二、本課程將從哥德式之磚石構造建築（Masonry Construction）、工業革命發展之鐵構造建築（Iron Construction）、混凝土構造建築（Concrete Construction）、鋼構造建築（Steel Construction）及現代木構造建築 (Wood Construction)，這些不同時期之建築形式，藉由不同之材料特質、結構及構造方式等工程技術，詮釋設計者之理念，並表達不同社會文化及建築風格，進而闡述建築工程技術如何引導合理的建築設計方案及創造獨特建築美學。
349112.schedule: Week 1 : 課程綱要及重點介紹，磚石構造特性 Week 2 : 哥德式教堂特點，仿羅馬半圓拱構造 Vs. 哥德式尖拱構造 Week 3 : 石構造技術之演進及其古典設計概念，探討構造對建築之影響 Week 4 : 19c. 鍛鐵、鑄鐵及鋼材之製造發展，鐵構造 - 新建築潛力的演進 Week 5 : 國慶日放假 Week 6 : Viollet-Le-Duc 的建築觀點，及鐵構造建築案例與設計理念分析 Week 7 : 光復節補假 Week 8 : 鐵構造 Vs. 石構造之差異探討。混凝土、鋼筋混凝土及預力混凝土之原理及特質 Week 9 : 繳交期中報告，當日上課。 早期混凝土構造之發展：Hennebique、Baudot、Perret 案例分析 Week 10 : 工程師對於混凝土構造之詮釋：Maillart 鋼筋混凝土板的結構美學 Week 11 : 創造混凝土構造之新語彙：Corbusier 與 Kahn 之觀點及案例分析 Week 12 : 早期鋼構造高層建築之發展：Chicago School 之發展與案例分析 Week 13 : Archigram 建築思潮，龐畢度中心設計理念與構築技術案例分析 Week 14 : 木構造特性、新型木構件與板材發展 Week 15 : 木構造的演進與重型木構造系統 Week 16 : 輕型木構造的改良與構造系統 Week 17 : 校慶補假 Week 18 : 繳交期末報告，當日上課：建構建築與構築技術之橋樑。

349115.objective: 本課程為每學期建築設計輔助配套課程，目的在協助同學加強必要的設計能力與技巧，並提升專業設計能力。同學也因此得以藉此課程加強自身的建築表現能力，例如表達、繪圖與獲得更進一步的構築知識。 As a parts and accessories to Architectural Design course, the goal of this seminar is to help students enhance their design proficiency superior to the excellent skill level of design. A student who completes this course will be able to perform a good presentation works such as oral, drawing, construction processing, etc. And will have better understanding in design presentation.

349116.objective: 將建築的自明性融合在地與環境共生，是一種環境至上、尊重土地的設計理念，在這樣的前提之下，如何以環境的不浪費、資源再利用的構築方式，建構出一個剛剛好且可彈性運用的建築，反映出建築恆久永續的價值。 本課程旨在以環境設計角度，重新思考建築定位及空間規劃，使學生能具備基本 設計所需思維能力，並將人、土地、環境納為系統性整合對象，引導學生具備建築整合環境之能力與環境永續為建築設計者責任之意識。

349121.objective: 課程內容主要包括兩個項目: 1. 設計的思維與邏輯: 這堂課程與一般的設計概論不同，主要的目的在建立清晰的設計思維概念，從實務的觀點，來解說 "什麼是設計" 以及 "什麼是好的設計"。本課程會透過理論的講解以及大量的影片與實際案例，建立對設計邏輯的基本理解 2. 手繪實作與練習: 除了觀念的建立外，這堂課也會講解基本手繪的技巧，並以作業實作的方式，建立大家對設計的流程，方法與觀念初步的認識，期末將讓大家以手繪的方式設計一個 "座椅"，成為你的第一個設計案 本課程分上課週與評圖週 從第二週起，有手繪作業，第三周則是上課週，第四週則是評圖週，隔週上課，隔週評圖，設計手繪作業，有兩週的時間完成 ** 本課程是針對未來想要從事設計相關產業的同學所設計的專業課程，目的在建立實作流程技法與觀念理論的專業基礎 ** 本課程不是常識性 (通識性質) 的課程，但是如果你想深入了解: 1 基礎的設計流程與技法， 2 建立做設計應有的專業素養， 3 對設計應有的基本概念， 這會是相當扎實的課程

349124.objective: 「全民國防教育法」自民國 95 年 2 月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。 In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

349126.objective: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生：(一) 認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值 (二) 有效學習 (三) 涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。 "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management, so that they may construct the knowledge and imagination that are needed in planning for grand visions of achieving the goals of higher education.

349128.objective: 本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向， 並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名， 並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。 依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。 一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。 二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。 期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。 The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application. Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories. 1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity. 2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability. It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

349130.objective: 文化事業是以「文化」為素材所開展的事業，性質上以文化、美學或社會價值為訴求，但也往往同時兼具經濟價值。本課程旨在介紹文化事業的內涵與範疇，比較其與當前政府推展的「文化創意產業」間的異同，其中「文化」、「文化政策」、「國際文化生態」等都是觸及的議題。其次，討論「高品質的文化服務」與「從業人員的素養」，探討從事者應具備的基本能力與人格特質，並借重測驗工具協助同學理解個人人格特質組成及分布。 對於重要文化事業區塊，或將採取主題介述方式，邀請業界人士進行講座，而實地參訪與場景演練也是重要的教學活動。 Cultural Vocation is a developing vocation base on culture. The scope of the nowadays so-called "Cultural Business" has more or less been verlapped with "The Business of Culture and Creativeness" with the essence of emphasis not only on the economic values but also on those of culture, esthetics and society. The course will be focused on introductory methodology through main topic discussions by inviting professionals from different realms of industries for panel symposiums. In addition, on-site visits and case simulations are also to be included as important educational activities. The initial courses will be discussions on cultural relevant topics such as "Culture", "Cultural policies", "Cultural Development" and "International Cultural Systems". Further various scopes and contents of "Cultural Vocation" and status quo of its development will be introduced and discussed.

349131.objective: 本課程旨在引導學生透過學習文學作品來說屬於自己的故事。這學期本課程會帶兩位作家：陳又津及白先勇，來讓同學從別人的故事看見自己。比較特別的是，本學期會以工作坊的方式，來將課程融入 AI 生圖技術，帶同學以繪本的創作方式來了解故事創作的方法來產出繪本，將文學創作與圖像生成相結合，進一步提升同學的創作能力。最後的繪本創作，希望能以線上策展的方式呈現，讓學生學習如何將創意成果轉化為現代人習慣的接收方式，好跟更廣泛的觀眾分享。

349133.objective: 本課程為針對非資訊背景學生所設計的 Python 與 AI 程式設計入門課程，期望透過趣味化、任務導向的方式，幫助學生降低學習程式的門檻，建立正向的學習態度。課程初期以遊戲化學習平台為引導，結合故事情境與互動任務，讓學生逐步掌握 Python 的基礎語法與運算邏輯。中期後則導入人工智慧（AI）基本應用，包括圖像辨識、簡易分類器、語意生成與 Chatbot 設計，培養學生實作與應用能力。 學生將透過每週小任務與兩次專題實作（期中個人、期末小組）進行成果統整與創意思考，鼓勵學生發想文化、創意或生活議題的 AI 解決方案，強化其數位素養與跨域實作經驗。 This course is designed as an introductory Python and AI programming class for students without a computer science background. Through a gamified and task-based approach, it aims to lower the barrier to learning programming and foster a positive attitude towards coding. The course begins with game-based learning platforms to help students grasp Python syntax and logic in a fun and interactive environment. As the course progresses, students are introduced to foundational AI applications, including image recognition, simple classifiers, semantic generation, and Chatbot development. Weekly mini-assignments and two project-based assessments (an individual midterm and a group final project) guide students in synthesizing and applying their knowledge creatively. Students are encouraged to develop AI solutions for cultural, creativity, or daily life issues, thereby enhancing their digital literacy and interdisciplinary practice.

349138.objective: 以日本歷史為主軸，專題探討日本文化與社會之特質。 日本，無論就地理或歷史而言，對台灣都影響深遠，因此各大學開設「日本社會與文化」相關課程者非常眾多。作為文化事業發展系的專業選修科目，本課程除了一般的歷史文化背景介紹外，將特別著重於日本社會目前的重要課題以及內容娛樂產業（動漫電玩影視劇等）的發展。深入淺出教導學生認識日本的風土人情、社會結構特質與美學意識，開拓國際視野與文化交流的遠景。

349140.objective: 本課程以衣食住行、飲食男女等日常活動、交往、思維為主軸，考察一般人的歷史活動與日常生活在各時期的變化。當歷史不再只是帝王將相的豐功偉業或名流大家的傳奇生活，升斗小民的日常生活看似微不足道，點點滴滴的匯聚而成的正是一個社會的大歷史。

349144.objective: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生：(一) 認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值 (二) 有效學習 (三) 涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。 "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. 349146.objective: 本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向， 並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名， 並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。 依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。 一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。 二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。 期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。 The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application. Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories. 1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity. 2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability. It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

349148.objective: Course Description This course aims to provide students with a solid understanding of differential and integral calculus. It is designed to cultivate logical reasoning, inspire creative thinking, strengthen computational and deductive skills, and emphasize practical applications and graphing techniques. The goal is to build a strong mathematical foundation for future studies in engineering mathematics and related professional courses, ultimately achieving the objective of applying what is learned in real-world contexts. Course topics include: 1. Limits and Continuity 2. Derivatives and Their Applications 3. Indefinite and Definite Integrals 4. Transcendental Functions and Their Inverses 5. Integration Techniques 6. Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integrals 7. Applications of Definite Integrals 8. Solid Geometry and Vector Calculus 9. Partial Derivatives 10. Multiple Integrals 11. Series 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1. 極限與連續，2. 導數及其應用，3. 不定積分與定積分，4. 超越函數及其反函數，5. 積分法則，6. 不定型與瑕積分，7. 定積分的應用，8. 空間幾何與向量微積分，9. 偏導數，10. 重積分。

349150.objective: 本課程主要使學生能強化會計學的基本觀念，並以國際會計原則 (IFRS) 為架構，熟悉會計流程與財務報表之編製。課程內容包含會計恆等式與財務報表的介紹、借貸法則、會計處理程序 (分錄、過帳、試算) 與調整、結帳與會計循環的完成、買賣業會計、存貨的會計處理，最後則是現金流量表的編制。

349151.objective: 數位科技與人工智慧是資訊科技發展的兩大重要驅動力，本課程旨在培養本系學生在此領域學習的藍圖與概念建立。本課程將介紹數位科技與人工智慧的基本概念、原理與應用。在數位科技方面，將涵蓋 IT 基礎設施、網際網路、資訊安全、虛擬化與雲端，IoT 等主題。在人工智慧方面，將涵蓋機器學習、深度學習、自然語言處理、電腦視覺等主題。 Digital Technology and Artificial Intelligence are two major driving forces of the development of information technology. This course aims to cultivate students' learning blueprints and concepts in this field. This course will introduce the basic concepts, principles and applications of digital technology and artificial intelligence. In the areas of digital technology, it will cover topics such as IT infrastructure, the Internet, information security, virtualization and cloud computing, and IoT. In the areas of artificial intelligence, it will cover topics such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and computer vision.

349156.objective: 課程的目標期待透過理論與案例研究幫助學生理解「金融科技」，包括改變付款方式的破壞力、分析不斷變化的監管環境，並對人工智慧、區塊鏈、上雲、行動銀行、開放銀行、機器人顧問、眾籌、P2P 借貸等金融科技議題有著更深入的了解；此外，也介紹資訊安全與目前監管機構在金融科技的角色。 The objective of the course is to help students understand "Financial Technology" through theory and case studies, including the disruptive impact of changing payment methods, analyzing the constantly evolving regulatory environment, and gaining a deeper understanding of financial technology topics such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, cloud computing, mobile banking, open banking, robo-advisors, crowdfunding, peer-to-peer lending, etc. Additionally, it introduces information security and the role of current regulatory agencies in financial technology.

349159.objective: 「全民國防教育法」自民國 95 年 2 月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。 In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

349161.objective: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生：(一) 認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值 (二) 有效學習 (三) 涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。 "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management, so that they may construct the knowledge and imagination that are needed in planning for grand visions of achieving the goals of higher education.

349163.objective: 本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向， 並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名， 並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。 依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。 一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。 二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。 期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。 The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application. Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories. 1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity. 2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability. It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

349165.objective: 本課程教授近代百年設計，以平面設計為主軸，同時亦對當時設計運動所影響的設計相關領域，包括產品、服飾、室內與建築設計風格，做關聯性的介紹。透過近代百年設計發展主要運動的介紹，建立學生對於設計史的知識與設計文化涵養的紮根，並學習思考設計運動時代下的美學思潮脈絡與發展關係。 This course introduces students to graphic design as well as the influence of design movement in the fields of products, fashion, interior and architecture design that shaped the twentieth century in design. Through the introduction of the twentieth century in design, this course advances student’s understanding of design history and cultural enrichment. Students take an in-depth look at the context and development of movements that are significant in the history of design.

349166.objective: 課程規劃的目標為以互動設計的理論為基礎，實務導向為原則，使學習者能將學術界的理論與產業界的實務加以結合以充實對於互動設計具有的了解。學習的內容包含互動設計系統構成要素、實務與理論基礎、方法與技術、科技支援與應用等單元，各單元並包含不同互動設計個案的研討，使理論能與實務進行驗證。課程亦安排至相關領域業界的參訪以及互動相關展覽參觀，以加深對於互動設計實務的印象與了解。 The course aims to develop broad understanding on interaction design for students, based on theory and practice course structure. Course topics include essential factors of interactive system, interaction design theory and practice, methods and techniques, technical support and application. Course also incorporates case studies, company visits and exhibitions relevant to interaction design to enhance the understanding of integrating theory and practice.

349166.materials: 互動設計概論 – 創造互動設計無限應用的可能 Interaction Design – Creating Valuable Application of Interactive System Design A. 前言 一、定義：數位化時代的互動設計 (李所長) 1-1 使用者的體驗 1-2 產業界的技術推力 1-3 市場的接受度 1-4 創客 (Maker) 的實作 1-5 3D 列印與開放式硬體 (Arduino) 1-6 展覽策展人的規劃 二、互動設計的首要原則：使用者經驗 (大綱詳附件一) (陳老師) 1-1 問題 - 解決過程 1-2 使用者經驗定義 (含使用者中心設計 UCD) 1-3 使用者經驗的心理學基礎 (Donald A. Norman 的思考) 1-4 使用者行為研究法 (IDEO Method Cards) B. 生活中的互動設計 一、互動設計 vs. 人機介面 (大綱詳附件一) (陳老師) Chapter 1：人機介面的人因基礎 1-1 人機系統基本概念 (系統輸入輸出、控制與顯示) 1-2 人的認知過程與介面設計 (認知過程、人的感知系統) 1-3 心智模型與介面設計 Chapter 2：人機介面使用性 2-1 使用性工程 (基礎觀念) 2-2 介面使用性設計與使用者評估 (使用性 lifecycle、評估方法) 2-3 使用性設計實務 (網頁使用性設計、真實世界中的使用性) 2-4 介面設計之原理原則 (介面一致性…) Chapter 3：人機介面設計重要構面 3-1 介面設計類型 (從傳統控制顯示介面、GUI 到自然人機介面) 3-2 介面使用者經驗設計 (Jesse James Garrett 的 UXD) 3-3 資訊架構與流程 (任務分析) 3-4 原型設計 (prototyping) Chapter 4：常用之介面設計方法與工具 4-1 心情看板 moodboard 4-2 人物誌與情境 persona & scenario 4-3 快速原型工具 Axure RP、POP 4-4 卡片排序 Card sorting 二、互動設計 vs. 智慧空間 (大綱詳附件二) (吳老師) Chapter 5: 透視智慧空間的新發展 5-1 智慧空間之發展與潛在思維 Technological Development and Philosophy 5-2 智慧空間 - 從概念到實踐 Smart/ Human Centered Design 5-3 台灣智慧空間發展與產業 Industry/ Policies Chapter 6: 智慧化空間技術與材料 6-1 智慧空間與互動技術之需求 Needs 6-2 適用於空間之互動感知技術 Spatial sensor technology 6-3 虛擬實境與擴增實境 Augment & Virtual reality display 6-4 智慧化介面 Smart interface Chapter 7: 感知與回應模式 7-1 資訊空間與介面 Information control and interface 7-2 資訊流與資訊尋求 Information flow and information seeking 7-3 資訊視覺化與回應 Information visualization and reflection 7-4 使用者感受與操控 User perception and affordance Chapter 8: 智慧化空間設計與應用 8-1 應用方向 - 3D 實境 3D VR/ AR 8-2 應用方向 - 自動化 Automation 8-3 應用方向 - 節能 Energy saving 8-4 應用方向 - 物聯網 Internet of things 8-5 應用方向 - 物業管理 Property management 8-6 應用方向 - 通用設計 Universal design 三、互動設計 vs. 展示科技 (大綱詳附件三) (曹老師) Chapter 9: 展示內容與手法 9-1 會場環境端評估 9-2 觀眾研究 (如：空間心理學。參觀行為等) 9-3 博物館相關理論 Chapter 10: 展示科技與互動設計 10-1 觸控介面 10-2 非接觸式智慧導覽服務 10-3 影像辨識 10-4 動作偵測 10-5 特殊顯示 (如：水字幕。浮空投影等) 10-6 體感偵測 10-7 人臉辨識 10-8 擴增實境 Chapter 11: 超展示設計 11-1 多媒體展演 11-2 五感體驗 11-3 大型博覽會分析 Chapter 12: 發現生活中的展示科技 四、互動設計 vs. 數位學習 (李所長) Chapter 13: 科技進化下的數位學習 13-1 數位學習的定義與範圍 13-2 台灣數位學習產業與變遷 13-3 新科技下數位學習的發展與契機 Chapter 14: 數位學習的技術與工具 14-1 數位學習之觸控技術 14-2 數位學習之體感技術 14-3 數位學習與虛實整合的教具 14-4 科技輔助式學習工具 Chapter 15: 學習成效與評估模式 15-1 使用者省思與數位檔案評量 15-2 建構式發問與數位化形成性評量 15-3 總結性評量與線上追蹤 15-4 影響學習成效的評估 Chapter 16: 具互動性的數位學習應用案例 16-1 虛實整合的教具應用 16-2 AR 與 VR 的數位學習應用 16-3 穿戴式裝置結合行動學習的應用 16-4 跨載體無所不在的學習應用 16-5 開放式 /費線上學習的應用 附件一 前言 二、互動設計的首要原則：使用者經驗 本書，「互動設計概論 - 創造互動設計無限應用的可能」的中心思想不同於過去其他書籍強調在原理原則的說明、或是技術導向應用的介紹，而是由使用者相關的感知經驗為核心延伸至相關的人 - 機 - 境的應用。本章的目標在於介紹使用者經驗的基本概念理論，透過使用者經驗目標的了解、問題 - 解決過程邏輯、以人為本的思維構築以及創意思考的使用者行為探索與研究方法。

349167.objective: 本課程旨在瞭解設計的基本要素與美的形式原理，應用各種媒材的特性與構成，從平面及立體的構成的實作練習中，激發出設計美感與創造力。透過「使用者 — 產品 — 環境」三者間互動關係的深入探討，掌握住視覺傳達與多媒體的基本語彙，作為互動設計的基礎，創造出全新的體驗與感受。 The course is to prepare students for understanding the basic elements of design and the form and principle of art. To achieve these goals, the course provides opportunities for students to apply characteristics and compositions of diverse media for the form of two-dimension and three-dimension in practice. Also, the course arouses student’s design aesthetics and creativity. To explore the context of user-product-environment, students understand visual communication and multimedia language as a basis of interaction design toward completely new experiences and sensation.

349168.objective: 本課程之目的在於介紹情境劇本法 (scenario) 之相關知識與其在互動設計上之應用。藉由此課程的學習，學生可以了解如何使用代表性的角色擬定以及故事板的操作以發現關鍵設計議題。透過實務操作了解方法並練習模擬製作，學生能具備業界所需之互動情境或介面設計應有之情境敘事技巧與能力。課程內容包含情境故事法介紹、人 - 機 - 境概念、互動情境模擬、代表性角色擬定以及故事板製作。學生評量方式則包含報告撰寫以及作業繳交。 The aim of the course is to introduce basic knowledge and application of scenario technique on interaction design. Through this course, students can understand how to define the characters of an interactive scenario and develop storyboard to draw out key design theme.Through hands-on practice and simulation exercises, students will acquire the narrative skills and abilities needed for designing interactive scenarios or interfaces required in the industry. Course contents include introduction of scenario method, human-machine-scenario, interactive scenario narration, character mapping and storyboard. Students will be evaluated by reports and their works.

349173.objective: The primary goal of this course is to equip students with foundational 3D modeling and rendering skills, while guiding them through the complete process of transforming a design concept into a tangible output. The course will focus on Rhino 3D, a widely used tool in both fabrication and industrial design. Through a series of tutorials and hands-on exercises, students will develop a solid understanding of the software and gain essential skills applicable to various design industries. By the end of the semester, each student is expected to complete a comprehensive Graphic Doding project, which must include codes, renderings, animations, and a 3D model. This final package will serve as the key evaluation criteria for the course. In addition, we will dedicate part of the class to introducing digital fabrication workflows, providing students the opportunity to gain hands-on experience with turning digital models into physical objects.

349176.objective: The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on : (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year, the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year, we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

349178.objective: Principle of Interaction Design: Autumn 2024 - Syllabus Credit Hours: 2.0 Instructors: Ryan Sheng-Ming Wang Course Description: "Interaction Design" blends theoretical and practical perspectives in the areas of visualization and interactivity into several focused aspects using interactivity for education, entertainment, interactive media design and industrial design purposes. An interface is the link between a user and a design that communicates how a design will be used, creating an experience for the people who will use it. It provides the framework, elements, and resources for a “conversation” to take place between users and design. In this course, we will explore the fundamentals of interfaces and the interaction design process. Students will be introduced to and have opportunity to practice the fundamental concepts, methods, and practices of interaction design. They will explore the ideas of "User Experience Observation ", "Form Follows Function" and "User Interaction Analysis and Evaluation". They will explore how interactive media create experiences, and understand the role that interaction with contents and installment fulfills in human existence. Finally and most importantly, students need to learn how to improve their ability to present their design ideas. This is a class with time devoted to lecture, discussion, practice activities, design work sessions, and critique of practical work. Course Objectives/Goals: At the conclusion of the course, students will be able to: 1. Identify how increasingly complex technologies are integrated into designs, services and events. 2. Define how digital or physical artifacts behave in response to user-centric interaction. 3. Describe, test and evaluate the usability and sustainability of user interfaces. 4. Apply iterative cycles of research, testing and development based on the understanding of user needs, goals and experiences. 5. Develop solutions and processes to common or known interface problems. 6. Build and test rapid prototypes for look and feel and usability. 7. Utilize client based concept development to develop the strategy, information architecture, human-computer interaction and interface design. 8. Demonstrate competency in information architecture, human-computer interaction and interface design.

349186.objective: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生：(一) 認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值 (二) 有效學習 (三) 涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則，工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康，安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。 "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

349187.objective: 本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向， 並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名， 並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。 依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。 一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。 二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。 期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。 The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application. Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories. 1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity. 2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability. It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

349189.objective: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1. 極限與連續，2. 導數及其應用，3. 不定積分與定積分，4. 超越函數及其反函數，5. 積分法則，6. 不定型與瑕積分，7. 定積分的應用，8. 空間幾何與向量微積分，9. 偏導數，10. 重積分。 This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

349190.objective: 本課程的目的是為了：1. 驗證物理理論之真實性，2. 培養同學認真的科學態度與方法，3. 培養同學數據處理的能力，4. 啟發同學自行設計解決量度問題的方法。課程之施行為一學分三小 時，內容偏重電磁、光學、近物之實驗。 In this course there will be 1 credit for one semester; and 3 laboratorial hours per week. The experiments contains electromagnetics, optics, and modern physics, etc.. The purposes of this course are 1. to identify the physical laws, 2. to cultivate students' earnest manner and methods of science, 3. to cultivate their ability of data reduction, 4. to instruct them to solve the problems of measurements by self-designments.

349191.objective: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。 The course is aimed directly at the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester, and 3 lecture hours per week.

349205.objective: 本課程將針對電子電路在電力電子轉換器的應用上教授電路的分析與設計，本課程包含了電力電子學、電子學、控制系統等領域。 課程的內容包含: 1. 基礎理論的回顧 2. 模擬軟體的學習與應用 3. 被動 / 主動元件介紹 4. 轉換器的電路架構說明 5. 轉換器的電路動作分析 6. 功率開關的特性與其應用的場合 7. 功率轉換器的損耗分析 8. 轉換器的基本控制模式介紹 9. 轉換器的控制迴路設計與模擬驗證 10. 周邊的保護電路與感測電路介紹 11. 設計案例說明 12. 進階電力電子技術分析探討 This course will teach the analysis and design of circuits for the application of electronic circuits in power electronic converters. This course covers the fields of power electronics, electronics, and control systems. Course content includes: 1. Review of power electronics background 2. Learning a simulation software 3. Introduction of the principle of the passive components 4. Description of the circuit topologies of the converter 5. Analysis of the circuit operation principle of the converter 6. Introduction of the characteristics of power switches and their applications 7. Introduction of the loss analysis of power converters 8. Introduction to the control method of the converter 9. Introduction of the control loop design and simulation verification of the converter 10. Introduction of peripheral protection circuit and sensing circuit 11. Design case review 12. Introduction of the advanced power electronics topic

349312.objective: This course provides an in-depth study of digital signal processing (DSP) principles and techniques. Some ideas are built using MATLAB codes. Topics include discrete-time signals and systems, Fourier analysis, Z-transform, filter design and implementation, sampling rate conversion, random signal processing, and spectral analysis. The course emphasizes both theoretical foundations and practical applications through assignments, projects, and research paper studies. By the end of this course, students will be able to: 1. Analyze and process discrete-time signals and systems. 2. Apply the Fourier and Z-transform techniques to signal analysis. 3. Design and implement FIR and IIR digital filters. 4. Perform spectral analysis and sampling rate conversion. 5. Critically review and present recent research papers in DSP. 6. Complete a comprehensive final project demonstrating mastery of course concepts.
349312.schedule: Week 1: Introduction Week 2: Discrete-Time Signals and Systems Week 3: Discrete-Time Fourier Analysis Week 4: Z-Transform Week 5-6: Discrete Fourier Transform Week 7-8: Implementation of Discrete-Time Filter Week 9: Midterm Week 10: FIR Filter Design Week 11: IIR Filter Design Week 12: Sampling Rate Conversion Week 13: Random Signal Processing Week 14-15 Spectral Analysis Techniques Week 16-17 Paper Study Week 18: Final Project Presentation

349366.objective: Statistical design of experiments is a wide subject that treats a large number of methods for planning experimental investigations in a manner that ensures statistically valid conclusions. This course introduces students to concepts and techniques of classical and applied experimental design and covers the statistical design of experiments for systematically examining how a system functions. Topics covered will include: introduction to fundamentals and principles of experiments, blocking designs, completely randomized designs (CRD), randomized completely block designs (RCBD), full factorial designs with two levels, fractional designs with two levels, Latin square designs, 3-leval designs (CCD, BBD, Cuboidal designs), and response surface methodologies.
349366.schedule: Week 1 Introduction to fundamentals of engineering statistics and principles of experimentation Week 2-3 Simple comparative experiments: CRD (Completely randomized design) Week 4-5 RCBDs (Randomized complete block designs) Week 6-8 Factorial designs and 2-level factorial designs Week 9 Midterm or assignment Week 10-13 2-level fractional factorial design and resolution Week 14-15 3-level (fractional) factorial designs and multi-factor designs (Latin square design, CCD, BBD, Cuboidal designs) Week 16-17 Fitting regression model including GLM: Estimation, diagnostics Week 18 Final exam or assignment
349366.materials: Montgomery, D. C. (2017), Design and Analysis of Experiments, 9th Ed., Wiley. Supplementary references: Will be noticed if necessary. Additional materials will be covered from other texts and/or from recent literature.

349371.objective: 本課程將以英文授課，引入生活性的學習方法來誘發學生學習動機，並培養可在社會與職場運用的四項英文基本技能。課程目標在幫助學生在生活實境習得英文，為他們裝備可溝通表達於日常、社交活動，並提升職涯的整合性英文技能。每堂課程都注重在以學生為中心的學習活動中帶入全真、應用性高的英文技巧。課程設計涵蓋的功能包括課堂分享與作業、日常互動英文以及專業英文練習。主要課題包括溝通，簡報與談判技巧，應用閱讀與寫作，聽力技巧運用，語言與文化。 This course will be instructed in English. This course introduces real-world based learning approaches for students to raise their learning aspirations and to develop four essential English skills that are applicable in social and professional encounters. This course aims to help students practice English in most real-life settings and to equip them with integrated skills to advance their careers. Every class session focuses on bringing authentic and applied English in student-centered leaning activities. The class design covers the functions like information sharing and task-based activities, social interactions, and professional English practices. Essential topics include communication, techniques of negotiation and presentation, applied reading and writing, strategies for developing listening skills and language learning across cultures.

349379.objective: 產品與服務的開發與設計主要在提升使用者的經驗。以此課程教授使用者經驗的概念與其資料收集與分析的方法。學生將能了解使用者經驗的概念、其資料的收集的方法與資料形式，以及相關之實驗設計與統計分析的方法。 The primary objective of the development and design of products and services is to enhance user experience. The concept of user experience and the methods for its data collection and analysis will be taught in the course. Students will learn the user experience concept, the methods of data collection and the formats of collected data, as well as related methods of experimental design and statistical analysis.

349385.objective: 本課程主要探討高等應用統計的相關原理方法與應用案例，包括一般資料分析、信度效度、迴歸分析、主成分分析、多元尺度分析、區別分析、抽樣調查等。課程將配合個案進行討論。 The objective of this course is to help students understand the data analysis and applications. The major contents include reliability and effectiveness of data, regression analysis, principle component analysis, multi-dimensional scaling, logistic analysis and sampling analysis. The course will also include some practical example discussions.

349386.objective: The objective of this course is to teach students how to make smart financial decisions in an effort to create most economical investment return. This course focuses on identification of investment projects, investment decision-making, project analysis and evaluation methods. The subjects includes: the investment environment, cost concepts and behaviors, understanding financial statements, investment project evaluation, interest rate and inflation rate, own - and debt financing, internal and external financing, depreciation, income taxes, developing project cash flows, capital budgeting, uncertainty and risk. Various factors that affect the financial decision problems such as economics, management, environment, and politics are discussed to help decision makers properly resolve investment decisions.

349389.objective: This course introduces students to the process of data science, covering problem formulation, data acquisition, modeling and analysis, and presentation and integration into action. Students will learn useful skills as well as basic statistical methods by completing several hands-on problems focused on real-world data. This course starts with a brief introduction to multivariate data analysis and data summarization including visualization. Then it extends to focus on using data to develop predictive capabilities using supervised and unsupervised machine learning models (regression, classification, clustering, PCA, etc.).

349390.objective: 本課程主要是介紹六標準差方法。六標準差 (Six Sigma) 是一套管理系統，它是透過聆聽顧客的聲音 (Voice of Customer)，經由關鍵品質 (Critical to Quality) 的分析，利用專案的方式，以流程改善工具解決有問題的企業流程。本課程著重了解 “Six Sigma” 理論、分析工具及統計應用軟體 (Minitab) 之運用，針對六標準差綠帶、黑帶專業培訓課程，藉由理論分析與實際操作使用的說明，協助學生將”Six Sigma” 導入企業，以獲得關鍵流程的改進。 This course primarily introduces the Six Sigma methodology. Six Sigma is a management system that listens to the Voice of Customer, analyzes Critical to Quality factors, and utilizes project-based approaches with process improvement tools to address problematic business processes. The course focuses on understanding the theory of Six Sigma, analysis tools, and the application of statistical software (Minitab). It is designed for Green Belt and Black Belt professional training in Six Sigma. Through theoretical analysis and practical exercises, the course assists students in implementing Six Sigma in enterprises to achieve improvements in key processes.

349408.objective: 鍍膜製程為近代製造業廣泛利用之表面處理技術，常用於刀具、模具、光學元件、感測器及半導體裝置等。本課程提供物理、化學法鍍膜技術之原理、設備之介紹。並講述膜成核、生長理論與近代薄膜科技於能源、光電、生醫與環境領域之應用。 Film deposition process, a surface treatment technology, has been widely used in modern manufacturing. It is commonly applied in the development of cutters, molds, optical component, sensor and semiconductor devices, etc. This course provides an introduction regarding the basic principle and apparatus of the coating technology (physical and chemical routes). Besides, the film nucleation, growth theory and their applications in energy, optoelectronic, biomedical and environmental fields are described as well.

349479.objective: 結構工程上的問題一般都會以微分方程式來表示，微分方程式的求解除了少數簡單及線性的結構系統能以解析的方法求解外，大都需要使用數值方法來求解。例如使用有限元素法來進行結構分析，其中就隱含相當多的數值分法，如微分方程式的離散化，函數插值法，數值積分，數值微分，非線性方程式的求解以及矩陣計算等等。主要課程內容有: (1) Numerical Systems and Errors (2) Interpolation by Polynomial (3) Numerical Solution of Nonlinear Equations (4) Numerical Differentiation and Integration (5) Numerical Solution of Differential Equations (6) Numerical Linear Algebra

349497.objective: 本課程主要介紹財務管理的基礎知識，分析、診斷、控制與健全企業財務的方法。其中，主要內容包括閱讀、分析與診斷財務報表，評價「錢」與「時間」的關係，評估最適工程方案的決策，營建業投資開發財務可行性分析與決策，財務風險的衡量與應用等。本課程的目標，透過財務管理基礎知識的建立，與診斷分析控制方法的介紹，輔以實務或專題討論，培養工程領域學生處理工程財務管理的能力，進而提昇工程管理的執行力。 This course offers an introduction to the fundamental concepts of financial management, with a focus on methods for analyzing, diagnosing, controlling, and improving corporate financial performance. Core topics include the interpretation and evaluation of financial statements, the time value of money, decision-making for selecting optimal engineering alternatives, financial feasibility analysis for investment and development projects in the construction industry, and techniques for measuring and managing financial risk. The course is designed to build foundational financial knowledge while introducing analytical and diagnostic tools. Through a combination of practical applications and topic-based discussions, students in the engineering field will develop the ability to manage financial aspects of engineering projects, thereby enhancing their overall effectiveness in engineering management.

349506.objective: 許多現成的工程軟體並無法滿足所有客製化的需求，因此會開放作謂的「應用程式介面」（Application Programming Interfaces, API）供使用者進行二次開發，使其能自行拼湊、重組與創造需要的功能。本課程以建築資訊塑模（BIM）或人工智慧（AI）應用為主要示範案例，訓練學生有系統地理解 API 的規格說明文件，並且有效率地開發 API 應用程式，以達到各種工程應用軟體的客製化應用，並提升不同軟體間的交互操作性。 Many engineering software packages may not fully meet all customized requirements, thus they provide Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) for users to engage in secondary development. This course takes Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications as primary demonstration examples, and trains the enrolled students to systematically understand API documentations as well as efficiently develop API applications. It can help the enrolled students to customize their software for solving the engineering problems. In addition, it also enhances the interoperability between different engineering software packages.

349515.objective: 本課程為碩士班結構材料組一年級的核心選修課程。本課程內容著重在了解結構動力學基本原理與分析方法。以大學部的靜力學、材料力學、結構學等相關課程為基礎，進一步了解結構物在受具有時間特性的動態載重下引發的動態反應。本學期課程內容可大致分為：運動方程式、自由振動、強制振動、數值分析方法、反應譜分析、多自由度系統分析、阻尼特性、頻率域分析簡介等。 This course is a core elective designed for first-year graduate students in the Structural Materials division of the Master’s program. The course focuses on the fundamental principles and analytical methods of structural dynamics. Building upon undergraduate-level courses such as statics, mechanics of materials, and structural analysis, students will further explore the dynamic responses of structures subjected to time-dependent loads. The main topics covered during the semester include: Equations of motion, Free vibration, Forced vibration, Numerical analysis methods, Response spectrum analysis, Multi-degree-of-freedom (MDOF) system analysis, Damping characteristics, and Introduction to frequency domain analysis.

349529.objective: Disaster is divided to natural and anthropogenic disaster. Either natural or anthropogenic disaster damage can be minimized by proper management, including pre- and post- management. Learning from the history, several disasters have been identified and more and more technologies have been developed to mitigate the possible disasters. In this course, natural disasters are focus because it is more difficult to predict and prevent. With the changing environment and climate, the intensity and frequency of natural disasters become more strong and unpredictable; therefore, the disaster management is very important. Real cases for different types of disaster will be chosen and discussed in this course. Facing these disasters, what we can do and how we can prepare is a survival issue. Through the comprehensive discussion, the students are expected to learn the structural and nonstructural solutions for the various disasters. 349535.objective: 本課程是較大學部的「岩石力學」課程為之深入探討岩石行為的課程，將針對岩石的指數性質、透水性、強度及變形性做一回顧，並介紹岩力在基礎、隧道、邊坡等工程上之應用。上課並將佐以論文研究，以培養學生之研究興趣鍛鍊相關研究工具及方法為主。其涵蓋的論文內容大致如下： 1、量綱分析與相似性 2、裂力在岩石力學上之應用 (如貫裂破壞、水力破壞) 3、後尖峰強度之穩定性 4、榫塊理論 (暫定，依實際需要調整之) 等 。 Compared to the undergraduate Rock Mechanics course, this is a more advanced course to examine the behaviors of rocks under different stress conditions。 It will review the index properties, the permeability properties, the strength properties, and the deformation properties of rocks, and focus on the application of rock mechanics to (1). Underground tunneling and mining, (2). Slope stability, and (3). Foundation engineering。 Additionally, to improve research motivation and ability, this course will introduce students to some concepts: (1) Dimensional analysis and Similarity; (2). Fracture mechanics including indentation fracture and hydrofracturing; (3). Post-peak response and stability/bifurcation; (4). (To be adjusted). The students taking this course will have plenty of reading assignments, and are required to participate in the classroom discussions.

349538.objective: 本課程將探討明渠中穩定流、非穩定流、均勻流、非均勻流之流體特性。 Open channel hydraulics treats the motion of water in conduits that have a free surface, that is, in which the flow of water is not completely bounded by the channel perimeter and one surface is exposed to atmospheric pressure. The flows can be steady (time-invariant) or unsteady, uniform (space-invariant) or non-uniform (gradually, rapidly, or spatially varied). For engineers, open channels are very common for the conveyance of natural waters, storm discharges, sewage collection systems, and aqueducts for water distribution systems. Knowledge of the mechanics of open-channel flow, then, is important for the proper design of these facilities.
349538.schedule: 1. Open Channel Flow and Its Classifications 2. Open Channel and Their Properties 3. Energy and Momentum Principles 4. Critical Flow 5. Uniform Flow and Its Formula 6. Computation of Uniform Flow 7. Design of Open Channels 8. Theoretical Concepts of Boundary Layer, Surface Roughness, velocity distribution 9. Theory and Analysis of Gradually Varied Flow 10. Methods of Computing Gradually Varied Flow 11. Applications of Flow Profiles Computations 12. Spatially Varied Flow 13. Gradually Varied Unsteady Flow 14. Rapidly Varied Unsteady Flow
349538.materials: Subramanya, K., 2009, Flow in Open Channels. McGraw Hill.
349538.remarks: Open Channel Hydraulics by B. T. Chow, McGraw-Hill

349623.objective: FUEL CELLS are an important component in Energy Engineering and can be defined as an electrochemical system that converts chemical energy in the fuel into electrical energy with the help of electrodes and redox electrochemical. There are many kinds of fuel cells that help us in meeting the energy demands of this modernizing world. Understanding them theoretically is very significant for research advancements in the field of Energy. This course ' FUEL CELLS’ is a basic course taught entirely in English. The aim of this course is to provide introductory knowledge to students about the basics, types, working mechanism, applications and advancements in the field of fuel cells. This class will also deal with sustainable fuel cells for producing clean energy and thereby preventing hazardous environmental issues through significant energy efficiency improvements and sustainable use of resources. This course enables students to fully understand the basics of professional disciplines of the fuel cell, and to further inspire and enhance the knowledge of students about future energy technology. This course also has an important objective of motivating non-native English students to improve their English language skills like conversing, discussing and writing assignments in English. These practices will help them deliver better English presentations and also enhance their thesis and paper writing abilities.

349627.objective: 本課程適合修過工程數學、基礎熱流以及具備基本操作 ANSYS FLUENT 軟體的碩博士班學生選修。授課內容主要是應用 Matlab 及 CFD 套裝軟體分析能源與熱流科學領域的相關問題，並著重於案例分析。課程內容主要包括利用數值分析解析邊界層問題、有限差分法求解穩態與暫態熱傳導以及二維強制驅動流問題，案例分析包括室內氣流運動、潔淨室氣流分佈、熱交換器性能分析、儲冰系統分析、電子散熱以及氫能系統等。

349629.objective: 因應全球淨零碳排趨勢，能源管理與碳管理為國家各產業提升競爭力的重要環節。本課程將從 ISO50001 能源管理與 ISO14064 碳管理制度出發，講授能源管理、能源績效評估、碳管理、和績效提升 / 減碳計算之量測與驗證方法學。講授內容涵蓋：關鍵觀念、節能 / 減碳技術、績效 / 減碳量測與驗證方法、節能 / 減碳統計分析方法學、和案例 EXCEL 操作與討論。 In response to the global trend of net-zero carbon emissions, energy management and carbon management are important links in improving the competitiveness of various industries in the country. This course will start from the ISO50001 energy management and ISO14064 carbon management systems and teach the measurement and verification methodologies of energy management, energy performance assessment, carbon management, and performance improvement/carbon reduction calculations. The teaching contents cover: key concepts, energy saving/carbon reduction technology, performance/carbon reduction measurement and verification methods, energy saving/carbon reduction statistical analysis methodology, and EXCEL case practice and discussion.
349629.schedule: (1) 課程簡介與 ISO 50001 能源管理 / ISO 14064 碳管理簡介 (2) 能源績效量測與驗證 - 關鍵與基礎：ISO 50001 能源管理系統、國際能源績效量測與驗證協定 (International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol, IPMVP) (3) 能源績效量測與驗證 - 重要議題：IPMVP 重要內涵、選項與簡單案例 (4) 能源績效量測與驗證 - 量測：量測儀表、量測方法 (5) 能源績效量測與驗證 - 量測與取樣：誤差與不確定度、取樣分析 (6) 能源績效量測與驗證 - 計算：統計分析 I 與 EXCEL 應用實作 (7) 能源績效量測與驗證 - 計算：統計分析 II - 數據判定、不確定度分析與 EXCEL 應用實作 (8) 能源績效量測與驗證 - 計算：數據判定、組合不確定度與 EXCEL 應用實作 (9) 能源績效量測與驗證 - 計算：案例操作與 EXCEL 應用實作 (10) 碳盤查與管理 IOS14064：IOS 14064 系列標準內涵 (11) 碳盤查關鍵項目：各範疇 (Scope) 鑑別與說明 (12) 節能 / 減碳技術應用：系統節能技術、減碳技術 (13) 能源管理與碳管理：組織 (Organization) 管理、能源資通訊技術 (Energy Information and Communication Technology, EICT) 應用 (14) 實務案例討論：生產性質行業 (15) 實務案例討論：非生產性質行業 (16) 期末報告 (簡報) I (17) 期末報告 (簡報) II (18) 期末考 (Open book)

349633.objective: 本課程為訓練學生具有敏銳的觀察能力及細密的思考能力，以發現技職教育的相關問題，並擬定完善可行的研究計畫，遂行研究工作，經客觀分析程序，並作成研究論。課程內容括技職教育研究概論、研究設計、研究方法、取樣與量測、資料處理、報告撰寫。 This course is a survey of research methodology that is relevant to the technological education. 349663.objective: 本課程主要探討高分子在溶液及固態時的物理化學現象及其應用。內容包括熱力學、高分子的微結構及定性。 熱力學探討統計熱力學、晶格理論、Flory-Huggin 理論、Flory-Krigbaum 理論、相分離、θ- 溫度、滲透壓、GPC 測分子量、高分子膠體。 高分子之微結構包括有高分子之形狀、自由旋轉分子鏈距離、光散射、中子散射、排拒體積、碎形、霍氏光譜及核磁共振儀在高分子微結構之分析。
349663.schedule: 1.Introduction 2.Chain structure 3.Molecular weight and size 4.Concentrated solution 5.Phase separation 6.Amorphous state 7.Crystalline state 8.Rubber elasticity
349663.score_policy: Term Performance Including Attendance(20%) Report(30%) Final Exam(50%)

349665.objective: 本課程主要探討各種高分子之聚合方法及動力學之研究，如逐步聚合、遊離基連鎖聚合、乳化聚合、離子連鎖聚合、連鎖共聚合反應、開環聚合、立體規則高分子之合成，未終止的游離基聚合方法。從分子量的分佈，結構物性之關係，作高分子聚合之最佳化設計，並且探討這些聚合方法如何應用在最新的科技上，如光電材料、複合材料。

349689.objective: The progress of electronic industry accelerates the computer development so that computer simulation becomes one of the important tool in many fields. In this course, we will discuss how to apply the computer to assist the molecular structure design. In order to gain insight into the basic idea of structural design, the fundamental background in molecular mechanics, molecular dynamics, and quantum chemistry will be introduced. Some practical softwares will also be included in the course. Each student has to prepare his personal notebook for practice each lecture.

349691.objective: The course introduces nanomaterials and their preparation processes (including chemical method and physical methods). Future development and applications are also discussed. This course will cover the following topics:1. Introduction of nanomaterials and Nano-chemistry; 2. Nanomaterials: structure and analysis; 3. Quantum mechanics; 4. Nanomaterials: self-assembly; 5. Nanomaterials: simulation; 6. Carbon-based nanomaterials; 7. Advanced synthesis and processing 8. Growth and application of semiconductor nanoparticles; 9. SEG & ESG prospectives. 本門授課之目的在於介紹奈米材料及其製程 (包括化學法及物理法奈米材料法)，並探討奈米材料的未來發展及應用。所包括的課程主題如下：1. 奈米材料與奈米化學簡介。2. 奈米材料與結構分析 3. 量子力學；4. 奈米材料自我組成 5. 奈米材料模擬 6. 碳化奈米材料 7 先進奈米材料製成 8. 奈米材料的應用；9. 奈米材料的遠景與未來發展。

349699.objective: 本課程區分為四個實習，共一學年之都市設計實習，每學期應從事幾項實習，依該學期之情況而定：(一) 大型基地開發之建築規劃與都市設計實習：參照台北市都市發展局擬定之「都市設計與土地使用開發許可」之審議標準，練習建築、敷地與都市設計三者整合關係之設計實習。(二) 都市更新地區都市設計實習：以台北市更新地區為範例，選定基地範圍從事都市更新地區之改造，建立地區未來像，並擬定都市設計準則。(三) 都市計畫通盤檢討地區都市設計實習：依據都市計畫通盤檢討第八條規定，都市計畫通盤檢討地區必須依據該地區之交通、產業、文化、生態及基地等因素，擬定都市設計準則；以台北市都市計畫通盤檢討為例，練習都市設計準則之訂定，或以都市計畫細部計畫為例，研擬土地使用分區管制與設計準則。(四) 新發展區都市設計實習：選定一個地區，可能是擴大都市發展地區或新市鎮、新社區之規劃設計實習。 There are four exercises for one academic year. The exercises to be undertaken depend on when and how it is appropriate:(1) Exercise on building planning and urban design for large-scale land development project (2) Exercise practice on urban design for district renewal planning (3) Exercise of overall review district urban design out of the total urban design (4) Exercise on urban design for new development area

349708.objective: 研究生相較於大學期間訓練的最主要差別在於其必須從事個人的學術研究。因此，研究生須要資訊與洞察力以達成獲得較高學位之論文寫作能力。故本課程主要內容包括： 一、 研究的特性 二、 智慧收集 -「什麼」的問題 三、 研究 -「何故」的問題 四、 良好研究的特質 五、 研究的基本類型 六、 從事研究的技能 七、 研究倫理 八、 研究設計練習 The necessity for personal academic research is the key cultural change that postgraduate students will encounter compared with their undergraduate days. Thus, postgraduate students need information and insights to develop the capacity to operate successfully achieving a higher-level degree. To examine these concerns, the course includes: 1. Characteristics of research 2. Intelligence-gathering-the "what" questions 3. Research-the "why" questions 4. Characteristics of good research 5. Basic types of research 6. The craft of doing research 7. Research ethics 8. Research design practice

349708.objective: 研究生相較於大學期間訓練的最主要差別在於其必須從事個人的學術研究。因此，研究生須要資訊與洞察力以達成獲得較高學位之論文寫作能力。故本課程主要內容包括： 一、 研究的特性 二、 智慧收集 -「什麼」的問題 三、 研究 -「何故」的問題 四、 良好研究的特質 五、 研究的基本類型 六、 從事研究的技能 七、 研究倫理 八、 研究設計練習 The necessity for personal academic research is the key cultural change that postgraduate students will encounter compared with their undergraduate days. Thus, postgraduate students need information and insights to develop the capacity to operate successfully achieving a higher-level degree. To examine these concerns, the course includes: 1. Characteristics of research 2. Intelligence-gathering-the "what" questions 3. Research-the "why" questions 4. Characteristics of good research 5. Basic types of research 6. The craft of doing research 7. Research ethics 8. Research design practice

349710.objective: 本課程授課主要內容分為三部分：第一部份為都市防災概論，此部分主要針對國內外文獻作一回顧，進而瞭解都市防災整體架構，區分為（1）文獻回顧；（2）防災基本計畫；及（3）防災整體架構等。期使國內都市計畫能逐步邁向防災都市計畫，以建立『安全都市』為目標。此部分的主要內容區分為：（1）都市災害風險理念的形成；（2）防災都市計畫與地區防災系統規劃；（3）都市計畫防災系統規劃原則；（4）都市計畫防災作業準則內容架構；（5）都市計畫防災作業準則；（6）安心都市計畫的形成與實現。第三部分為實務操作部分，以草屯鎮為例，藉九二一大地震的實例，深入探討災情調查的方法，實際調查狀況及研訂災後重建的程序與計畫內容，期望成為國內都市重建計畫的範例，主要內容區分為：（1）緒論；（2）重建理論；（3）草屯鎮現況發展；（4）災情調查方法與重建程序之建立；（5）災情調查分析與重建計畫內容研訂等。

349727.objective: Construction history could be considered as the key foundation to understand architectonic theories. Conventionally, architectural academies provide study aspects either in architectural histories in terms of development of architectural style and philosophy or in the latest progress of architectural materials and construction techniques. Moreover, theoretical debates of architecture also pay more attentions to philosophical discussions instead of physical construction presentation. Nevertheless, architectonic theories mainly discuss the presentation of materials and construction systems. Therefore, construction methods of materials in fact affect the interpretation of architectonic theories significantly. As a result, this course can be divided into two sections: firstly the construction history of Eastern and Western worlds as well as modern period of time will be reviewed. Students should present their plans of their final reports in the mid-term class about 10 minutes, in order to collect some feedback from colleagues and class instructor for further develop to achieve the final report. ＊＊Research thesis 30% One should submit his/her thesis by the noon of 1/21 (12:00pm) to Dr. Wu in person. The words of the thesis should not be less than 5000 words. It should be in thesis format (word) instead of brief presentation format (power point). Employed materials of one’s chosen architectural project for the thesis should be clarified. Please note that the referred theories should be reviewed firstly. Aftermath, the discussion of material deployment should be referred to at least one of the architectonic or atectonic theories.

349729.objective: 隨著跨學門的多元連結，當代建築學的設計與史論研究向度越趨廣泛且複雜。為回應此變動的條件，研究方法作為知識體系建構的工具，亦需重新思考如何提供理解當代建築學和認識論的新興維度。因此，本課程首先以「研究為一門藝術的概念」- 透過理解自身意識與研究的關係，作為開啟研究的初步引導。接著，將從人文社會科學研究方法的基礎出發，探討如何在建築學門內適切轉化及運用此些方法。透過本課程，學習者將能夠有效辯證和梳理不同研究主體 (知識論) 以及該研究所對應之方法邏輯 (方法論), 並以此作為設計研究的基礎建構。同時，期待學習者能夠理解在建築研究中，學門的部分特殊性質所衍伸出的方法論修正，並鼓勵為當代建築設計與史論研究提供新的思路。 With the growing interdisciplinary connections, contemporary architectural design, theoretical research, and historical dimensions have become increasingly expansive and intricate. In response to these evolving conditions, research methods, as essential tools for constructing knowledge systems, need to be reconsidered in order to offer fresh insights into understanding contemporary architecture and its epistemology. This course starts by embracing the concept of "research as an art" as a foundational guide to initiate research, emphasizing the crucial relationship between self-awareness and the research process. It then builds upon the established research methods in the humanities and social sciences, exploring how to effectively adapt and apply these methods within the field of architecture. 349760.objective: 本課程旨在研討專業英文研究及應用，課程包括專業領域英語文之語域分析，探討各領域中的語法及詞彙特點，並進一步分析不同領域中之修辭及言語萹章使用，進而研討語言溝通目標功能分析並結合策略研究，以將理論應用於專業實務及研究中。 This course is intended for graduate students who are pre-experienced in working in specific fields of professions. For other students who are inexperienced in the workplace are required to have consolidated knowledge and observations of the world industries. It aims to address the applicability of theories in EPP and the plethora of situations raised from such applications. The course will provide theoretical studies for applications in respect to register analysis, rhetorical and discourse analysis, functionality analysis and skills and strategies. It is also expected that the course will describe other models in EPP studies.

349765.objective: 傳統發音教學大多根據教師直覺認為語音是該如何產製的、或發音課本中教條式的規則。在這堂課，學生將透過具體的聲學和構音資料、來學習重要語音學原則，並學習將原則正確地應用在發音教學當中。學生也將探討如何將這些知識轉化成不同年齡層和語言程度之學生可以接受的內容。 Traditionally, teaching pronunciation has been based on "armchair data" (e.g., the instructor's intuition on how a sound should be articulated) or prescriptive statements in pronunciation textbooks. In this course, students will learn fundamental principles of phonetics through experimental acoustic and articulatory data and learn how to apply them to pronunciation teaching. Students will be challenged to translate what they have learned into digestible pronunciation instructions for students of different ages and proficiency levels.

349768.objective: 本課程旨在介紹英語全球化、全球英語，以及英語作為國際語言的發展與相關論述，並針對英語在全球擴散的現象，檢視相關的概念與理論。本課程將探討因英語全球化所造成，在社會語言學、文化、政治經濟與教育等方面的重要議題，以及與世界英語相關的議題與爭論。 This course aims to provide students with an overview of the spread of the English language around the world, the emergence of World Englishes/ Global Englishes, and the development of the popularization of English as a world lingua franca. It examines the various concepts and theories developed in academia to account for the unprecedented global expansion of English. Through readings and class discussion, this course will look at key sociolinguistic, cultural, politico-economic and educational issues arising from the spread of English as well as the current issues and debates surrounding World Englishes/ Global Englishes. Students will be encouraged to conduct original research on or detailed analysis of the implications of English as the international language.
349768.schedule: Syllabus 1. Course Introduction 2. The history of English 3. The global spread of English 4. Language change and diversity in English 5. English in the inner circle 6. English in the outer circle 7. English in the expanding circle 8. English as a lingua franca 9. Tutorial (reading week) 10. Attitudes towards English 11. Teaching and learning Global Englishes 12. Issues related to Global Englishes 13. Issue: Global Englishes, ELF and language education 14. Issue: The power and politics of English 15. Issue: Commodification of English 16. Issue: English, globalization and popular culture 17. Issue: Englishization in higher education 18. Term paper submission

349793.objective: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to numerical methods and their application in solving scientific and engineering problems. 本課程旨在全面介紹數值方法及其在解決科學與工程問題上之應用。 Students will learn to translate real-world problems into mathematical models and apply various numerical algorithms for their solution. 學生將學習如何將實際問題轉化為數學模型，並應用各種數值演算法進行求解。 Key topics include mathematical modeling, error analysis, linear algebra, interpolation, approximation, numerical integration and differentiation, solving ordinary and partial differential equations, Monte Carlo methods, optimization, and an introduction to numerical methods in data science and high-performance computing. 主要內容包括數學建模、誤差分析、線性代數、內插法、逼近法、數值積分與微分、常微分與偏微分方程求解、蒙地卡羅方法、數值優化，以及數據科學與高效能計算中數值方法之簡介。 The course emphasizes hands-on experience through in-class programming sessions and utilizes online weeks for flexible learning. 本課程強調透過課堂程式設計實作獲得實務經驗，並利用線上教學週進行彈性學習。 課程重要事項 (Important Course Notes) Bilingual Instruction (雙語教學): This course will be conducted with materials and explanations provided in both English and Chinese to support diverse learning needs. 本課程將以中英文雙語提供教材與解說，以支持多元學習需求。 Language of Assessment (評量語言): Major assignments, presentations, and examinations are required to be completed in English. 主要作業、報告及考試需以英文完成。 Programming Sessions (程式設計實作課): This course includes several in-class programming sessions. 本課程包含數次課堂程式設計實作。 Active participation and completion of programming tasks are mandatory. 學生必須積極參與並完成程式設計作業。 Online Teaching Weeks (線上教學週): Specific weeks will be conducted online. 特定教學週將採線上教學。 Students are expected to engage with materials and activities as directed on the [LMS/Email/Course Website]. 學生應依循 [學習管理系統 (LMS)/ 電子郵件 / 課程網站] 之指示參與課程材料與活動。 Attendance Policy (出席規定): Students who are absent three (3) or more times (including programming sessions and online sessions where applicable) during the semester will automatically receive a failing grade for the course. 一學期內缺席三（3）次（含以上，適用於程式設計實作課與線上課程應參與部分）者，該課程成績以不及格計。(缺席三次不及格)

349827.objective: 本課程旨在全面介紹人工智慧（AI）的基礎知識與最新技術發展，涵蓋資料科學、機器學習、深度學習、自監督學習與自然語言處理等核心主題。學生將從 AI 的歷史與概念入門，逐步探索各種學習模型的理論基礎與實務應用，進而理解如注意力機制、生成對抗網絡（GAN）、大型語言模型（如 GPT）等前沿技術。 課程強調「理論與實作並重」，每週安排主題式教學，搭配實務操作與小組討論，以培養學生的問題解決能力、跨領域整合能力與實作經驗。學員將有機會使用如 Python 實作各類 AI 應用，並於課程末完成一項小組專題。 This course offers a comprehensive overview of the foundations and cutting-edge developments in Artificial Intelligence (AI), covering core topics such as data science, machine learning, deep learning, self-supervised learning, and natural language processing. Students will begin by learning the history and core concepts of AI, then progressively explore theoretical foundations and practical applications of various learning models, including advanced techniques such as attention mechanisms, generative adversarial networks (GANs), and large-scale language models like GPT. Designed with a strong balance of theory and hands-on practice, the course features weekly thematic modules combining lectures, coding exercises, and collaborative discussions. Students will gain essential skills in using tools like Python to develop real-world AI applications, culminating in a final group project.

349833.objective: This course introduces the methods essential to business research. The first focus is on research methods, particularly applied quantitative statistical analysis—interpreting results, as well as applying them to actual data. Students should become informed consumers of statistics—to be able to understand and assess the quality of statistical methods in the papers they read, and to use those methods in their research. The second focus is on research design and data collection methods, which will be essential to master’s dissertation, and practical business roles (such as consultant or market researcher). Students will participate in a project in which they have the chance to collect and analyze their data. The course is on fundamentals, up to multiple regression, so we will not have time to discuss more advanced statistical techniques. However, you should leave this class with a solid foundation for further education on these topics.

349838.objective: 策略管理主要是幫助高階管理階層作決策。一般而言，這門課為商學課程中的課程主要協助學員們具有整合能力。學員不只是在策略管理中應活學活用，也融合所學應用於管理決策中。此門課將幫助您學習、研讀個案和討論，這是此門課的目標。 1. 瞭解組織所處環境 2. 分析外部環境之時機和危機 3. 剖析內部組織之優劣勢 4. 探討企業不同層次之應對策略。 Strategic management deals with the decision making at the top management level. Traditionally, this course has been the capstone course in the business program and is taught at the last year of study so that students can integrate functional area knowledge into a coherent one. Students are expected not only to learn a body of knowledge on strategic management, but also to synthesize economics, accounting, and marketing as an aid top management level decisions. We will use a combination of readings, case studies, and lectures to achieve the goals of the course.

349840.objective: 面對各種數位化革新技術浪潮的衝擊，零售業者必須置入各項智能科技進行數位行銷與商業模式的開發，例如零售業者使用無人商店、智能支付系統、擴增 / 虛擬實境、元宇宙、物聯網 (IoT)、消費數據分析、人工智慧 (AI)、機器學習等先進技術，將傳統零售環境轉變為更智慧、更便捷、更個性化的消費體驗。甚至利用這些新興數位科技與和數據資源實踐零售業態的升級和轉型，進而不斷涌現出新型業態和新型商業模式的品牌體驗與管理。據此，本課程將以介紹當代智慧零售個案為主軸，介紹智慧零售實務的同時，也帶出其背後運作的主要理論基礎，藉此以促進實務與理論並重的學習效益。 Faced with the impact of various digital innovation waves, retailers must integrate various smart technologies to develop digital marketing and business models. For example, retailers use advanced technologies such as unmanned retail stores, smart payment systems, augmented/virtual reality, the metaverse, the Internet of Things (IoT), consumption data analysis, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning to transform the traditional retail environment into more intelligent, more convenient and more personalized consumption experience. Retailers use these emerging digital technologies and data resources to implement retail upgrading and transformation and then emerge with new business models for brand experience and management. Accordingly, this course will focus on introducing contemporary smart retail cases. Introducing smart retail cases will also bring out the main theoretical foundations, resulting in learning benefits that emphasize practice and theory.
