351221.objective: 課程目標: 本課程旨在建立學生於工程與應用科學領域中必備的數學工具能力，涵蓋常微分方程、拉普拉斯轉換與特殊函數等主題。透過對數學理論的講解與實例應用分析，提升學生處理實務工程問題之邏輯推理與數值解法能力，並培養其獨立建模與數值模擬的能力。 教學方法: 課程以「理論說明 + Matlab 實作演練」進行，授課教師於黑板上詳述數學公式推導後，搭配電腦實作展示如何利用 Matlab 工具進行模擬與解題。鼓勵學生攜帶筆記型電腦至課堂，現場操作程式碼，加強理解。課後亦提供程式範例，協助學生進行自主練習與應用延伸。 Course Objectives: This course aims to build students' ability to use mathematical tools necessary for engineering and applied sciences. It covers ordinary differential equations, Laplace transforms, and special functions. Through explaining mathematical theories and analyzing practical applications, students' logical reasoning and numerical solution abilities in dealing with practical engineering problems are enhanced, and their independent modeling and numerical simulation abilities are cultivated. Teaching Methods: The course is conducted as "theoretical explanation + Matlab practical exercises." The instructor explains the derivation of mathematical formulas on the blackboard and then uses practical computer exercises to demonstrate how to use Matlab tools for simulation and problem-solving. Students are encouraged to bring their laptops to class and practice programming on-site to enhance their understanding. After class, programming examples are also provided to help students conduct independent practice and application extension.

351227.objective: 基本控制系統的動作方式、位置控制、比例控制、積分控制、微分控制、各種組合控制、氣壓控制裝置、電動及電子控制裝置、液壓控制裝置、空調設備上的各種控制包括溫度、壓力、風量、濕度等之控制。 To provide students with the concepts of control actions: two position control, proportional control, floating control, integral control, derivative control; to familiarize students with pneumatic control devices, fluid control devices, damper & valves, elementary control systems on HVAC & R systems, include: temperature control, humidity control, static pressure control, flow control and so on.
351227.schedule: 1 自動控制理論發展 2 自控系統設計實例 3 Laplace Transform 4 自動控制系統穩定度分析 5 自動控制系統性能分析 6-7 Evolutionary Algorithm 8 期中考 9-10 Expert System 10-11 Distinguish AI 11-12 Predictive AI 12-13 Generative AI 14-17 分組報告 18 期末考
351227.score_policy: 分組報告 50% + 期中考 20% + 期末考 30%
351227.materials: 1. 自編講義與已發表 SCI 期刊研究內容說明 2. 基礎理論說明使用 Richard, C. Dorf., Modern Control Systems, ADDISON-WESLEY, 1991. 3. 冷凍空調節能方面，台灣日立空調公司開發 AI 控制邏輯導入分離式空調節能案例說明，可透過 Fuzzy control、Genetic Algorithm-optimized control 與 Model-based Predictive Control (MPC)，搭配變頻器與電子膨脹閥等底層裝置，進行智慧控制。 4. 儲能與建築智慧能源管理方面，包括 AI 於建築節能與能源負載削減的應用。本人主導將 MPC 與 Fuzzy Control 應用於四棟大型建築與 26 個非生產性質用電場域（百貨賣場等），平均可達 35% 即時電力削峰成效，進行相關研討說明。 5. 本人所發展的 AI implementation framework 是目前產學界導入 AI 能源應用的重要參考架構，以實際案例說明。 6. 於高耗能工業製程方面，聚焦於 AI 智慧燃燒控制技術的應用，針對工業鍋爐與垃圾焚化爐等高污染高碳排設備，說明 AI 空燃比即時調整系統。
351227.consultation: 每周一次 (時間上課時公告) 3 小時至工綜 610 室諮詢
351227.remarks: 以實際案例說明 Evolutionary Algorithm、Expert System、Distinguish AI、Predictive AI and Generative AI 應用於冷凍空調與節能控制之發展，並要求學生分組進行報告，報告鼓勵使用付費之生成式 AI 工具。

351267.objective: 在本課程中，我們將探討教育訓練的各種實施方法，並系統性介紹不同的績效評鑑模型與其理論基礎。學生將學會如何判斷是否需要進行績效評鑑、應該在哪些階段進行評鑑，以及如何將評鑑結果連結至組織的整體策略目標與學習需求。課程強調理論與實務的結合，透過案例分析與實作練習，協助學生建立教育訓練規劃與成效評估的整體觀點。完成本課程後，學生將具備應用教育訓練實施策略與績效評鑑工具於實際工作場域的知識與能力。

351283.objective: 本課程主要探討高分子在溶液及固態時的物理化學現象及其應用。內容包括熱力學、高分子的微結構及定性。 熱力學探討統計熱力學、晶格理論、Flory-Huggin 理論、Flory-Krigbaum 理論、相分離、θ- 溫度、滲透壓、GPC 測分子量、高分子膠體。 高分子之微結構包括有高分子之形狀、自由旋轉分子鏈距離、光散射、中子散射、排拒體積、碎形、霍氏光譜及核磁共振儀在高分子微結構之分析。

351301.objective: 都市計畫是新興的學術，它是就特定地區有關都市生活之經濟、交通、衛生、保安、國防、文教、康樂等重要設施作有計畫的發展，並對土地使用作合理的規劃、開發與管制。其內容涵蓋建築物配置、住宅建設、土地使用分區、公共設施與交通路線規劃、開放空間管理與景觀設計、財務籌措與產業發展等。因此，都市計畫是提供一個都市長遠發展的藍圖，在時空上無論從單棟建築的興建乃至新社區、新市鎮的開發、舊市區的更新及各項公共設施的興闢，均須以都市計畫為藍本，所以都市計畫影響環境品質與居民生活福祉甚鉅。 為因應氣候變遷、保育自然環境與維護人文資產、促進資源與產業合理配置，都市計畫在觀念、作法、行政體制以及實質發展都必須與時俱進。先進國家的都市計畫皆以公共利益為依歸，為從事建築、景觀建築、都市設計、都市計畫、土木、營造、環境規劃與管理工作者必修的學科。 本課程目的在了解最新國際思潮影響與創新做法，檢視國內獨特的社會人文與都市計畫議題，如何參採先進國家制度與經驗，將理論應用在實務，作有系統的介紹與評論。修讀本課程可瞭解都市成長、規劃思想、政策發展、規劃體制變革歷程與經驗、永續理論應用與實務案例、國際與在地都市計畫挑戰、對策與發展。
351301.schedule: （一）都市計畫導論、理論與實務之間 （二）都市規劃思潮與最新規劃理論及實務介紹 （三）權利與公平觀點論都市計畫公共干預的本質 （四）法制、體系與規劃實施 （五）民眾參與與政策規劃 （六）土地使用與規劃許可 （七）都市公共設施規劃與維護管理 （八）協議與都市開發、集約緊湊都市 （九）都市永續規劃與環境心理、健康都市 （十） 都市永續規劃與古蹟維護保存 （十一）都市發展與休閒遊憩規劃、綠色都市 （十二）新鎮（社區）開發與管理、智慧城市 （十三）都市更新與再發展、循環都市 （十四）都市環境與防災、救災、調適、韌性城市 （十五）都市經營管理與行銷、宜居都市 （十六）學生研究報告或閱讀心得報告

351313.objective: 台灣建築就其文化特質而論，可依族群區分成南島族群文化、閩客移民族群文化及外國殖民族群文化，其內容廣泛地包括前述建築所屬的自然地理環境、社會組織、宗教信仰及象徵體系等議題。本課程即在以傳統建築領域的南島文化及閩客文化為對象進行討論，課程首先就傳統社會、傳統建築議題進行基礎理論探討。其後再以原住民社會所屬的南島建築，及閩客移民所建立的漢人建築和聚落為題，藉由建築反映的自然地理環境、產業經濟、社會組織、匠師體系等建築文化，綜合論述其文化涵構與特色。本課程目的期使修課同學除了對台灣傳統建築、空間有所認識外，亦對其所屬的社會文化意義有所體認。

351360.objective: This course will acquaint students with fundamental concepts and principles of professional translation. Students will acquire a solid grounding in a range of ideas within translation studies (e.g. linguistic and functionalist approaches, discourse and register analysis, translation norms, cultural turn, sociology of translation, and translation technologies) and apply the theoretical knowledge to various English and Chinese translation activities. This course will also enable students to critically discuss the basic postulates of translation theories and use them in text analysis, the identification of translation problems, and the formulation of suitable strategies and techniques.

351364.objective: 不同文化之間的對話需要故事的講述。了解一種文化的故事有助於人們了解這種文化並與其人民交談。有時，一種文化會借用另一種文化的故事，或者寫一個關於彼此文化碰撞的故事。(例如，關於亞洲的美國故事，或關於美國的亞洲故事)。為了幫助學生與來自其他文化的人們談論重要的思想，本課程研究跨文化共享故事以及一種文化講述其他文化的故事。 Conversation between different cultures requires the description of stories. Knowing a culture’s stories helps one to understand that culture and talk with its people. Sometimes a culture borrows a story from another culture or writes a story about its encounter with that other culture. (For example, American stories about Asia or Asian stories about America). To help students talk about important ideas with people from other cultures, this course examines stories shared across cultures and stories one culture tells about another.

351385.objective: 先修課程：負責教授同意 表面現象，介面反應等與近代高科技技術，如鍍膜工程，表面處理，腐蝕，磨潤，微機電，感測器，半導體技術等息息相關，且日益重要。表面分析是原子層次的相關研究，它包括振動，電子或離子頻譜分析，微技術等之應用。主要的項目包含，表面形貌觀察 (SEM, BSEM, AFM), 成份分析 ( 光譜分析，質譜分析，EDX ), 結構分析 ( XRD, AES, ESCA, XPS ), 鍵結分析 ( Raman 光譜，FTIR ), 表面粗糙度，膜厚，附著力，內應力等膜之特性分析。

351407.objective: 本課程涵蓋廣泛之工業 4.0 - 智能化生產所需相關基礎技術，包括工業革命簡史、人工智慧演算法、物聯網基礎技術與應用實例、雲端服務系統與資訊安全技術、巨量資料管理、分析、及應用實例、智慧化企業與工廠管理系統與應用、自動化與機器人技術及應用等等。
351407.schedule: 週次 單元主題 第一週 智能化生產簡介 / 四次工業革命簡史與內容，工業四點零概論：互聯網、物聯網、巨量資料 (大數據)、雲端運算、人工智慧、自動化與機器人。 第二週 人工智慧的過去與現在：三次人工智慧熱潮、決策樹、專家系統、類神經網路，運用與困境。 第三週 當代人工智慧原理：巨量資料的影響、深度學習、開源程式 TensorFlow、Keras 簡介。 第四週 物聯網基礎技術與應用: 物聯網基礎架構概論：物聯網基本詞彙定義 / 物聯網協定層架構 / 物聯網功能及技術現況與發展方向。軟硬體設計與整合規劃：各式感測器與基本原理 / 網路層技術與相關標準 / 應用層技術與相關標準 第五週 物聯網基礎技術與應用: 智能化工廠應用實例：創新生產模式 / 物聯網導入生產之優劣點與特色分析 第六週 雲端服務系統與資訊安全技術: 雲端基礎設施架構：基本架構與名詞定義；雲端服務與應用：三大服務模式型態與特性 / 三大服務模式發展現況與願景 第七週 雲端服務系統與資訊安全技術: 資訊安全技術：資訊安全概論 / 雲端架構安全防護方法 第八週 巨量資料管理、分析、及應用: 巨量資料擷取、儲存、與管理：巨量資料檢索與擷取技術 / 資料儲存方式 / 巨量資料管理模式；巨量資料探勘與分析：巨量資料探勘意義與方法 / 巨量資料分析技術。 第九週 期中考 第十週 巨量資料管理、分析、及應用: 巨量資料應用實例：智慧應用原則 / 資料分析與推薦系統 第十一週 智慧化企業與工廠管理系統與應用: E 化製造系統架構: E 化製造系統構成要素與名詞定義 / E 化製造優劣分析 第十二週 智慧化企業與工廠管理系統與應用: 製造執行系統 (MES) 功能與應用：製造執行系統 (MES) 之定義與功能 / 製造執行系統 (MES) 之現有架構與發展方向 第十三週 智慧化企業與工廠管理系統與應用: 製造執行系統 (MES) 功能與應用：製造執行系統 (MES) 之優劣分析 第十四週 自動化與機器人技術與應用: 可程式邏輯控制器 (PLC): 可程式邏輯控制器 (PLC) 架構 / 可程式邏輯控制器 (PLC) 程式設計簡介；開源程式開發版介紹：Arduino,Rasberry Pi,…. 第十五週 自動化與機器人技術與應用: 智慧控制系統：模糊邏輯控制器概論 / 類神經網路控制器概論。工業用機器人概論：工業用機器人分類與優劣分析 / 工業用機器人應用方法。 第十六週 自動化與機器人技術與應用: 機器人應用案例分析，機器人工業現況分析、各國機器人市場與產業分析。 第十七週 自動化與機器人技術與應用: 機器視覺原理與應用：機器視覺系統架構與工作原理 / 機器視覺技術生產應用方法。開源影像處理軟體簡介：OpenCV。 第十八週 期末考

351411.objective: 本課程主要在介紹人力資源與組織管理的進階理論與實務，內容包括了 (但不限於) 人才任用、訓練與發展、績效評估、薪酬管理、組織設計、領導、工作激勵、以及工作團隊運作等等重要議題。課堂上並討論上述理論對於管理實務上的意涵。 This course introduces many advanced topics of human resource management, organization theory, and organization behavior. 351431.objective: 本課程將採用理論講授與數據實作並行的方式，協助學生建立對顧客關係管理（Customer Relationship Management, CRM）之完整認識與實務操作能力。 首先將針對 CRM 之核心理念與在企業經營模式中的角色進行說明，說明 CRM 如何透過有效的顧客資料管理、客戶價值分析、互動溝通與體驗設計，提升企業營運績效與顧客忠誠度。課程初期將聚焦於顧客資料與行為分析，包含市場區隔、目標客群選擇、客戶價值評估與溝通策略等。藉由實際企業案例（如胖東來）來強化理論與應用連結。 中期課程將帶領學生實作問卷調查與 Google 表單設計，模擬蒐集顧客意見的流程，並進一步導入 SPSS 進行統計分析與報表產出，包括：交叉分析表、描述統計、t 檢定、變異數分析、迴歸分析與相關性分析等技術，以協助學生從數據中發掘有意義的行銷洞察。 後段課程將實作顧客區隔分析（如 RFM 模型）、顧客價值預測模型，輔助 CRM 決策，實踐以數據驅動的精準行銷策略。 本課程將強調實務與資料分析能力的養成，學生將能熟悉從顧客資料蒐集、分析到應用於行銷策略的完整流程，為日後進入精準行銷、顧客關係等領域打下良好基礎。 --- This course combines theoretical lectures with data practice to help students gain a comprehensive understanding of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and practical skills. It begins by explaining CRM's core concepts and its role in business models, focusing on how CRM enhances operational performance and customer loyalty through effective data management, customer value analysis, interactive communication, and experience design. Early lessons emphasize customer data and behavior analysis, including market segmentation, target audience selection, customer value assessment, and communication strategies, reinforced by real-world cases like Fat Dong Lai. In the mid-term, students will design questionnaires and Google Forms to simulate collecting customer feedback, followed by statistical analysis using SPSS, covering cross-tabulation, descriptive statistics, t-tests, ANOVA, regression, and correlation analysis to uncover marketing insights from data. Later, the course introduces Python’s scipy and sklearn modules for programmatic statistical analysis and machine learning, guiding students through customer segmentation (e.g., RFM model) and value prediction models (e.g., KNN, logistic regression, SVM) to support CRM decisions with AI tools and enable data-driven precision marketing. The course focuses on building practical and analytical skills, equipping students with the full process of collecting, analyzing, and applying customer data to marketing strategies, laying a strong foundation for careers in marketing, data analysis, and customer relations.
351431.schedule: 第 1 週：課程介紹 CRM 概述 第 2 週：客戶資料管理，與市場區隔與目標客戶選擇 第 3 週：客戶價值與忠誠度管理 第 4 週：客戶互動與溝通管理 第 5 週：實作：傳統手機客戶數據方法：Google 客戶問卷調查表單 第 6 週：實作：Google 客戶問卷調查表單的製作的 10 種特殊技巧 第 7 週：實作：SPSS 的單一樣本 t 檢定 第 8 週：實作：SPSS 的成對樣本 t 檢定 第 9 週：期中考 第 10 週：實作：SPSS 的單變數卡方檢定 第 11 週：數位時代的 CRM，CRM 系統選型與實施 第 12 週：CRM 的績效評估與改進，客戶體驗管理 第 13 週：實作：SPSS 的獨立樣本 t 檢定 第 14 週：實作：SPSS 的單因子變異數分析，ANOVA 第 15 週：實作：SPSS 的相關性研究：探討 2 個變數之間的相關性 第 16 週：實作：SPSS 的迴歸分析 第 17 週：實作：顧客區隔 RFM 的分群預測，可找出不同的目標客群，然後做差異性行銷 第 18 週：期末考

351545.objective: 教學大綱：簡介作業研究 Systems Analysis 中的各式優選工具，並學習混沌理論。以生態族群的 Growth and Decay 模式為例，初窺混沌世界的奇妙，以提供往後解決問題時有不同的思考方向。混沌理論應用在物理、經濟、生物、數學的領域上，處理數百年來許多無法看透的問題有不錯進展 (包括紊流現象)，在環境領域上的應用則尚待開拓。只要處理的系統 (問題) 具有自我相似性，以混沌來處理是可行的。(課程中將視時間教進階數學軟體 Mathematica.) Explore Chaos Theory from the Models of Growth and Decay (Simple Logistic Model, Logistic Model with Carrying Capacity, Logistic Model with Carrying Capacity and Migration). Introduce important factors of Chaotic Behavior: Dynamics of species, Critical Reproduction Rate, Bifurcation, Butterfly effect. Examples of Chaotic behavior: Single Species System, Two Species Competition System, Two Species Predator-Prey System.
351545.schedule: 1. 優選工具簡介 Mathematic tools for system analysis  線性規劃  時間序列、啟發式演算法、類神經網路、灰色理論 / 模糊理論  賽局理論、小世界理論 2. Models of Growth and Decay  Simple Logistic Model  Logistic Model with Carrying Capacity  Logistic Model with Carrying Capacity and Migration 3. Chaotic 混沌 Behavior (week 3 交 HW1)  Dynamics of species  Critical Reproduction Rate  Bifurcation 4. Examples of Chaotic behavior  Single Species System  Two Species Competition System  Two Species Predator-Prey System 5. Butterfly effect 蝴蝶效應. Deterministic or Random? (week 5 交 HW2) 6. Final Exam;

351599.schedule: 由於近年來人工智慧與大數據應用的蓬勃發展，新興的 Python 程式語言成為全世界學習程式語言的首要標的。相較於編譯式 (compiled language) 程式語言（例如，C/C++/Java），Python 程式語言是一種完全開源費且程式語法具備可讀、簡潔及直觀特性的直譯式 (interpreted language) 程式語言。本課程教學在於 Python 程式設計基礎學習及其物件導向程式 (Object-Oriented Programming, OOP) 撰寫教學。經由本課程教學，同學對於未來使用 Python 至各個工程應用領域將會有相當大的助益。 * 本課程需攜帶筆電至課堂程式實作（若無安排電腦教室） 週次 單元 1 課程介紹 (課程內容適時適性彈性調整) 2 Python 介紹 3 資料型態與運算 4 資料型態與運算與流程控制敘述 5 流程控制敘述 6 Python 函式 7 檔案處理 8 NumPy 陣列結構處理 9 期中考週 10 NumPy 陣列結構處理 11 Pandas 數據結構處理 12 Pandas 數據結構處理 13 類別與繼承 14 套件與模組 15 數據分析範例 16 機器學習範例 17 機器學習範例 18 期末考週

351623.objective: 本課程之目標在於從科學哲學層次、研究方法層次、與實際操作層次探討設計研究的本質，內容包括界定設計研究問題、選用適當的量化或質性研究方法與特定工具、研究結果詮釋、案例解析、以及論文寫作等，俾使同學具備研究之基礎觀念以及進行創作或理論論文寫作之能力。研究方法一強調量化研究，課程內容包含研究的基本概念、文獻探討、研究問題、研究變項、研究假設、研究設計、資料蒐集與分析、研究工具、研究樣本、研究倫理與研究論文撰寫等。教學以課堂講授與論文研討與發表為主要方式，並以隨堂測驗、報告與分組討論與發表為評量依據。 The aims of this course are to explore the nature of design research at the three various levels of scientific philosophy, research methods, and pr92tical execution. The contents involve the introduction of defining the design problems, selecting the quantitative or qualitative research methods and specific instruments, interpretation of research results, case studies, as well as writing a thesis. This research methods one focus on quantitative research that content details includes fundamental concept of research, literature review, research problem, research variables, research hypothesis, research design, data collection and analysis, research instruments, research samples, research ethics and writing up. The te92hing methods include lectures, paper discussion and presentation based on the course assessment of assigned project, panel discussion and individual/group presentation.

351624.objective: 本課程規劃的目標為以互動設計的理論為基礎，實務導向為原則，使學習者能將學術界的理論與產業界的實務加以結合以充實對於互動設計具有全面性的了解。學習的內容包含互動設計系統構成要素、理論與實務基礎、互動設計方法與技術、科技支援與應用、認知心理、情境設計以及電腦支援協同合作等單元，各單元並包含不同互動設計個案的研討，使理論能與實務進行驗證。 The course aims to develop broad understanding on interaction design for students, based on theory and practice course structure. Course topics include essential factors of interactive system, interaction design theory and practice, interaction design methods and techniques, technical support and application, cognitive psychology, and scenario design.

351625.objective: 本課程之目標在於研討互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究，或是透過互動媒體設計個案研討、互動媒體設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。

With panel discussion, research report and design practice, graduate students can be able to learn the ability of research, analysis and pr92tice by effectively exchange opinions and personal experience. The aim of graduate of interactive media design is to integrate different disciplines from computer science, mechatronics, human-culture and design and art so as to foster the professional of interactive media design. Therefore, one of the aims of this course is to construct multi-disciplines learning environment which perform a topic-oriented study model. This study model formulates the graduate students of design, art, information and mechatronic disciplines to collaborate an interactive media design project. It may execute interactive media design by working with the form of case study or design creation.

351627.objective: 互動設計可視為三大傳統設計領域：平面設計、工業設計，與建築設計的延伸。在許許多多延伸出來的新設計領域如 UI、UX、響應式網頁、互動產品、智慧空間等等，圖像依舊是所有設計在發想、討論，與實現設計上所仰賴的根本工具。本課程以圖像為設計語言的架構下，介紹由圖像所發展出來的數位生產線，以模組技術介紹互動設計在設計發想、原型製作，以至到設計討論與提案所需要之圖像技術，並鼓勵學生以一設計提案來總結課堂之所學。

351704.objective: 本課程主要在介紹高階管理的理論與實務。將透過學校老師與企業高階管理者與學生一起探討當前管理重要議題。本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。 This course focuses on the introduction and discussion of theories and practices of contemporary management topics. Besides university professors, renowned top manager will be invited to share the best practice experiences of the workplace in the lecture. The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.

351705.objective: 在管理決策中，要如何做行銷管理才能使得公司的產品賣得出去並增加公司收入。要如何做資金管理才能使得公司可以正常營運並將資金做適當的管理決策配置。透過國內外相關公司案例的討論，讓學生可以瞭解消費者行為、市場區隔、產品策略、通路、數位 (含 AI) 行銷等議題，以及對財管的投資、融資、營運資金、公司理財等議題有進一步的理解，讓高階經理人可以有更全面的策略營運方針。 In management decisions, how should marketing management be conducted to ensure that a company's products sell and increase company revenue? How should financial management be handled to ensure the company operates smoothly and makes appropriate management decisions regarding the allocation of funds? Through discussions of relevant domestic and international company cases, students can gain an understanding of topics such as consumer behavior, market segmentation, product strategy, distribution channels, and digital (including AI) marketing, as well as develop a deeper understanding of financial management topics like investment, financing, working capital, and corporate finance. This will enable senior managers to develop more comprehensive strategic operational guidelines.

351706.objective: 本課程主要在介紹高階管理的理論與實務。將透過學校老師與企業高階管理者與學生一起探討當前管理重要議題。本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。 This course focuses on the introduction and discussion of theories and practices of contemporary management topics. Besides university professors, renowned top manager will be invited to share the best practice experiences of the workplace in the lecture. The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.

351712.objective: 本課程旨在深入介紹統計技術和最佳化概念，藉以輔助管理之決策。課程涵蓋統計學及最佳化相關主題，包括描述性統計、相關分析、抽樣和估計、概率分布、假設檢驗、回歸模型、實驗設計和線性規劃。通過課程學生還將獲得統計和最佳化軟件（如 LINGO 和 Excel）的實際操作經驗。修習課程之學生將具備應用統計和最佳化工具處理實務問題之技能和知識，使其能夠基於數量方法之做出決策及管理。 This course aims to offer an in-depth understanding of statistical techniques and optimization concepts for making informed management decisions. The course provides a comprehensive overview of key topics in statistics, including descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, sampling and estimation, probability distributions, hypothesis testing, regression models, design of experiments, and linear programming. Students will also gain practical experience in statistical and optimization software such as LINGO and Excel through interactive tutorials. On completion of this course, students would be able to equip with the skills and knowledge needed to apply statistical and optimization tools to real-life situations, allowing them to make informed decisions based on quantitative methods.
351712.schedule: 1. Descriptive statistics and related charts 2. Statistical software (Minitab/Excel) tutorial 3. Linear Programming and combinatorial optimization 4. Optimization software (LINGO/Excel) tutorial
351712.materials: Barry, R., Ralph, M., & Hanna, M. E. (2018). Quantitative analysis for management. 13e Hillier, F. S., & Lieberman, G. J. (2019). Introduction to operations research. 11e

351713.objective: 本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。 目的二，進一步教授 ESG 及聯合國 SDGs 指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。 最後，透過對於 ESG 與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力 The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations. The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies. Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

351741.objective: 公司治理已成為廿一世紀企業組織架構調整之重大議題，如何經由管理策略及法制設計使台灣企業經營回歸股東長期價值及利益，為政府、交易所與公會等自律機關、及企業經營者必須面對之問題。在法制上，獨立董事監察人、審計委員會之設置、公司自律守則之擬議、股東會之運作，均衝擊我國公司法、證券交易法及交易所規則現行管理架構及規範；在實務上，上市櫃公司如何順利接受公司治理之理念及管理規範，以提昇公司營運的外在評價與體質。 The corporate governance had been the enterprise framework adjustment of the main issue of the 21 century. How do the manage the corporate strategy and system of the law to make the profit for the shareholder, government and enterprise. The main purpose of the course to help the learner to understand the law of corporate and the practice of the enterprise.

351741.objective: 公司治理已成為廿一世紀企業組織架構調整之重大議題，如何經由管理策略及法制設計使台灣企業經營回歸股東長期價值及利益，為政府、交易所與公會等自律機關、及企業經營者必須面對之問題。在法制上，獨立董事監察人、審計委員會之設置、公司自律守則之擬議、股東會之運作，均衝擊我國公司法、證券交易法及交易所規則現行管理架構及規範；在實務上，上市櫃公司如何順利接受公司治理之理念及管理規範，以提昇公司營運的外在評價與體質。 The corporate governance had been the enterprise framework adjustment of the main issue of the 21 century. The main purpose of the course to help the learner to understand the law of corporate and the practice of the enterprise.

351745.objective: 本課程在使學生了解各種不同的資訊科技 (Information Technology) 與管理資訊系統間的關連性，並實際應用所教授的 IT 技術進行學術研究。藉由 IT 技術的應用演練，讓學生將實際進行問題分析、模型發展、系統開發、模擬實驗及最後的研究結論與模型驗證。提升學生獨立思考與解決問題之能力，培養科學的態度與學術研究的知識。本課程能夠： 1. 學生俱備基礎數據分析能力 2. 能夠將所學應用於生活中決策問題輔助

351749.objective: 策略管理主要是幫助製造業與服務業高階管理者作決策。一般而言，這門課程主要協助學員們具有策略思維與整合能力。學員可在策略管理學習過程活學活用，更能融合所學應用於管理決策中。此門課也採用適當的製造業與服務業個案研討來幫助學員學習、研讀與熟悉策略管理的運作，以達成此門課的目標。授課主題包括研討策略管理的本質與整體架構，瞭解組織所處環境 ， 分析外部環境之時機和危機， 剖析內部組織之優劣勢 ， 探討企業不同層次之應對策略，整合策略的執行與治理等。 Strategic management deals with the decision making in manufacturing and service industry at the top management level. Generally, this course provides students with strategic thinking and knowledge integration. With case studies in manufacturing and service industry, this course also helps students learn, study, and understand the process of strategic management well to achieve the goals of the course. Topics in this course include the essence and whole framework of strategic management, in what circumstances an organization has been, analyses on the opportunities and threats of external environment, the strengths and weaknesses of internal organization, application strategies of companies at different levels, implantation on integration strategies and so forth.

351750.objective: 本課程設計為讓初學者了解並能分析在現今市場環境下，企業所面臨的財務問題。課程涵蓋企業資本評價的基本模型，包含企業金融資產的定價模式、實體資產評價與投資專案分析、資本結構分析，以及其他企業在資金管理與財務規劃預測的相關議題。另外，為了讓企業經理人了解衍生性金融商品，本課程亦以深入淺出方式介紹選擇權之基本觀念、交易實務與決策應用。本課程目的在讓參與者對『財務決策對公司表現和價值的影響』有更深刻的認識，培育理論與實務兼備之財務管理人才 The course develops theoretical framework for understanding and analyzing major financial problems of modern company in market environment. The course covers basic models of valuation of corporate capital, including pricing models for primary financial assets, real assets valuation and investment projects analysis, capital structure and various types of corporate capital employed, derivative assets and contingent claims on assets. In addition, in order to let corporate managers understand the derivatives, this course introduces the basic concept of option, transaction practice and decision-making applications. The purpose of this course is to provides knowledge in evaluating different management decisions and its influence on corporate performance and value, so as to cultivate financial management talents with both theoretical knowledge and practical skills.

351754.objective: 本課程教導學生對製造業與服務業進行精實化管理的策略與技巧。課程內容包含：造成大型企業倒閉的商務環境改變與組織內的問題；科技提昇與電子化管理對企業的衝擊；精實化企業中有效及具競爭力營運管理的要素；精實化管理的發展策略與技巧。探討競爭優勢與生產服務系統模式、經營模式之關連，包括大量客製化、競爭優勢階段性、 發展競爭優勢作為、 豐富顧客價值。本課程將使學員熟習各項品質管理的理論基礎與發展趨勢，強化理論研究與實務應用能力。首先，課程涵蓋基礎統計使學員具備研究方法與分析技術能力，了解收集、統整和分析資料。其次，討論量化的六標準差管理相關工具及專案推行流程，以系統化思維探討問題並提出有效可行的解決對策，持續提升品質及客戶滿意。最後，介紹制度面及組織管理面的全球品管概念，闡述創造魅力品質之重要理論模型及影響服務品質關鍵因素。 This course covers the strategies and techniques of managing a lean business in manufacturing and in service. The linkages between competitive advantages and production systems, competitive advantages and business models will be discussed first. Then, topics include mass customization, competitive advantage stages, developing competitive capability and maximize customer value. This class will help students familiarize themselves with the trend of theoretical basis of the quality management and strengthen their ability in both theoretical research and practical application. First, the course covers basic statistics so that students will be acquainted with research methods and analysis techniques. Second, the six sigma management tools will be reviewed and the process for its implementation will also be addressed. Finally, the system- and the organization-level quality as well as the Kano Model for attractive quality will be discussed.

351757.objective: 本課程在使學生了解各種不同的資訊科技 (Information Technology) 與管理資訊系統間的關連性，並實際應用所教授的 IT 技術進行學術研究。藉由 IT 技術的應用演練，讓學生將實際進行問題分析、模型發展、系統開發、模擬實驗及最後的研究結論與模型驗證。提升學生獨立思考與解決問題之能力，培養科學的態度與學術研究的知識。本課程能夠： 1. 學生俱備基礎數據分析能力 2. 能夠將所學應用於生活中決策問題輔助

351757.objective: 隨著雲端運算服務的廣為使用及網際網路服務的發展，我們已經處於大數據時代，如何處理與儲存大數據、如何從大數據中，探勘有用的知識，成為近年來熱門的研究議題。本課程內容尚包括如何處理與分析大數據、如何更進一步從大數據分析發展市場行銷與顧客關係管理策略，大數據各種案例實務探討等。

351762.objective: 這門課程將深入探討 ESG 概念及其在國際趨勢中的地位，包括 CBAM、CCA、TCFD 等法規，亦將闡述國際評比、CSRD、IFRS S1/S2 等要求，以及國內主管機關的法規，尤其關於公司治理藍圖的要求。透過工作坊形式，我們將聚焦氣候變遷和財務相關揭露的重點，並以案例分享產業實務。從國際法規如 SB253、CBAM 到國際標準 ISO 20400，我們也將討論供應鏈管理和永續採購的趨勢。此外，將涵蓋人權相關議題，如 TIFD 和 DEI，以及永續報告書撰寫注意事項。最後，我們將介紹永續金融和責任投融資，並討論金融業永續法規對企業的影響。 This course explores ESG concepts and global trends like CBAM, CCA, and TCFD. We'll cover international ratings, CSRD, IFRS S1/S2, and domestic regulatory requirements, focusing on corporate governance. Through workshops and case studies, we'll highlight climate change and financial disclosures. We'll discuss supply chain management trends, ISO 20400, and human rights issues like TIFD and DEI. Additionally, we'll cover sustainability reporting guidelines and introduce sustainable finance and responsible investment, examining their impact on businesses and financial regulations.

351765.objective: 本課程專注在探討全球組織經營策略與領導決策之關鍵議題，聚焦在不同時空的國際經營環境中，企業經營者如何因應政府的政策與財經情勢改變，能夠快速回應與彈性應變的領導思維與決策。透過本課程將能夠理解高階主管面對政經環境的調整能有效因應變化，並且提升領導才能與創造市場優勢之創新能力。 The course focuses investigate the global organization's management strategies and leadership decision of the key issues. It is focusing in the different time frames and fierce international environment, how changes in policy of governments and situation of economic. Business executives will be able to quick to respond with the elastic strain of the global strategy perspective and leadership thinking. This course will be able to understand top managers can achieve the decision making of leadership, and improve the leadership knowledge and innovation capabilities in market competition.

351768.objective: 由於產業環境辦化及科技創新速度，影響企業之營運模式。本課程旨在針對因應產業 / 工業 4.0 調整，課中會針對企業經營模式變革與產業 / 工業 4.0 產業生態鏈變革探討。 除了理論解析外，本課程並輔以企業實務個案研討。 Due to the change of industry environment and the speed of technological innovation, the business models of enterprise are impacted. The purpose of this course will study the transform of business model and the impact of Industry 4.0 on the ecosystem of industry. In the course, besides the theory will be included, the business practices case will be also covered.

351770.objective: 在現今產業激烈競爭與利潤微薄之階段，落實執行 "突破創新" 以增加競爭力之唯一生存之道，但鮮少有企業真正瞭解與實際地徹底執行它。不僅工程或服務技術要創新，管理思維更要突破創新，以有效迅速解？錯綜複雜的研發、工程與管理之諸多矛盾問題。本課程以創新構思問題解？法 (TRIZ) 為基礎，詳細介紹工程技術如何落實創新與管理實務創新如何執行。本課程適用於自有品牌業者、ODM 或 OEM 製造業者、服務業者與學術單位教學研究，特點如下：完整詳實闡述 TRIZ 理論並輔以大量簡單案例說明 TRIZ 概念、工程 TRIZ 實務案例 10 餘個與 TRIZ 工程與管理之參數與創新原則說明簡例約 800 餘個，管理實務案例 20 餘個，包含研發管理、服務業管理、專案管理與生產管理等。案例與簡例最多，創新執行力可快速上手與實施應用。本課程 TRIZ 研發、工程與管理兼顧，製造業與服務業高層、中層與基層員工皆符合讀者條件，使 "突破創新" 輕易實務執行並成為企業文化，亦適用於大學與研究所之工管、企管 (經營管理)、工商管與工程相關科系，可自行按需求選擇性深入教授講解某些章節，也替產業界事先磨練一群創新思維之活力新血，可長久伴隨您在職場 (或未來進入職場) 解決研發、工程與管理之困難矛盾問題。
351770.schedule: 1: 萃智導論與創新流程概觀 (2 小時) 2: 問題探討與機會辨識 (4 小時) 3: 技術 / 物理矛盾與發明原則 (3 小時) (含 Matrix + 軟體使用展示) 4: 衝突辨識與功能屬性分析 (3 小時) 5: 功能分析與修剪 (Trimming) (3 小時) 6: 演練與報告 (3 小時)

351774.objective: 本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。 本國語文課程以《世說新語》為主要文本，這部由南朝劉義慶編撰的經典筆記小說，內容涵蓋魏晉南北朝時期的逸聞軼事與人物風貌。通過閱讀、分析和討論，學生將深入了解魏晉風度、清談文化以及個人與社會價值觀的演變，並認識《世說新語》的文學價值及其對後世的影響。

351776.objective: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。 The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters, and 3 lecture hours per week.

351784.objective: 本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向， 並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名， 並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。 依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。 一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。 二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。 期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。 The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application. Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories. 1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity. 2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability. It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

351788.objective: 探討木材之物理及機械性質對於家具構造與製造品質之影響，並讓學生瞭解材料之組織構造以熟識家具用材之鑑定。終其目標在使學生認識材料進而善用材料。 介紹以木質材料為主之家具材料。內容含蓋木材之外觀特徵，組織構造，材料鑑識及其物理與機械性質對於家具構造和製造品質其間之關係等。 The macrostructure and microstructure of wood. Identification and uses of common Softwoods and Hardwoods. Physical and mechanical properties in relation to wood processing. Properties of other wood based materials such as particleboard, fiberboard, plywood, laminated wood related to their use in furniture manufacture also included.

351789.objective: 讓學生瞭解木材機器加工原理及最新工業用木工機器之種類，並使學生熟悉家具製造技術，特別是製造家具需要用到的各種設備之加工能力，及其作業特性和刀具要件等方面之知識與實務。 介紹家具製造過程中所需之各種機器設備之種類及其加工性能。不論及機器本身之設計問題，而側重於機械之應用；不研究一種機器所能做出之各種巧妙的加工方法，而在討論量產作業時，如何利用最合適之機器及加工方法所應採用之標準操作方式。 Survey of furniture manufacturing technology emphasizing mass production equipment and its relationship to furniture product engineering. The course is directed toward the efficient use of equipment in the production of large lots. In addition, the course does not concern itself with ingenious ways to do a maximum variety of operations on one machine; however, it is interested in presenting the best machine and method for standard production operations.

351791.objective: 介紹人體之形態特徵、心理期望、動作行為等人因知識，研究人因資訊應用於工業設計實務上之設計方法或準則以獲得具安全、效率與舒適之產品或環境設計。 This course is for students, researchers, and practitioners who design or evaluate products for their target user. It covers evaluation methodology for supporting human factor design for products, human-machine systems, software applications, games, and specialized appliances intended to be used by people. This field contains a substantial body of knowledge with regard to human factor design and the more narrowly scoped field of usability engineering (UE). Within these areas of practice, and the related research field of HCI, a host of methods are available for evaluating interactive products for user. This course provides an overview of a new and vibrant research field and exposes gaps in current methodologies that future research must address. We also hope it conveys our enthusiasm for this research area, where so much interesting work is taking place and so much still needs to be done.

351793.objective: 課程將習得順應 AI 設計的時代下，電腦 2D 影像編輯及繪圖軟體、排版在視覺設計、產品與空間設計等跨領域設計的多元表現技能。 隨著 AI 技術進步，圖像表現也在不斷演進。如何利用結合 AI 技術與圖像編輯技法具體呈現 AI 概念，會是新時代設計師的必備能力。 本課程以 Photoshop 為主要表現工具，illustrator 作為輔助工具角色，實現電腦視覺設計在概念溝通、圖像表達、造型發展、情境表現、之於 AＩ輔助溝通能力上的設計應用力。 The course will lead students to acquire the multi-expression application skills of computer 2D image editing and drawing software in the fields of visual communication, product and space design. As the era of AI generation arrives, the techniques for visual representation are continuously evolving. How to concretely present concepts through the collaboration of visual creation tools and AI is a challenge for designers in the new era Using Photoshop as the main expression software tool, realize the design application force of computer vision-aided design in concept communication, image expression, modeling development, and situational expression.

351795.objective: 課程講授家具結構之專業知識與應用技術，理論與實務並重。內容包括開發流程、產品工程、基本力學、木材特性、複合板特性、木材接合、機械扣件、框類家具結構特性、板類家具結構特性、層板家具結構特性等。 This course is introducing the knowledge and technique of furniture construction, both theory and practicing. 351801.objective: 本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向， 並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名， 並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。 依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。 一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。 二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。 期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。 The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application. Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories. 1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity. 2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability. It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

351804.objective: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1. 極限與連續，2. 導數及其應用，3. 不定積分與定積分，4. 超越函數及其反函數，5. 積分法則，6. 不定型與瑕積分，7. 定積分的應用，8. 空間幾何與向量微積分，9. 偏導數，10. 重積分。

351812.objective: 課程重點：(1) 藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2) 使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3) 熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4) 透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。 This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3) to familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4) to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

351813.objective: 本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向， 並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名， 並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。 依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。 一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。 二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。 期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。 The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application. Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories. 1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity. 2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability. It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

351825.objective: 如何藉由商務模型的分析，建置數位化協同產品設計與開發環境，並說明資料管理、構型管隨著網路時代的來臨，不但造成數位化協同產品設計與開發觀念的興起，也造成數位化協同平台技術逐漸成熟，並且將同步工程觀念的實現更往前邁進一大步。本課程是從數位化協同產品設計與開發概念之介紹開始，使學生明白數位化協同產品設計與開發在現代製造業中的重要性，接著介紹理與工作流程管理等相關實務應用觀念。 Information and network technologies have promoted the traditional concurrent engineering to the next generation. The collaborative e-design and e-development concept has been more popular in industries. This course is introduced from the concept of collaborative product design and development to help students understanding the importance of collaborative e-design and e-development in modern industries. Furthermore, the business model analysis method is provided to construct the collaborative environment of e-design and e-development. In addition, some real cases of data management, configuration management, and workflow management are mentioned.

351826.objective: 本課程由機械工程的角度出發，結合基礎電化學原理，介紹燃料電池的基本原理及種類，由最新市場發展現況導入，介紹燃料電池的發展歷史及最新現況，同時說明提升燃料電池效率及壽命的關鍵影響因素，結合實作方式深入了解燃料電池特性。 This course is based on the principle of mechanical engineering and electrochemical theory to introduce the basic principles and types of fuel cells. From the latest development in the global market, the course will introduce the fuel cell history and the latest products of fuel cells. The improvement of fuel cell efficiency and lifetime will be explained through fundamental theory and experiments.

351827.objective: 本課程主要在介紹綠色科技及其在二十一世紀對人類生活的影響，內容包括現今幾個最重要的「潔能」與「節能」科技，以及一些「環保」相關科技。「潔能科技」包括風力能、太陽能、水力能、地球內部能源、生質能、路面能、聲音能、燃料電池、電動車等；「節能科技」包括節能住宅、變頻空調等；「環保科技」則包括碳回收主題。介紹內容包括各項技術原理介紹及其發展概況。 This course aims to introduce green technologies and their influences on human life in the 21st century. The contents consist of the most important topics about the clean energy and energy conservation technologies. The clean energy technology consists of wind energy, solar energy, hydraulic energy, earth interior energy, bioenergy, roadway energy, sound energy, fuel cell, electric vehicles, and so on. The energy conservation technology consists energy save buildings, variable frequency air-condition, etc.. The environmental protesting technology includes carbon recapture etc.. This course will talk the technical principles and their general developing situations.

351829.objective: 本課程提供學生們一個可以改善他們的科技英文寫作技巧的環境，內容將包括：1. 扼要複習英文句型與文法，2. 撰寫論文常發生的錯誤，3. 分享論文審稿的經驗，4. 提供淺顯實用的寫作原則，5. 同儕分享讀論文與寫作的錯誤心得。 This course provides an environment to help students improving their English skill in writing technical paper or thesis. What will be included in the class are: 1. concise review of sentence structure and grammar, 2. frequent writing mistakes of paper or report, 3. share of the experience in paper review, 4. offering simple and practical writing principles, 5. share the experience in reading and writing papers.
351829.schedule: Week 1-2: Introduction to Technical Paper Writing Understanding the importance of technical paper writing Exploring various types of technical papers Week 3-4: Defining the Research and Establishing Objectives Formulating clear research questions and objectives Conducting a comprehensive literature review Identifying research gaps and contributions Week 5-6: Writing a Solid Introduction Developing a clear problem statement Outlining the paper's structure and organization Week 7-8: Writing the Methodology Section Describing research design and methodology Explaining data collection and analysis methods Week 9 : Midterm Exams Week 10-11: Presenting Results and Analysis Effectively displaying data using graphs, charts, and tables Interpreting results logically and objectively Week 12-13: Writing Discussion Summarizing key findings and implications Addressing limitations and suggesting future work Week 13-14: Enhancing Clarity and Coherence Improving sentence structure and word choice Ensuring logical flow between paragraphs and sections Week 15: Citations and Referencing Week 16: Peer Review and Feedback Exchanging papers for peer review Providing constructive feedback and suggestions Week 17: Finalizing and Proofreading Reviewing and editing the final draft Ensuring proper formatting and consistency Week 18: Final Group Presentations
351829.score_policy: Weekly writing assignments: 30% Midterm test: 30% Final presentation: 40%

351831.objective: To understand how Life Cycle Thinking and Life Cycle Management can solve environmental problems. Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), one of the most essential tools for analyzing and assessing environmental issues, will be taught during the semester. Students will also learn about the popular LCA software SimaPro. Various applications related to LCA, such as circular economy, net zero, carbon footprinting, carbon labeling, waste management, and eco-design, will also be practiced in the class.

LCA Software SimaPro Tutorial: Introduction and Practices (Make learning groups) 6. Methodology of LCA-II. Inventory analysis 7. Methodology of LCA-III. Methodology of Life Cycle Impact Assessment (LCIA) 8. Methodology of LCA- IV. Uncertainty, Sensitivity Analysis, and Interpretation 9. Mid-term Exam 10. Group report- LCA for one product or service 11. LCA Applications(I): Product and Process Ecodesign; Environmental Declarations and Carbon Labeling, etc. 12. Special Topic: CBAM and Carbon Footprinting, Carbon Labeling, Environmental Footprinting, and Material Flow Cost Accounting (MFCA) 13. Other Types of LCA (Eco-efficiency, MFCA, Social LCA, and Organizational LCA, etc.), and LCA Applications(II): Environmental Engineering Related Applications 14. Quantitative Performance Assessment for Circular Economy 15. Company Tour Visit (Taiwan Cement) 16. LCA Outlook and Latest Development: Net Zero and Biodiversity; Natural Capital Accounting 17. Team Project Presentation 18. Final Exam

351833.objective: 這門課主要是給開給博士生及二年級以上碩士生的課程，主要以課題式 (topics) 的討論，以及問題解決 (problem-solving) 為主，探討最新永續發展的新議題，以及可資應用的解決工具，討論將會以最新之期刊論文為主，內容探討的議題將包括 (不限)：系統思考與永續發展 (Systems Thinking and Sustainability)、企業永續治理 (Corporate Sustainable Governance)、綠色與永續創新 / 競爭力 (Green and Sustainable Innovation/Competitiveness)、繁茂昌盛 (Flourishing vs. Sustainability)、地球限度 (Planetary Boundaries for Sustainability)、B 團隊及 B 計畫 (B Team and Plan B)、社會面相之生命週期評估 (SLCA)、生命週期永續性評估及為永續發展目標的生命週期評估 (LCSA & LCA for SDGs)、金字塔底層及包容性企業 (Base of the Pyramid/ Inclusive Business)，其他議題。
351833.schedule: 週數 課程議題 課程主要內容 1. 系統思考與永續發展 (Systems Thinking and Sustainability) I 探討系統思考及其與永續發展的關連 2. 系統思考與永續發展 (Systems Thinking and Sustainability) II 學習系統思考的原理及系統動力模擬的建模，以及因果循環關係 3. 系統思考與永續發展 (Systems Thinking and Sustainability) III 學習如何透過系統思考及系統動力學的模擬，來解決永續發展的諸多的問題 4. 企業永續治理的新趨勢 (Corporate Sustainable Governance) I. 永續揭露與漂綠、利害關係人理論、人工智慧與治理 (AI and Corporate Governance) 5. 企業永續治理的新趨勢 (Corporate Sustainable Governance) II. 永續創新 (sustainable innovation)；多元、公平及融合 (Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, DEI) 及其爭議 6. 企業環境永續的新趨勢 (Corporate Environmental Sustainability) I. 地球限度 (Planetary Boundaries)、淨零 (Net Zero)、循環經濟 (circular economy) 7. 企業環境永續的新趨勢 (Corporate Environmental Sustainability) II. 自然與生物多樣性 (Nature and Biodiversity)；生態系統服務 (Ecosystem Services) 評估 8. 企業社會永續的新趨勢 (Corporate Social Sustainability) I. 金字塔底層 (Base of the Pyramid, BoP) 的發展及實踐 9. 企業社會永續的新趨勢 (Corporate Social Sustainability) II. 多元、公平及融合 (Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, DEI) 及其爭議 10. 專題：生命週期評估 (LCA) 的最新發展及重要議題 I. 動態生命週期評估 (Dynamic LCA)；前瞻性生命週期評估 (Prospective LCA) 11. 專題：生命週期評估 (LCA) 的最新發展及重要議題 II. 生命週期永續性評估及為永續發展目標的生命週期評估 (LCSA & LCA for SDGs) 12. 企業參訪 了解永續企業的實務 13. 學生研究分享及報告 (一) 14. 學生研究分享及報告 (二) 15. 學生研究分享及報告 (三) 16. 專題分組報告 (一) 繳交報告並分組上台報告 17. 專題分組報告 (二) 繳交報告並分組上台報告 18. 期末考 Take Home

Introduction to the basic concepts of the finite element analysis 2. Formulation of the finite models through the use of variational principles 3. Shape functions and isoparametric elements 4. One dimensional problems: rod, truss, beam, frame, etc. 5. Two dimensional problems: plane stress, plane strain and plate, etc. 6. Three dimensional problems: typical solids 7. Implementation of the FEM computation by computer 8. Finite element applications in dynamic problems 9. Survey of some finite-element software systems

351853.objective: 本課程主要在研討傳統的結構化語言的編譯技術。課程所所涵蓋的內容包括有： - 語句上的分析、語句分析器的製作 - 由上而下的組譯器製作 - 由下而上的組譯器製作 - 語意分析 - 機器碼之產生與暫存器之配置 - 資料流分析的理論與應用 - 程式碼最佳化處理。課程的實施，將以基本編譯技術為主，作深入的介紹。學習所得的觀念與技術，將利用一個實驗性語言編譯器的實作來貫穿。因此，程式規畫實作，將在這個課程中，佔有相當大的比重。 This course discusses issues in the compilation of conventional block-structured languages, as listed below. - lexical analysis, scanner generators; - top-down parsing, LL (1) parsers; - bottom-up parsing SLR, LALR, LR (1) parsers, parser generators; - semantic analysis; - code generation and register allocation, code generator generators; - dataflow analysis: theory and practice; - code optimization. There will be a significant programming component to the course
351853.schedule: Week 1: Introduction Week 2: x86-64 Assembly Language Week 3: TD Assembly Language Week 4: Abstract Syntax, Semantics and Interpreter in OCaml Week 5: TD Interpreter in Mini-Python Week 6: Lexical Analysis Week 7: Parsing: Syntax Analysis 1/2 Week 8: Parsing: Syntax Analysis 2/2 Week 9: TD Parsing -- Mini-Turtle Week 10: Static Typing Week 11: Parameter Passing Week 12: Compiler of Functional Language Week 13: Compiler of Object-Oriented Language Week 14: TD Code Production Week 15: Optimizing Compiler 1/2 Week 16: Optimizing Compiler 2/2 Week 17: Memory Allocation Week 18: Final Exam
351853.materials: You may find the corresponding materials to the lectures in the following books. 1. Alfred V. Aho, Monica S. Lam, Ravi Sethi et Jeffrey D. Ullman Modern Compilers: Principles, Techniques, and Tools. 2. Benjamin C. Pierce Types and Programming Languages 3. Randal E. Bryant et David R. O'Hallaron Computer Systems: A Programmer's Perspective Other relevant resources: - Nielson, Nielson, and Hankin. Principles of Program Analysis - Appel. Modern compiler implementation in ML (there are also Java/C versions) - Robert Harper. Practical Foundations for Programming Languages

351854.objective: 本課程旨在教授學生如何運用創意編程和視覺化電腦圖形技術，將資料及音訊數據轉換為可視化之 2D 或 3D 視覺內容，藉以增進資料及音訊之閱聽體驗。課程進行中，學生將習得多種基於演算法之視覺表現方式，以滿足設計層面中富含躍動感、平衡感以及美感之體驗需求，活用創意編程與新媒體技術來創建更生動、更具有影響 力的動靜態視聽影像。 This course aims to teach students how to utilize the knowledge from data science and computer graphics technology to represent data and audio into visualized 2D/3D representations, which gives rise to enhanced experiences of reading and listening. Students will learn a variety of programming skills to design visual representation based on algorithms to deliver dynamic, balanced and aesthetic experiences. With the help of creative coding and new media technology, more vivid and influential static and dynamic visual and audio experiences will be generated.

351860.objective: 講述鑄造學之基本原理，概念，以及實際應用技巧，基本原理上， 以材料的凝固解析學為主。包括：熱傳導及流動性等基本原理。應 用上包含金屬、非金屬、高分子等其他原材料之鑄造方法、技巧之 介紹。 It lectures the fundamental principles, concept and practical applied technique, basically speaking, it is mainly based on solidification and analytic process, which includes the fundamental principles of heat transfer and flowability. 351865.objective: 本課程以深入淺出之方式，介紹與機器學習之相關技術及演算法，目標是修習本課程之學生具有閱讀機器學習相關文獻之基本知識，並能從事相關之實務或電腦模擬實驗之工作，因此本課程著重在廣泛介紹各類之演算法之應用，而非深究少數演算法之深奧數學原理．本課程涵蓋之演算法，包含：最佳化基本知識，隨機最佳化演算法，隨機搜尋，決策樹，隨機森林，類神經網路及深度學習相關演算法，基因演算法，貝氏定理及應用，高斯混合模型，隱藏式馬可夫鍊 (及訓練演算法，支援向量機，線性及邏輯回歸，分群方法，降維方法，提升方法，決策融合技巧，及增強式學習等． This introductory course covers most of the techniques and algorithms related to the current trend in the machine learning field. The goal of this course is that students complete this course can read and understand the literature in the machine learning field, and can conduct computer simulations for experiments or apply the techniques to practical problems. Therefore, this course intends to cover a broad range of algorithms with emphasis on applications, rather than to cover only a few algorithms with extensive mathematical treatments. The algorithms covered in this course include: foundations of optiminizations, random search, decision tree, random decision forests, neural networks and deep learning, genetic algorithm, Bayes' theorem and its applications, Gauss mixture model, hidden Markov model (with its training algorithm), support vector machine, linear and logistic regressions, clustering algorithms, dimension reduction techniques (LDA, PCA, ICA, FA), boosting methods, decision
351865.schedule: Week 1: Class Announcement Week 2: Introduction to Machine Learning Week 3: Basics of Supervised Learning (Classification and Regression) Week 4: VC dimension, Bayesian Decision Theory, Naive Bayes Classifiers Week 4: Dimension Reduction Techniques: PCA, FA, LDA, ICA Week 5: Unsupervised learning: Clustering Algorithm (k-means) Week 6: Decision Trees, Bagging Algorithm (Random Forest) Week 7: Basics of optimization Week 8: Basics of Optimization Week 9: Gradient Search Week 10: Feedforward Neural Networks Week 11: Multi-layer Perceptrons, Back Propagation, Regularization Methods Week 12: Deep Learning and Convolutional Neural Networks Week 13: Deep Neural Networks: YOLO, Autoencoder, LSTM Week 14: Bayesian Networks, Confidence of Classification, Self-supervised learning Week 15: SVM, Adaboost, Ensemble Learning Week 16: Final exam Week 17: Presentation Week 18: Presentation

351866.objective: 學習敏捷與精實軟體開發方法與敏捷實務作法。本課程將涵蓋下列主題： 一、Scrum 方法 二、終極編程方法 三、看板方法 四、終極編程核心與配套實務作法 五、精實軟體開發實務做法 Students will learn Agile and Lean software development methods and agile practices. 351887.objective: 隨著材料科技的進步，材料的應用也逐步擴展到微精密電子元件、3C 光電元件、生醫電子元件等範疇。因此在從事相關技術的發展前提下， 了解電子及電路的基本原理有助於強化與提升相關技術的應用與開發能力。 本課程介紹電機、電子以及電機機械的基礎概念。內容包括 (1) 電機工程介紹，(2) 電子電路基本原則：電荷、電流、電壓、功率、科希荷夫定律、歐姆定律，(3) 電阻性網路分析：節點電壓和網目電流、重疊定理、戴維寧和諾頓等效電路，(4) 交流網路分析：介紹儲能元件並分析由正弦電壓及電流所驅動的電路，(5) 暫態分析：探討在不同穩態條件下，電壓及電流的行為，(6) 交流電源：簡單交流電源的計算，以及電力的產生及分配。

351890.objective: 本課程以「史前至古典時代」為歷史背景，探討人類初期生活型態的演變與設計的起源。從史前部落的生存環境與手工藝開始，逐步進入古埃及、古希臘、古羅馬等古文明的社會結構、宗教信仰、建築形式與生活器物，了解設計如何根源於生活需求與文化信仰。課程強調從歷史中理解設計思維與物質文化的起點，並訓練學生具備以文化視角分析生活與設計的能力。 教學目標： 1. 了解史前至古典時期的生活環境與社會結構，建立歷史脈絡中的設計觀。 2. 建立學生對史前至古代文明的生活型態與設計系統的整體理解。 3. 分析古代文化如何透過建築、器物、圖像與空間展現其價值與信仰。 4. 培養學生以歷史脈絡詮釋當代設計問題的能力。 5. 帶領學生從歷史資料與物質文化中進行設計觀察與詮釋的能力。 6. 引導學生發展跨文化與跨時代的思維，強化設計與社會責任連結。 7. 發展研究與表達能力，能以口頭與書面方式清楚說明歷史與設計間的關係。 8. 建立學生批判性思維與跨文化理解能力，為後續課程打下基礎。
351890.schedule: 週次 單元主題 第 01 週：課程導論：為什麼從歷史理解設計？ 第 02 週：史前社會與人類生存工具的設計思維 第 03 週：聚落與農業社會的興起：居住型態與器物變化 第 04 週：原始裝飾藝術與文化象徵 第 05 週：美索不達米亞文明與城市空間結構 第 06 週：埃及文明：宗教建築與永恆觀念 第 07 週：印度與東亞古文明中的工藝與信仰 第 08 週：中國古代設計與文化秩序 第 09 週：分組與期中討論 第 10 週：小組簡報 1：選擇一主題進行生活設計分析 第 11 週：古希臘城邦與民主空間之設計特質 第 12 週：古希臘建築與生活器物分析：公共空間與家具服飾 第 13 週：古羅馬的建設：道路、水道與公共建築 第 14 週：古羅馬社會的視覺與物質文化 第 15 週：古代飲食、身體與日常設計文化 第 16 週：小組簡報 2：從古代設計出發的當代啟發提案 第 17 週：材料與技術：從手工藝到社會制度的形塑力 第 18 週：課程總結與未來延伸：歷史如何回應當代挑戰 以上課程得依學習狀況彈性調整

351894.objective: Course Title: Numerical Analysis with MATLAB Course Objectives: This course introduces students to the fundamentals and applications of numerical methods to solve various engineering and scientific problems. By the end of the course, students will understand how to formulate mathematical models, analyze errors, solve nonlinear equations, perform matrix-based solutions of linear systems, apply curve fitting and interpolation techniques, and solve differential equations numerically. The course emphasizes practical MATLAB implementation, encouraging students to develop, test, and interpret numerical algorithms and simulations. Emphasis will also be placed on the methods' efficiency, stability, and accuracy. The course prepares students to be competent problem-solvers in real-world situations where analytical solutions are infeasible. Teaching Methods: The course employs a combination of lectures, hands-on MATLAB tutorials, problem-solving sessions, and project-based learning. Weekly lectures introduce theoretical foundations and derivations of algorithms, reinforced with illustrative engineering applications. Students will engage in weekly computer labs to implement and test methods in MATLAB, using provided templates or writing their scripts. Regular homework and in-class problem sets enhance analytical thinking and programming proficiency. Open discussions, collaborative projects, and quizzes provide formative feedback, while a final project allows for creative exploration of numerical methods in student-selected topics. Using graphical visualizations and case studies ensures connection to real-world phenomena, fostering theoretical understanding and practical competency.
351894.schedule: 18-Week Course Outline Week Topic MATLAB Practice/Demonstration ========================================= 1 Introduction to Numerical Methods and Mathematical Modeling Euler’s method on motion models 2 MATLAB Fundamentals Vectors, matrices, scripts, and plotting 3 Programming in MATLAB M-files, loops, conditionals, input/output 4 Round-off and Truncation Errors Taylor series, error plots 5 Root Finding I: Bracketing Methods Bisection & false position with error estimation 6 Root Finding II: Open Methods Newton-Raphson, secant, fzero 7 Optimization Methods Golden-section search, fminbnd, fminsearch 8 Linear Systems I: Direct Methods Gauss elimination, LU decomposition 9 Midterm Exam — — 10 Linear Systems II: Iterative Methods Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel, fsolve 11 Matrix Properties and Conditioning Matrix inverse, norms, condition number 12 Polynomial Interpolation Newton, Lagrange, polyfit/polyval 13 Spline and Piecewise Interpolation Natural, clamped, and not-a-knot cubic splines 14 Regression: Linear and Nonlinear Linear regression, multiple regression, lsqcurvefit 15 Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors Polynomial method, power method, eig function 16 Fourier Analysis FFT, power spectrum analysis, Nyquist frequency 17 Numerical Integration Trapezoidal, Simpson’s, Gauss quadrature, integral 18 Final Exam — —

351896.objective: Human-Computer Interaction Design: Autumn 2023 - Syllabus Meeting Times and Location: Wednesday, periods: 2-4, Credit Hours: 3.0 Instructors: Ryan Sheng-Ming Wang Instructor Office Location and Hours: Room 705-2, Design College bldg., Wednesday, 1300-1500: and Thursday 1300-1700. Instructor Contact Information: E-mail: ryan5885@mail.ntut.edu.tw Course Description: "Human-Computer Interaction Design" blends theoretical and practical perspectives in visualization and interactivity into several focused aspects using interactivity for education, entertainment, interactive media design, and industrial design purposes. An interface is a link between a user and a design that communicates how a design will be used, creating an experience for the people who will use it. It provides the framework, elements, and resources for a “conversation” between users and design. This course will explore the fundamentals of interfaces and the human-computer interaction design process. Students will be introduced to and able to practice the fundamental concepts, methods, and human-computer interaction design practices. They will explore the ideas of "User Experience Observation ", "Form Follows Function," and "User Interaction Analysis and Evaluation". They will explore how interactive media create experiences and understand the role that interaction with contents and installment fulfills in human existence. Finally and most importantly, students need to learn how to improve their ability to present their design ideas. This class is devoted to lectures, discussions, practice activities, design work sessions, and critiques of practical work. Course Objectives/Goals: At the conclusion of the course, students will be able to: 1. Identify how increasingly complex technologies are integrated into designs, services and events. 2. Define how digital or physical artifacts behave in response to user-centric interaction. 3. Describe, test and evaluate the usability and sustainability of user interfaces. 4. Apply iterative cycles of research, testing and development based on the understanding of user needs, goals and experiences. 5. Develop solutions and processes to common or known interface problems. 6. Build and test rapid prototypes for look and feel and usability. 7. Utilize client based concept development to develop the strategy, information architecture, human-computer interaction and interface design. 8. Demonstrate competency in information architecture, human-computer interaction and interface design.

351897.objective: 課程大綱： 本課程之目的為訓練學生有關電子設備散熱設計之相關原理與技術。介紹各項電子元件之發熱量、溫度與元件穩定性之關係，熱對流、熱輻射等熱傳原理在電子設備散熱之的應用法則；解說電子設備散熱器之演進與設計原理，如：熱管之原理與演進、小型風散之特性與設計原則等。探討電子設備的熱阻抗分析、溫度計算、熱應力分析，並介紹相關電腦輔助分析軟體。 This course introduces principles and techniques of thermal management and cooling design of electronic equipments. Subjects of this course include: thermal and physical properties of electronic components, thermo-fluid phenomena and principles of thermal management for electronic devices, and the evolution of cooling devices such as heat pipes and micro fans, discussion of analysis methodologies and computer software of thermal management problems including thermal resistances, temperature gradient, and thermal stress.

351898.objective: 本課程包含下列課題 1. 空氣清淨機構理論。 2. 無塵室構造、建造及確效。 3. 空氣過濾理論。 4. 無塵室設計專案。 5. 論文研讀。 This course covers the following Topics. 1.Theory of air cleaning Mechanism. 2.Clean room configuration, construction and verification. 3.Air filtration theory. 4.Paper discussion.
351898.schedule: 週次 日期 授課內容 1 9/11 課程簡介說明及無塵無菌室用途及基本原則 2 9/18 ICR/BCR 工業 / 生物潔淨室之歷史用途基本構造及未來 3 9/25 空氣過濾理論及裝置 4 10/2 潔淨室之概念、標準及其設計程序 5 10/9 國慶日 6 10/16 潔淨室之分類原理及其特點 按不同用途分類、氣流組成、空氣循環方式以及潔淨室佈局作講 解 7 10/23 潔淨室之設計 - 空調設計 - 1 計算循環風量、潔淨室之空調負荷，各種空調設計方案 課堂講授 8 10/30 潔淨室之設計 - 空調設計 - 2 計算循環風量、潔淨室之空調負荷，各種空調設計方案 課堂講授 9 11/6 期中考 10 11/13 無塵室的建築規劃 實務上無塵室規劃、人員及物料淨化路線、及人員安全問題 11 11/20 Filter 測試節能及 AMC 氣態化學污染物及其影響、 氣態分子污染物濾除技術理論及實務 12 11/27 BCR 應用分野及最新進展 cGMP、HACCP、PIC/S GMP、RABS、GLP、BSL、CPC 13 12/4 ICR 應用分野及最新進展 SMIF、FOUP、SWIT、T&A、DOUP、Mini-Environments 14 12/11 潔淨室之設計 - 循環空氣系統 對空氣循環元件如：軸流型風扇、風機過濾機組作介紹 15 12/18 潔淨室省能方法探討 分析導體廠廠務系統能源消耗之特徵以及節省能源之方法介紹 空調箱組成原件、配置方式並說明控制方法 16 12/25 行憲紀念日 17 1/1 元旦 18 1/8 分組期末報告及案例討論

351901.objective: 實驗是進行科學與工程研究不可或缺的工具，實驗方法的設計與實驗數據的分析更是決定實驗結果品質優劣的關鍵，本課程將介紹實驗過程所必須具備的各項知識，以數據的量測與分析為開始，並介紹量測各類物理量的感測元件，如壓力、溫度、流量及聲波等，以建立學生具備實驗量測的基礎。課程主要內容包含有基本量測、量測標準、量測單位、訊號讀取、資料簡報、數據的準確性與變異性、類比訊號量測、數位訊號量測、系統響應、感測器。
351901.schedule: 第一週：量測作業介紹； 第二週：量測誤差介紹； 第三週：精確度與準確度介紹； 第四週：可靠度分析； 第五週：誤差傳遞； 第六週：平均值與標準差； 第七週：統計分析方法介紹； 第八週：量測儀器介紹； 第九週：期中考 第十週：量測規範介紹； 第十一週: ISO/IEC 17025 技術規定； 第十二週: CNLA 量測評估規定； 第十三週：量測實務介紹 (一); 第十四週：量測實務介紹 (二); 第十五週：量測實務介紹 (三); 第十六週：量測實務介紹 (四); 第十七週：量測實務介紹 (五); 第十八週：期末考

351902.objective: Course Outline: Design methods, forced convection correlations for single phase heat exchange, pressure calculation, condensers and evaporators analysis, shell and tube heat exchanger analysis, compact heat exchanger analysis, wet coil analysis. 課程大綱： 本課程介紹熱能交換原理與熱交換相關之工程技術。使學生熟悉低溫熱交換中之分析熱效率、選擇材料之方法，及選用高效率熱交換器表面形狀之技術。內容包括：流力、熱交換基礎原理；氣冷式散熱鰭片分析、再生式熱交換器、管內與管集之單相熱傳、壓降計算；冷凝器、蒸發器等兩相熱交換器之設計；以及各種幾何變數、殼管式熱交換器之答拉瓦計算法、強化熱傳表面、鰭片管、熱傳表面積垢之問題與對策。
351902.schedule: 週次 / Week 授課內容 /Topic 1 Introduction of heat exchangers 熱交換器簡介 2 Types of heat exchangers an their applications 各種熱交換器之分類及應用 3 Fluid flow and heat transfer fundamentals in heat exchangers 熱交換器流力及熱傳基本觀念之回顧 4 Fundamental theories of heat exchanger design 熱交換之設計方法導論 5 Design methods of heat exchangers 熱交換之設計流程 6 Design of double pipe heat exchangers, fin analysis 套管式熱交換器之設計、鰭片分析 7 Analysis of compact heat exchangers 密集式熱交換器之分析 8 Heat transfer and pressure drop of compact heat exchangers 密集式熱交換器熱傳及壓損 9 Midterm exam 期中考 10 An example of compact heat exchanger design 密集式熱交換器之計算實例 11 Evaluation of heat exchangers 熱交換器之性能評估 12 Heat and mass transfer of direct contact heat exchangers 熱質傳與直接接觸式熱交換器 13 Plate type heat exchangers 板式熱交換器 14 Regenerative heat exchangers 再生式熱交換器 15 Shell and Tube heat exchangers 殼管式熱交換器 16 Analysis of shell and tube heat exchangers 殼管式熱交換器之分析 17 Fouling problems and solutions of heat exchangers 熱交換器積垢之問題與對策 18 Final exam 期末考

351903.objective: 超低溫冷凍通常指進行在 - 100℃以下特定低溫範圍之冷凍技術應用，高能能物理同步輻射冷卻，生物醫學胚胎冷凍保存，大型超低溫冷能氣化發電廠與中、長程飛彈推進系統冷卻技術等，現代微系統科技多方面高層次應用上之必要技術。故如何進行實質而有效整合超低溫系統技術，是決定未來國力競爭之主要關鍵項目。

351906.objective: 本課程旨在教授學生，尤其是創業 / 設計經理，尋找商業案例研究和技術，以快速將創新產品或服務推向市場並收集可操作的客戶見解。它適用於從中小型企業到企業以及一系列工業領域的一系列組織。本課程有助於解決經理面臨的持續壓力，要求他們進行創新並為客戶推出新穎的產品和服務。我們打算引導他們進行整體思維，以推進商業戰略和創業精神。 This course is designed to instruct students, as well as entrepreneurial and design managers, in search of business case studies and techniques for swiftly launching innovative products or services to the market while gathering actionable customer insights. Applicable to a diverse range of organizations, from small to medium-sized enterprises to corporate entities across various industrial segments, the course serves to assist managers in meeting the ongoing demand for innovation and the introduction of novel products and services. Our goal is to guide participants in adopting a holistic approach to advance business strategy and entrepreneurship, addressing the constant need for innovation in their roles.

351907.objective: 本課程旨在探討如何整合科技於文化創意產業，透過案例教學，幫助學生結合有效率的資訊科技工具於人文藝術，以發展文化創意產業，並創造高附加價值的效益。當今產、官、學、研都強調跨域整合的重要性，文創與互動科技的結合，能為文化創意作加值，並注入新生命、新體驗，因此，文創遇到科技後，所激盪出的火花與創意，已逐漸受到產、學界的青睞。本課程將探討文化創意的發展脈絡、文創的底蘊與其應用面、互動科技的應用，透過文獻研讀、案例分析等方式，瞭解國外最新研究與趨勢，討論文創與科技的創新應用可行性，引領文化創意產業轉型，規劃未來文創與科技整合的新契機。

351909.objective: 本課程將討論材料凝固熱力學、材料凝固動力學、平衡及非平衡狀態下材料的凝固現象與凝固界面之溶質濃度分佈情形。課程最後會介紹凝固學在工業界的應用實例：單晶成長與鑄造工程。 This lecture will first discuss the Thermodynamics and Dynamics for Solidification in Materials under equilibrium and non-equilibrium states. Second, we will discuss the Solidification behavior and solutes distribution at the interface between solid and liquid. Finally, we will briefly introduce the applications of Solidification in industry cases: Single Crystal Growth and Casting engineering.

351912.objective: 寶石業為台灣新興的工業之一，集地質學、礦物學、結晶學、切割技術、商業行為及藝術美感於此門學問，寶石礦物的物理及化學性質和鑑定，寶石礦物的生成和產狀及其地理公布，如何加工，銷售行為如何進行，珠寶的設計方式及製造。寶石礦物之顏色分類，內含物之特色，光學現象之表現。人造寶石之製造與辨認，均讓學習者有能力鑑定其真偽，價值與市場行為。 Introduction the physics and chemistry properties of gemstones.

351917.objective: 本課程旨在介紹和探討電子商務的基本概念、原理和實踐。學生將瞭解電子商務的發展背景、關鍵技術、商業模式和相關法律法規等方面的知識。課程內容包括電子商務的基礎概念、網站設計與開發、電子支付系統、網絡營銷、電子商務安全和隱私保護、供應鏈管理以及電子商務的社會和經濟影響等主題。透過案例分析和小組討論，學生將學習如何在電子商務環境中建立和管理成功的網上業務。此外，學生還將進行電商平台的實務操作，瞭解電子商務系統的建置和運營。同時，學生也將探討未來電子商務趨勢和創新。通過本課程的學習，學生將獲得在數字時代運營和成功利用電子商務的能力和知識。 This course aims to introduce and explore the fundamental concepts, principles, and practices of e-commerce. Students will gain an understanding of the development background, key technologies, business models, and relevant laws and regulations in e-commerce. The course covers topics such as the basics of e-commerce, website design and development, electronic payment systems, internet marketing, e-commerce security and privacy protection, supply chain management, and the social and economic impacts of e-commerce. Through case studies and group discussions, students will learn how to establish and manage successful online businesses in the e-commerce environment. Additionally, students will engage in practical exercises on e-commerce platforms to understand the setup and operation of e-commerce systems. Furthermore, students will explore future trends and innovations in e-commerce. By the end of this course, students will acquire the knowledge and skills to operate and leverage e-commerce effectively in the digital era.

351927.objective: 本課程內容： 1. 風量計算、風壓降計算與風車軸動力計算 2. 風管尺寸之選定（包括風管尺寸選定之方法、選定風管尺寸之工具、風管布置與尺寸選定與風管布置圖之繪製等） 3. 風管之製作與安裝（包括圓形金屬風管之製作與安裝、方形金屬風管之製作與安裝、酚醛複合風管之製作與安裝、風管之穿牆與穿樓板等） 4. 風口與百葉（包括送風口之選用、回風口之選用、百葉之樣式與構造、風口之壓降、風口之安裝） 5. 風管之轉彎、分歧與變管（包括形狀、特性、製作與選用等） 6. 管件之選用與安裝（包括風門、氣密風門、消防排煙閘門與防火閘門等） 7. 風車之特性與接管（包括風車之型式、風車系統效應與風車之接管等） 8. 風管系統之噪音處理（包括聲音之大小、噪音之來源、環境噪音之管制、風管系統之音能估算、音源之擴散、消音元件之選用、噪音估算與檢討等） 9. 風管壓降計算實務

351933.objective: 此課程旨在使學生理解自然界中常見的物理現象，進而領會物理 - 生活 - 科技之關聯。教學以工程背景學生所需要的物理基礎搭配實務探討來進行。主題涵蓋力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學等物理相關的觀念與應用。 This course aims to enable students to understand common physical phenomena in nature and then understand the connection between physics, life and technology. The teaching is based on the physical foundation required by students with engineering background and practical discussions. Topics cover physics-related concepts and applications such as mechanics, thermodynamics, acoustics, electromagnetism, and optics.

351934.objective: 本課程的目的是為了：1. 驗證物理理論之真實性，2. 培養同學認真的科學態度與方法，3. 培養同學數據處理的能力，4. 啟發同學自行設計解決量度問題的方法。課程之施行分為上下兩學期，每一學期為一學分三小時。上學期的內容偏重力學、波動、熱力、流力之實驗，下學期的內容則偏重電磁、光學、近物之實驗。 In this course there will be 1 credit for each of two semesters, and 3 laboraborial hours per week. The first semester experiments involve mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, and waves, etc.. The second semester experiments contains electromagnetics, optics, and modern physics, etc.. The purposes of this course are 1: to identify the physical laws, 2:to cultivate the ability of data reduction of students, 4: to instruct the students solving the problems of measurements of measurements by self-designments.

351946.objective: 隨著人工智慧、5G 通訊網路與感測技術的迅速發展，智慧物聯網應用已成為現代產業關注的核心領域。這些技術正加速整合，廣泛應用於智慧家庭、智慧醫療、工業自動化、軌道 (台鐵、高鐵、捷運) 系統及環境監測等多個場域，推動系統朝向智慧化、自動化與自我調適的方向發展。本課程旨在培養學生具備人工智慧與物聯網的基礎知識與實作能力，並透過專題與實驗導向的學習模式，深入理解智慧系統、資料處理的核心技術。課程內容涵蓋物聯網架構、感測器整合、資料傳輸模組、場域應用 (軌道機電整合、軌道系統應用)、等主題，學生將學習如何使用 Arduino 等嵌入式平台設計與建置實體系統。除了傳統人工智慧的應用外，本課程亦有生成式人工智慧的潛在應用。學生將了解大型語言模型或圖像生成模型，進行資料合成、異常偵測、自然語言介面設計、影像識別以及智慧決策支援… 等簡介，拓展物聯網應用的智能層次。為使學生具備設計與實作智慧物聯網系統的能力，並能將生成式 AI 融入創新應用中，為未來跨領域的技術整合與產業發展打下堅實基礎。 With the rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI), 5G communication networks, and sensing technologies, smart Internet of Things (IoT) applications have become a key focus in modern industries. These technologies are increasingly being integrated and widely applied in areas such as smart homes, healthcare, industrial automation, railway systems (Taiwan Railways, High Speed Rail, MRT) and environmental monitoring, driving systems toward greater intelligence, automation, and adaptability. This course is designed to equip students with fundamental knowledge and practical skills in both AI and IoT, adopting a project-based and hands-on learning approach to help them gain a deep understanding of core technologies in intelligent systems and data analysis. Course topics include IoT architecture, sensor integration, data transmission modules and field applications (railway electromechanical integration, rail system applications). Students will learn how to design and build physical systems using embedded platforms such as Arduino. In addition to conventional AI applications, the course also explores the potential of Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI). Students will be introduced to large language models and image generation models, and how they can be applied in data synthesis, anomaly detection, natural language interface design, image recognition and intelligent decision support, further enhancing the intelligence level of IoT applications. The ultimate goal of this course is to enable students to design and implement smart IoT systems and to integrate generative AI into innovative applications, laying a solid foundation for future interdisciplinary technology integration and industry development.

351949.objective: Robotics Lab (RLab) is offered with all experimental in-class projects, same as its previous version “Robotics and Automation Applications (RAA)”. Compared with Robotics course, this Robotics Lab (RLab) course is offered for undergraduate students with programming experience, but no particular prerequisites, such as Robotics, are required. RLab focuses on projects in the areas of optical inspection, mobile robots, manipulators, visual servoing, and automation. 本課程為全實驗課程，等同於原先「機器人與自動化應用」之新版課程。相較於「機器人學」基礎分析課程，機器人學實習 (RLab) 屬應用課程、適合具備基礎程式能力的大學生修習，並無機器人學等先修課程要求。課程專題聚焦於光學檢測、移動式機器人、機械手臂、視覺伺服與自動化。

351952.objective: 本課程主要敘述數位語音訊號的處理技術及語音相關應用。討論的課題主要包括語音分析的基本聲學原理如發音模型與語音特徵分析，以及語音編碼、語音合成、語音辨認等重要應用。 This course is intended to introduce the fundamentals of speech signal processing and related applications. The topics it will address include speech production model, extraction and evaluation of speech features, basic principles of speech analysis and synthesis, speech coding, and speech recognition, etc.

351954.objective: 此課程主要是含蓋無線通訊基頻訊號處理的理論基礎與系統架構，探討無線通道所能提供的通道容量以及可靠通訊。而大部分的課程內容會以目前熱門的多輸入多輸出 (MIMO) 傳輸為背景而進行探討。 This course provides the fundamental theories and architectures for baseband wireless communications. It is concerned that how reliable communication can be achieved and what is the capacity a channel can provide. Much attention will be focused on the newly developed technology, referred to as multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) transmission.

Week 7: Single-Antenna Wireless Communications. Week 8: Midterm I. Week 9: Spatial Multiplexing and Receiver Design. Week 10: Spatial Multiplexing and Receiver Design. Week 11: Spatial Multiplexing and Receiver Design. Week 12: Space-Time Coding. Week 13: Space-Time Coding. Week 14: Midterm II. Week 15-18: Other MIMO Transceivers (Optional) and Final Project.

351956.objective: The course includes: Introduction to Pattern Recognition, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood & Bayesian Parameter Estimation, Non-Parametric Classification - Density Estimation, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Multi-Classifier - Positive Boolean Function, Linear Discriminant Functions, Pattern Recognition of High Dimensional Data Sets, Pattern Recognition for Remote Sensing Images, Biometric Certification, Video Surveillance, Accuracy Assessments and Other Related Topics. 本課程介紹電腦科學中圖形識別的基本原理與相關技術，使學生了解各種圖形識別的分類方法，經由對分類問題的分析，瞭解如何將輸入樣本依不同特性加以分類，並熟悉圖形識別系統之相關議題如：分割、特徵擷取、分類、後處理、訓練、監督 / 非監督式學習、機器學習，進而了解分類問題，增進其解決實際圖形識別分類問題的能力。課程內容包括下列課題：圖形識別概論，Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood, 非參數法學習，K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Positive Boolean Function 多分類器，Linear Discriminant Functions，高維資料分類，分類正確率評估 (Accuracy Assessments) 及其他重要的應用，例如：文件分析、生物辨識、影像監控、遙測影像分類、醫療診斷、資料探勘等概念，最後並透過相關論文的研讀及討論，了解近代圖形識別的最新發展趨勢。

351965.objective: 全球化製造體系的形成，使得合約製造商必須以更積極的態度，從策略面出發，藉由各種電腦與網路的技術，整合內部與外部的流程與資訊，打造數位化工廠。數位化製造的目的，是希望藉由資訊透明化，提升整個製造體系的競爭優勢。課程的設計，是以概念介紹的方式，說明數位製造的應用現況與相關技術。本課程的內容包括：數位化製造概論、數位化製造實例說明、商業模型分析、知識管理、企業知識入口網站、產品資料管理、交易系統、資料倉儲、企業資訊入口網站、工作流程管理、最新數位化相關技術介紹。 Globalization has lead contract manufactures more active on seeking new strategies to survive. To increase competition, new technologies, such as computer and network technology, have applied. Computer and network technology can integrate internal and external information to establish a so-called "e-factory." This course covers different issues related to e-Manufacturing, such as Concept of e-Manufacturing, Case Study, Business Model Analysis, Knowledge Management, Enterprise Knowledge Portal (EKP), Product Data Management (PDM), Concept of Trading Systems, Concept of Data Warehousing, Enterprise Information Portal (EIP), Workflow Management, State of the Art Technologies, etc.

351966.objective: C/C++ 語言是廣泛能與硬體溝通的高階程式語言，無論是在傳統 UNIX 系統、3D 影像虛擬視覺化設計、中介語言等應用上，是新一代程式語言開發的基石。C/C++ 語言的跨平台的通用性和深層的記憶體管理機制，透過進階的 C/C++ 語言的學習，使其更靈活地發揮在各項專案設計中。本課程會以基礎 C/C++ 語言的回顧為開始，並將 C/C++ 語言帶入位元操作與物件化內容，最後導入電腦圖學與高效能平行化計算等應用。 The C/C++ language is a high-level programming language that can communicate with a wide range of hardware, and is the basis for the next generation of programming language development, whether in traditional UNIX systems, 3D image virtualization design, intermediary languages, etc. The cross-platform versatility and deep memory management mechanism of the C/C++ language make it more flexible for various project designs through advanced C/C++ language learning. This course will begin with a review of the basic C/C++ language, move on to bit manipulation and object-based content, and finally lead to applications such as computer graphics and high-performance parallel computing.

351972.objective: This course presents analytic concepts in computer network analysis. It is designed for the beginning graduate students who are interesting in computer networks. Students should have a mathematical maturity typical of undergraduate curricula in science and engineering, including calculus and discrete mathematics, as well as a course in operating systems and a course in computer architecture. The teaching approach in this course emphasizes modeling, analysis and design principles used in modern computer networks, including the Internet of today. The subject material includes reference models, queuing systems, graph theory, routing algorithms and resource management systems. Case studies include Internet foundation protocols, such as IP and TCP, as well as Internet multicasting and differentiated service principles.

351976.objective: 奈米科技與半導體製程技術在近年來受到極大的重視，因此在本課程將介紹半導體基礎與最新的奈米技術，內容包含有基礎電子電路學與半導體製程，以及奈米材料 (如奈米碳管、石墨烯、二維奈米材料等)，期許可以帶給同學當今最新的奈米化技術與半導體相關之科技知識。 Nanotechnology and semiconductor manufacturing processes have received significant attention in recent years. The content includes basic electronic circuitry and semiconductor manufacturing processes, as well as nanomaterials such as carbon nanotubes, graphene, and two-dimensional nanomaterials. The aim is to provide students with the latest knowledge in nanotechnology and semiconductor-related technologies.

351992.objective: 本課程主旨在介紹計算生物學及醫學資訊學相關之重要主題，目的在於提供學生漸進式的介紹，理解當代最新之各項生醫分析技術。本課程主要為有志於跨領域學習之學生所設計，內容包含基礎生物學的核心知識與基礎 Linux 操作，以及生醫領域的序列比對工具和介紹微陣列晶片技術。在奠定基礎後開始進入次世代分析技術的應用，主題將包含 DNA 定序、RNA 定序與總體基因體學分析。希望透過這些內容讓學生在分析各種基因資料並了解不同生物學問題時，具備選擇合適工具與詮釋結果的能力。接著，透過研究實例和分析操作，讓學生接觸到實際實驗測量產生的數據，體會真實研究的過程。藉由實際操作相關分析工具，使學生體會基因資料在實務上的重要性，達到將生物理論與實務應用緊密結合的目標。此外，課程也將邀請計算生物學領域的專家親臨授課，透過專題演講與實作操作，帶領學生深入探索前沿技術，拓展知識與實做技能。 This course aims to introduce important topics related to computational biology and medical informatics. The objective is to provide students with a gradual introduction to understanding the latest contemporary biomedical analysis techniques. This course is primarily designed for students interested in interdisciplinary learning. The content includes concept knowledge of basic biology, fundamental Linux operations, sequencing alignment in the biomedical field, and introductions to microarray technologies. After establishing this foundation, the course will progress to the application of next-generation sequencing technology, covering topics such as DNA sequencing, RNA sequencing, and metagenomics analysis. Through this content, students will develop the ability to select appropriate tools and interpret results when analyzing various types of genetic data and addressing different biological questions. Following this, research case studies and hands-on analytical exercises will allow students to engage with real data generated from experimental measurements, providing insight into the actual research process. By directly working with relevant analytical tools, students will gain an appreciation for the practical significance of genetic data, achieving the goal of closely integrating biological theory with real-world applications. In addition, the course will feature guest lectures and hands-on workshops by experts in computational biology, guiding students in exploring cutting-edge technologies and expanding both their theoretical knowledge and practical skills.

351994.objective: 在現今產業激烈競爭與利潤微薄之階段，落實執行 "突破創新" 以增加競爭力之唯一生存之道，但鮮少有企業真正瞭解與實際地徹底執行它。不僅工程或服務技術要創新，管理思維更要突破創新，以有效迅速解？錯綜複雜的研發、工程與管理之諸多矛盾問題。本課程以創新構思問題解？法 (TRIZ) 為基礎，詳細介紹工程技術如何落實創新與管理實務創新如何執行。本課程適用於自有品牌業者、ODM 或 OEM 製造業者、服務業者與學術單位教學研究，特點如下：完整詳實闡述 TRIZ 理論並輔以大量簡單案例說明 TRIZ 概念、工程 TRIZ 實務案例 10 餘個與 TRIZ 工程與管理之參數與創新原則說明簡例約 800 餘個，管理實務案例 20 餘個，包含研發管理、服務業管理、專案管理與生產管理等。案例與簡例最多，創新執行力可快速上手與實施應用。本課程 TRIZ 研發、工程與管理兼顧，製造業與服務業高層、中層與基層員工皆符合讀者條件，使 "突破創新" 輕易實務執行並成為企業文化，亦適用於大學與研究所之工管、企管 (經營管理)、工商管與工程相關科系，可自行按需求選擇性深入教授講解某些章節，也替產業界事先磨練一群創新思維之活力新血，可長久伴隨您在職場 (或未來進入職場) 解決研發、工程與管理之困難矛盾問題。

351995.objective: Copyright Act is specifically enacted for the purposes of protecting the rights and interests of authors with respect to their works, balancing different interests for the common good of society, and promoting the development of national culture. This course introduces the main meanings, concepts and contents of the Copyright Law. Including the scope for copyright protection, the kinds of works that qualify for copyright protection, the rights granted to copyright owners, the management of copyright, and remedies for right infringement. In particular, what are copyright protections applied with AI? The discussion in the course covers theory and examples, to enhance a deeper understanding the exchanges between copyright protections and AI for the students.

351995.objective: 本課程將以近期著作權法著名案例的評析，培養學生關鍵的基礎能力，再導入若該著作為人工智慧自行創作或人類以人工智慧為輔具所創作之法律爭議，鼓勵學生從比較法考察及跨域科法整合之觀點，剖析立法、司法或行政所面臨的問題，並探求可能解決問題的具體措施或建議方案。 This course will analyze recent well-known copyright cases, expecting that relevant fundamental capability of students can be built. 351998.objective: 本課程所定義的文化產業包括音樂產業、電視產業、電影產業、劇場產業和其他表演藝術有關的產業。這些產業區塊都存在相關的智慧財產權議題，例如所有權、權利轉讓、合理使用、侵權行為、契約爭議等等。本課程將透過法院判決的選讀與產業案例研究來讓學生認識文化產業的智慧財產權議題。學生將被要求參與討論。評分方式包括課堂參與和報告。 The scope of the cultural industry covered by this course includes the music industry, film industry, television industry, theatre industry, and other industries related to performing arts. Intellectual property issues do exist in these industrial sectors. The issues include ownership, title transfer, fair use, infringement, contract dispute, and so on. This course is intended to expose students to various IP issues in the cultural industry through studying court decisions and discussing industrial case studies. Students are required to participate in discussion. The grading policy is based on class participation and essay paper.

352002.objective: 本課程將介紹經濟分析的理論與研究方法，除了探討近年來為何經濟分析的研究方法如此受到重視外，還會討論到該如何從經濟之角度，來分析各類型之智慧財產權。而課程之內容則從基礎之經濟學理論開始談起，更以經濟分析之研究方法，來具體檢視各領域之智慧財產權，包括：著作權、專利權、商標權、營業秘密，藉以達到理論與實際並重之教學目的。
352002.score_policy: 1. 期末專題報告 70% 2. 上課出席 20% 3. 上課參與及表現 10%
352002.materials: 1.Cooter, Robert & Ulen, Thomas 著，溫麗琪、顧慕堯合譯，法律經濟學，華泰文化，2014 年 1 月。 2. 大衛・傅利曼著，葉家興審訂、徐源豐譯，經濟學與法律的對話，先覺出版社，2002 年 6 月。 3. 謝哲勝主編，法律經濟學，五南圖書出版公司，2007 年 5 月。 4.Cooter, Robert & Ulen, Thomas (2008), Law & Economics (Pearson Education, Inc., 2008). 5.Posner, Richard (2007), Economic Analysis of Law (Aspen Publishers, 2007). 6.Landes, William & Posner, Richard (2003), The Economic Structure of Intellectual Property Law (Harvard University Press, 2003).

352003.objective: 專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。因此本課程主要強調專利策略與專利布局分析在企業界的運用；值得強調的是，本課程內容完全與國考無關，係針對『專利技術分析』、『專利佈局』、『專利策略』與『科技管理』等主題作討論，故課程的設計會閱讀相關外文文獻，所以份量頗重，預期每星期均會花很多時間閱讀 paper 與課堂討論，所以較適合未來擬以相關主題作為論文研究方向之同學修習。
