353019.objective: 生命週期涵括人生全期，而黃金階段泛指 20~35 歲之青年期，雖然已經是法定之成年人，但卻是成年人之最早階段，人生之重大基礎皆在此探索與樹立的。其中，情感、愛情、性事、性別傾向也是在此階段被合理地期待著發展，但往往生涯才是被過度地觀注和投入，在離開校園進入社會之前，給自己一個探索性情愛的機會吧。 本課程末後階段則說明性別平等與性犯罪等相關法規，如家庭暴力防治法、性騷擾防治法、跟蹤騷擾防治法等等，提供務實法規之理解。 Life circle is the understanding of whole human being and golden age is between 20 to 35. It's the important base of life. You need to explore your feeling, loves, sex and gender for yourselves. We hope you can reduce the only duty of career development and increase understanding of intimate relationships. otherwise, we will introduce the Taiwanese regulations of gender equality in the end of courses. 親密關係是人際關係的核心問題，它關係著交友的態度、婚姻生活的幸福與社會的祥和。本課程由對兩性差異性的了解為基礎，以尊重為原則，在平等互助的精神中，建立兩性關係的和諧。本課程內容包括理論與實際的配合，儘量以生活化的內容貫穿其間，並注重課程內容的可實踐性，以協助學生處理兩性關係的難題。 另從生命週期之青年任務、家庭親子關係、世代背景來討論青年現時狀態，所面臨之獨立自主與發展自我和生涯的課題，也需要學習認識伴侶與相處，以及進入愛情的情感歷練，理解親密與界線，經歷分手與再追尋，在青年的黃金十年之中，探索自我生涯、人際關係、現實世界與親密關係的定位。 In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves and partners. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the partner. It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of living a meaningful life together. One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood. It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

353020.objective: 人的身體一旦接觸自然環境，便開始運作各個器官的功能。然而，與機器不同，人體無法任意更換零件。一旦身體機能出現問題，許多人常因缺乏相關知識，無法正確應對，甚至對早期徵兆渾然不覺。因此，本課程的主要目的是透過基礎醫學知識的介紹，幫助大學生了解自身身體構造與運作原理，培養自我健康管理的能力，能及早發現異常並主動應對。我們希望培養的是身心健全、具備健康素養的大學生，而非僅知埋首書本、卻忽視自身健康的學生。 Once the human body comes into contact with the natural environment, all of its organs begin to function. Unlike machines, however, the human body cannot simply replace its parts when problems arise. When physical functions begin to decline or show signs of abnormality, many people lack the knowledge to respond appropriately—or worse, fail to recognize the warning signs altogether. The primary goal of this course is to provide students with a foundational understanding of medical science, enabling them to better understand how their bodies work. By doing so, they can monitor their own health, detect abnormalities early, and take proactive steps to maintain their well-being. Our aim is to cultivate well-rounded, healthy university students—not those who excel only academically while neglecting their physical health.

353021.objective: 現代人的健康問題 50％以上導因於生活型態與行為模式，傳統以疾病治療為主的醫療模式已無法因應目前民眾的健康需求，健康促進、危急救護等觀念正被廣泛應用，本課程內容包含三大部分，包括「健康及其影響因素」、「健康促進相關議題」、「安全教育與急救」，藉由系統性健康教育與資訊傳播，使學生能習得正確健康知能及技能，幫助學生建立健康行為模式，使其健康能獲得更好的自我控制。 More than 50% of modern men’s health problems attributes from living style and behavior. The tradition way for curing illness has failed to fulfill people’s requirements. Conceptions such as health promoting and emergencies dealing are now being wildly used. This course mainly focuses on three issues, including “health and its affected cause,” “related issues on health promotion”, and “safety education and emergency treatment.” Through systematical health education and information spreading, students acquire the correct health knowledge and skills, to help students lead a healthy life and to get a better self-control on own health.

It also conducts industrial analysis and management technology for innovative industries.

353023.objective: 本課程將討論二十世紀後半 (1950-1990) 台灣重要科技產業與經濟發展的關聯性，同時也將從日常生活科技與社會的角度分析科技物設計的緣由，最後再帶入工程文化的認識與反思。This course will discuss the relationship between technology and industrial development in Taiwan during the second half of the 20th century (1950-1990). It will also analyze the reasons behind the design of technological objects from the perspectives of everyday life technology and society. Finally, it will delve into the understanding and reflection of engineering culture.

353024.objective: 藝術不僅是審美與表達的載體，更是創新思維的催化劑。本課程探索當代藝術如何與科學、產業、社會議題交匯，我們從藝術與科學的對話出發，探討視覺藝術如何受到不同科學的影響，並探討新興領域如文化科技應用作品、沉浸式展演、數位 IP 等，探討當代藝術如何拓展文化機構與文化產業的邊界。同時，課程也關注當代藝術的社會參與，包括環境永續、身份認同與潮流文化等，並透過知名經典的展覽與藝術家作品，以及時尚與藝術融合等知名創作，剖析創意如何形塑未來。課程將結合業師講座與代表性作品解析，鼓勵學生從跨領域的視角理解藝術，培養跨域與文化創新的思維模式。

353025.objective: 在上學期開設，一學期，兩學分。斷限：始於日據時期，止於七十年代，以台灣白話文學之生發演進史程為主軸。範圍：涵蓋文字改革運動，第一次鄉土文學論戰，第二次鄉土文學論戰， 本土化文學思想研析、及作品選讀。要求：學期報告一份、期末考。 Period: From the Japanese sovereighty to the 1980's; emphasizing the history of the vernacular literature. Topics: The movement of the language revolution; the first controversy of folk literature; the second controversy of folk literature; analysis of the literary localization movement and the study of selected works. Requirements: One term paper and a final exam.

353027.objective: 性、性別是人類與生俱來的課題，其與各時代之政治體系、法律規範及社會變遷有密不可分的關係法律中的性別議題，既是法律問題也是社會問題，需要結合法律領域與社會領域的知識，作跨領域教學與學習。 本課程配合性別平等教育政策趨勢，分就不同面向的法律規範中的相關性別議題，來讓學生了解近年來性別平等之相關法律意涵希望能在認知、情意、行動等層面，讓學生習得正確的性別權利意識，進而在國家公私領域中運用相關知識落實性別平等，以促進多元文化之下兩性平權發展。 Sex and gender are inherent issues of human beings, and they are inseparable from the political system, legal norms and social changes of all ages. Gender issues in the law are both legal and social issues and need to be combined with the legal field and society Domain knowledge for cross-domain teaching and learning. This course is in line with the gender equality education policy trend, and divides the relevant gender issues in different aspects of legal norms to let students understand the relevant legal implications of gender equality in recent years. Hopefully, students can learn from the levels of cognition, affection, and action. Correct awareness of gender rights, and then apply relevant knowledge to implement gender equality in the public and private sectors of the country, so as to promote the development of gender equality under multiculturalism.

353028.objective: 生命週期涵括人生全期，而黃金階段泛指 20~35 歲之青年期，雖然已經是法定之成年人，但卻是成年人之最早階段，人生之重大基礎皆在此探索與樹立的。其中，情感、愛情、性事、性別傾向也是在此階段被合理地期待著發展，但往往生涯才是被過度地觀注和投入，在離開校園進入社會之前，給自己一個探索性情愛的機會吧。 本課程末後階段則說明性別平等與性犯罪等相關法規，如家庭暴力防治法、性騷擾防治法、跟蹤騷擾防治法等等，提供務實法規之理解。 Life circle is the understanding of whole human being and golden age is between 20 to 35. It's the important base of life. You need to explore your feeling, loves, sex and gender for yourselves. We hope you can reduce the only duty of career development and increase understanding of intimate relationships. otherwise, we will introduce the Taiwanese regulations of gender equality in the end of courses. 親密關係是人際關係的核心問題，它關係著交友的態度、婚姻生活的幸福與社會的祥和。本課程由對兩性差異性的了解為基礎，以尊重為原則，在平等互助的精神中，建立兩性關係的和諧。本課程內容包括理論與實際的配合，儘量以生活化的內容貫穿其間，並注重課程內容的可實踐性，以協助學生處理兩性關係的難題。 另從生命週期之青年任務、家庭親子關係、世代背景來討論青年現時狀態，所面臨之獨立自主與發展自我和生涯的課題，也需要學習認識伴侶與相處，以及進入愛情的情感歷練，理解親密與界線，經歷分手與再追尋，在青年的黃金十年之中，探索自我生涯、人際關係、現實世界與親密關係的定位。 In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves and partners. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the partner. It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of living a meaningful life together. One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood. It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

353030.objective: 課程目標： 透過資訊安全教育，培養學生的資安意識與技能，增進科技素養，建立防禦思維與實作能力，提升資訊應用中的安全性，並啟發其持續學習與探索資訊安全領域的興趣，以奠定終身學習與生涯發展的基礎。本課程之內容為：一、資訊與網路安全簡介，二、安全與風險管理，三、存取控制概念，四、網路攻擊技術與防禦，五、安全操作系統與應用，六、資訊安全弱點與威脅，七、資安事件處理與應變，八、資通安全框架應用。 This course is designed to cultivate students' awareness and skills in information security through education, enhance their technological literacy, establish defensive thinking and practical abilities, improve the security of information applications, and inspire continued learning and exploration in the field of information security. The course aims to lay the foundation for lifelong learning and career development. The course includes: 1. An introduction to information and network security; 2. Security and risk management; 3. Concepts of access control; 4. Network attack techniques and defenses; 5. Secure operating systems and applications; 6. Information security vulnerabilities and threats; 7. Incident handling and response; 8. Applications of cybersecurity frameworks.

353031.objective: 現代科技文明進展得非常迅速，雖然一般人日常生活中經常享受到這些科技所帶來的便利，但卻習以為常而忽略背後的原理，本課程介紹各項科技技術的入門技術與發展歷史，引導同學以批判性思考角度省思科技產業發展，培養對科技發展相關議題（倫理、環保、商業等等）獨立思考的能力；另外本課程也準備數週的專題討論，特別討論能源相關議題，因為無論何種科技，均與能源使用有關，本課程一方面介紹節能科技，另一方面也討論綠能（包含太陽能、風能、生質能與其他新能源）的開發及使用。

353032.objective: 現代人的健康問題 50％以上導因於生活型態與行為模式，傳統以疾病治療為主的醫療模式已無法因應目前民眾的健康需求，健康促進、危急救護等觀念正被廣泛應用，本課程內容包含三大部分，包括「健康及其影響因素」、「健康促進相關議題」、「安全教育與急救」，藉由系統性健康教育與資訊傳播，使學生能習得正確健康知能及技能，幫助學生建立健康行為模式，使其健康能獲得更好的自我控制。 More than 50% of modern men’s health problems attributes from living style and behavior. The tradition way for curing illness has failed to fulfill people’s requirements. Conceptions such as health promoting and emergencies dealing are now being wildly used. This course mainly focuses on three issues, including “health and its affected cause,” “related issues on health promotion”, and “safety education and emergency treatment.” Through systematical health education and information spreading, students acquire the correct health knowledge and skills, to help students lead a healthy life and to get a better self-control on own health.

353032.remarks: 本課程涉及 SDG2：消除飢餓 SDG3：健康福祉 SDG5：性別平等 SDG6：潔淨水與衛生 SDG13：氣候行動 * 指標對應授課內容：SDG2：消除飢餓；第 3 週授課主題「飲食與健康」對應 SDG2 中的發展國民飲食營養相關指引及素材。SDG3：健康福祉；第 2-7 週授課主題「健康促進」「癌症防治」「傳染病的認識與預防」「物質濫用防制」對應 SDG3 的推動第四期國家癌症防治計畫；積極推動多元愛滋篩檢與諮詢服務、感染者診斷即刻服藥、以及暴露愛滋病毒前預防性投藥（PrEP）等防治政策，15-49 歲愛滋感染新增人數持續下降；持續透過多元管道推動慢性呼吸道疾病防治工作，以降低慢性呼吸道疾病過早死亡機率；提高藥、酒癮治療服務涵蓋率。SDG 5：性別平等；第 7 週授課內容愛滋病、HPV、猴痘、病毒性肝炎，從傳染病談性教育與性傳染病防治。SDG6：潔淨水與衛生；在第 1 週健康促進課程導論介紹影響健康的環境因素，第 3 週健康飲食、第 4 週腸道傳染病，都與水質衛生息息相關。SDG13：氣候行動；第 16 週授課主題「環境急症 - 過冷、過熱與氣候變遷對健康的影響」對應 SDG13 中的採取緊急行動應對氣候變遷及其衝擊，增進氣候變遷調適能力。
353032.sdg_indicators: SDG2：消除飢餓（Zero Hunger）SDG3：良好健康和福祉（Good Health and Well-being）SDG5：性別平等（Gender Equality）SDG6：潔淨水與衛生（Clean Water and Sanitation）SDG13：氣候行動（Climate Action）

353033.objective: 現今企業面臨嚴峻的挑戰，諸如科技變革、市場波動、政治鬥爭、氣候變遷等，變動頻繁的經濟、社會、自然環境，都是對企業永續經營的考驗。近年來，「永續創新」幫助企業永續發展的作用引起學者、經理人和政策制定者的廣泛關注，由於創新是解決經濟、社會和環境問題的關鍵，企業愈來愈傾向於投入永續創新，透過全新或改良的產品、服務、管理流程、系統程序、商業模式等，創造共享的社會和商業價值，減少對環境造成的負面影響。因此，永續創新指的是持續提升產品、流程與人力品質，共同為您的客戶、員工與環境打造一個更光明永續的未來。 Nowadays, firms face severe challenges, such as technological revolutions, market fluctuations, political conflict, and climate change. This swiftly transforming economic, social, and environmental milieu poses rigorous tests to corporate sustainability. In recent years, the concept of "sustainable innovation" has garnered significant attention from academics, executives, and policymakers, acting as a cornerstone in facilitating the sustainable progression of organizations. Innovation stands as an essential tool in grappling with economic, societal, and environmental quandaries, prompting an increasing number of companies to channel resources towards sustainable innovation. Such investment aims to generate shared socio-economic value and curtail adverse environmental impacts by pioneering or refining business products, services, processes, procedures, and methodologies. 353034.objective: 梁任公說：「孔子這個人有多少價值，連帶的論語也有多少價值。」所以論語是瞭解孔子最好的一部古經典。本課程旨在透過論語誘使學者對孔子的精神面貌有一番真切的體認，並使學者由而知曉儒家何以能深深影響著二千多年來國人的思想言行。 As Qishau Liang states, "Lueng Yu is as valuable as Confucius." Therefore, Lung Yu is the best classics, which provide easy access to deepening the understanding of Confucius. The course aim at sharpening students' knowledge about Confucius and Confucian school that has exerted profound influence on Chinese for over two thousand years.

353035.objective: 本課程的特色是希望藉由管弦樂音樂的播放，與實體樂器的展示、示範演出，互相結合，使同學在欣賞高水準的音樂之餘，更能實際接觸到平常接觸不到的實體樂器，實際的觀察樂器的構造，近距離的欣賞到樂器，能聽到實際上發出的聲音，從而對材料機械，科技與樂器聲響之間的關係，有一個真實而全新的認識，進而引發對音樂的認識以及興趣。 The feature of the course is that, through playing music, physical instrument display an demonstration of performances, the students come into contact with the usual musical instruments. Observing the instrument configuration and listening the sound in close distance lead to a true and a new understanding of the relationship between material mechanics and musical sound, and thus trigger and interest in music.

353036.objective: This course adapts a genealogy perspective and begins with a general overview of modern Chinese literature as a journey of discovery. The course will start with an introduction of A new literary history of modern China edited by Wang David Der-wei Wang (王德威), and then review how Wang succeeded Chih-tsing Hsia’s (夏志清) work to present a new, diversify, and historically poetic version of Chinese literature history. This course will take these authors as cases for discussion, mapping Lu Hsun (魯迅) and Eileen Chang (張愛玲). With further navigating their positions in the literary genealogy, the lecturer aims to address how their literary works construct contemporary culture. In addition, two films, Spring in a Small Town and New Women, will be discussed in order to understand the cultural situation at that time. 本課程將以華語譜系為視角，以中國現代文學的總體概述為起始，進行一場發現之旅。課程將以王德威的《哈佛新編中國現代文學史》切入，介紹王德威如何繼承夏志清的工作，呈現新格局、輻射的、「史蘊詩心」的中國文學史呈現。課程中將著重介紹魯迅、張愛玲的文學地位，解釋他們在文學系譜上承前啟後的位置，以各種面向來看待文學作品對於當代文化建構的貢獻。此外，也將特別探討《小城之春》與《新女性》兩部電影，以了解當時的文化情境。

353037.objective: 每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。 本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。 在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，發揮一加一大於二的效用，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。 本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。

353038.objective: 現代人的健康問題 50％以上導因於生活型態與行為模式，傳統以疾病治療為主的醫療模式已無法因應目前民眾的健康需求，健康促進、危急救護等觀念正被廣泛應用，本課程內容包含三大部分，包括「健康及其影響因素」、「健康促進相關議題」、「安全教育與急救」，藉由系統性健康教育與資訊傳播，使學生能習得正確健康知能及技能，幫助學生建立健康行為模式，使其健康能獲得更好的自我控制。 More than 50% of modern men’s health problems attributes from living style and behavior. The tradition way for curing illness has failed to fulfill people’s requirements. Conceptions such as health promoting and emergencies dealing are now being wildly used. This course mainly focuses on three issues, including “health and its affected cause,” “related issues on health promotion”, and “safety education and emergency treatment.” Through systematical health education and information spreading, students acquire the correct health knowledge and skills, to help students lead a healthy life and to get a better self-control on own health.

353039.objective: 本課程旨在介紹電子科技產業趨勢及智權管理策略，第一部分介紹電子科技產業發展趨勢；第二部分介紹一般科技產業之智權管理策略與模式；第三部分以個案研討方式，帶領學生討論產業之智慧財產權管理實務，包含品牌管理、專利布局策略、商標申請與運用、著作權議題、營業秘密之保護等相關案例。

353040.objective: 本課程探討永續能源技術與政策對環境與公共健康的影響，內容涵蓋太陽能、核能、海洋再生能源等技術，並結合能源法規、環境健康、氣候變遷等議題。課程透過提供跨領域視角，幫助學生理解能源發展如何影響社會、經濟與健康，培養分析與解決永續發展問題的能力。 This course explores the impact of sustainable energy technologies and policies on the environment and public health. It covers technologies such as solar energy, nuclear energy, and marine renewable energy, and integrates topics like energy regulations, environmental health, and climate change. By offering an interdisciplinary perspective, the course helps students understand how energy development affects society, economy, and health, while fostering the ability to analyze and solve sustainable development issues.

353041.objective: 透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。 創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。

353042.objective: 近年來各大學積極推動「大學社會責任實踐（University Social Responsibility, USR）計畫」，期許大學師生對在地方發展及公共議題發揮熱情與創意，與地方居民及企業協力推動社區及產業發展。 大學社會責任工作主要是透過社會創新，解決社會問題，來實踐社會責任所謂社會創新，就是用創新的方法來解決社會問題，產生「社會影響力」（Social Impact），並設法改變處在社會問題「當中的人」以及與這個人有關的「社會情境」（social context），來產生長久的社會影響。 本課程為小班制，訴求以師生共讀、討論、協作，以及讀書會、工作坊等方式進行，目標是協助同學以「說好故事」的方式，思考一個具體可行且能打動人的 SDGs、USR 或 ESG 方案，或賦予你正在打造的產品與服務更具前瞻公益性的價值。 In recent years, universities have actively promoted the "University Social Responsibility (USR) Program", expecting university teachers and students to show enthusiasm and creativity in local development and public issues, and work with local residents and enterprises to promote community and industrial development. This course will explain the basic concepts of social responsibility to the students, introduce the concepts and practical experience of each USR project team of our school, and use the case experience to share and discuss, and use USR field issues as the topic report discussion material. Guide students to participate in university social responsibility work, and enhance the attitude, cognition and behavior of social innovation.

353043.objective: 近年來，各大學積極推動「大學社會責任實踐（University Social Responsibility, USR）計畫」，期望透過大學落實社會責任，推動社會創新，並進而產生正向的社會影響力。 本課程採小班制進行，本學期將安排三個主題單元：(1) 原住民文物返還 (2) 原住民影像文化 (3) 都市原住民居住權與文化保存。透過這三個單元，本課程引領學生認識臺灣原住民在上述單元議題上的社會創新實踐，並期望藉此拓展對大學社會責任的理解與視野。

353051.objective: 本課程將介紹衛星遙測技術基礎，包括衛星通訊軟體及硬體，以及在地球科學、環境管理、農業和城市規劃中的應用。透過理論講授、案例研究和實習，學生將了解衛星遙測技術原理及其在各領域的實際應用。課程強調實際應用和解決問題的能力，並提供實習機會，讓學生參與衛星遙測專案，培養操作技能和解決問題的能力。 This course will cover the basics of satellite remote sensing technology, including satellite communication software and hardware, as well as its applications in Earth sciences, environmental management, agriculture, and urban planning. Through theoretical lectures, case studies, and practical exercises, students will gain an understanding of the principles of satellite remote sensing technology and its practical applications in various fields. The course emphasizes practical applications and problem-solving skills, providing labs for students to participate in satellite remote sensing projects and cultivate their operational skills and problem-solving abilities.

353053.objective: 本課程致力於深入研究各種低軌道衛星地面站系統的複雜結構和相關元素。課程首先介紹低軌道衛星地面站系統的基本概念，包括其在衛星通訊中的角色和功能。學生將深入了解地面站系統在支援低軌道衛星通訊方面的重要性。接著，課程將詳細介紹不同類型的地面站，如海事衛星、GEO/LEO 地面站以及固定式 / 移動式地面站。學生將學會分析這些地面站的特點、應用場景，以及相應的技術要求。課程的內容還包括天線次系統，涵蓋天線的種類、原理和性能特點。同時，課程將探討 LOC（地面中控系統）的功能和重要性，使學生瞭解地面站系統的集中控制和管理。接下來，學生也將深入研究資料介接網路，包括資料的傳輸方式、協定和安全性，以確保地面站系統的有效運作。最後，課程將關注其他支援系統，包括電源、控制和機構等，使學生全面理解地面站系統的整體結構和運作機制。透過實例分析，學生將獲得地面站系統架構解析的實際能力。 This course explores the complex structure of various Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite ground station systems, introducing fundamental concepts and their roles in satellite communication. Students gain a profound understanding of the pivotal role these systems play in supporting LEO satellite communication. The course analyzes different ground station types, including maritime satellites, GEO/LEO ground stations, and fixed/mobile ground stations, detailing their characteristics, applications, and technical requirements. It also covers antenna subsystems, the Local Operations Center (LOC), data interface networks, and supporting systems like power and control. Practical case analyses help students develop skills in deciphering ground station system architecture.

Through this course, students will learn the theoretical foundations of satellite communication, system design, operational techniques, and their practical applications across various industries.

353059.objective: This course is designed to: (1) strengthen students' previously acquired knowledge of English by reviewing fundamental grammatical concepts and sentence structures through level-appropriate reading materials; (2) develop reading skills through explanation of challenging vocabulary, phrases, and syntax, along with the analysis of fundamental writing techniques; (3) familiarize students with practical conversational expressions and enhance their confidence in cross-cultural communication; and (4) reinforce their competence and performance in listening, speaking, reading, and writing through consistent practice. In addition, the course incorporates the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support language learning. Students will explore how AI-assisted platforms—such as grammar checkers, pronunciation analyzers, conversation simulators, and personalized vocabulary trainers—can be used to enhance autonomous learning, provide real-time feedback, and improve overall language proficiency. 本課程旨在： (1) 鞏固學生既有的英語知識，透過符合其程度的閱讀教材，複習基本語法概念與句型結構； (2) 發展閱讀能力，透過講解困難詞彙、片語與句法結構，並分析基礎寫作技巧，以提升理解與寫作表達； (3) 使學生熟悉實用的會話用語，並增強其跨文化溝通的自信心； (4) 透過反覆練習，加強聽、說、讀、寫四項語言技能的能力與表現。 此外，課程亦納入人工智慧（AI）工具於語言學習中的應用。學生將學習如何運用各類 AI 輔助平台 —— 如文法檢查器、發音分析工具、模擬對話系統，以及個人化詞彙學習軟體 —— 以提升自主學習成效，獲得即時回饋，並全面增進語言能力。

353060.objective: Through weekly readings and class discussion, this course will help develop students’ English conversation and reading skills. In the course of practicing such skills, we will focus on an idea central to understanding the language and the culture of the West, and thus an idea central to understanding the people (their values, motivations, principles) of Western culture. [Past topics for this course include: Monsters and the Human; Comedy and Humor; The Nature of Good and Evil; The Hero in the West; Baseball and Society; The Idea and the Importance of Beauty; Exploration and Discovery]. Examining essays and films centered around such a topic, we will consider what the significant idea tells us about Western society and its people. 透過每週閱讀和課堂討論，本課程將幫助培養學生的英語會話和閱讀能力。 在練習這些技能的過程中，我們將集中在理解西方語言和文化的核心思想，從而理解西方文化中的人們（他們的價值觀、動機和原則）的核心思想。 [本課程的過去主題包括：怪物與人類；喜劇與幽默；善與惡的本質；西方英雄；棒球與社會；美的概念與重要性；探索與發現。 透過研究圍繞這一主題的文章和電影，我們將思考這個重要想法如何告訴我們有關西方社會及其人民的資訊。

353061.objective: 本課程通過閱讀各種文本（包括新聞文章、社論、報告和研究論文）來檢視當代文化中之社會和政治動態。 透過引導學生觀察、分析和理解當代 / 流行文化的複雜性和模糊性。 本課程將閱讀及討論引人入勝的文化故事、事件和趨勢，培養學生的批判性分析能力和文化素養。 This course examines important social, political, ethical, and aesthetic ideas in contemporary culture by examining a variety of audio-visual and written texts, including news articles, editorials, research papers, academic essays, videos, websites, movies, and stories. Students will practice observing and analyzing significant cultural phenomena in an effort to better understand how ideas, beliefs, and values develop and change over time, and are shaped by both longstanding traditions and by ever-changing popular trends. The course introduces fascinating cultural stories, events, issues, and trends to be studied, in order to develop students’ critical thinking, analytic skills, and cultural literacy.

A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

353066.objective: This is a history course of western classical music, of which the definition, according to The New Harvard Dictionary of Music and The Oxford Dictionary, is "art music” or"serious music", that written in a Western musical tradition, using an established form."Classical music is generally considered to be serious and to have a lasting value.” The styles of various periods will be introduced, from the Medieval, Renaissance, Classical, Romantic, to the Contemporary eras. The goal of this course is helping students to equip a general comprehension of Classical Music in terms of basic elements of musical art, technical theory, historical, social and cultural background extends to related arts and humanities. In addition, basic elements of music notation reading and theory will also be made known to the students. Other genres such as Alternative Rock and related fields will be interlaced with the Classical Music. In order to pursue the most accurate references and info, the major key-points and terminology used in this course will be in English or original European text. (There are requirements to fulfill this course such as Midterm & Final Exams, as well as in-class presentation or performance. If you're not interested in serious music genre, please DO NOT take this course.) 此門課程為西洋藝術音樂史，即古典音樂歷史。根據「新哈佛音樂辭典」 ( New Harvard Dictionary of Music) 與 「牛津字典」 的詮釋，所謂古典音樂為「嚴肅藝術」音樂，以嚴謹成型的作曲公式創作音樂，經過歷史洗練的時間藝術。透過此課程學生對西洋古典音樂會有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及社會人文背景，從音樂美感構成與相關人文藝術和文化歷史的議題作連結。 (此門課有期中考與期末考，還有課堂現場報告或表演的要求，如果對學術類型嚴肅音樂跟搖滾樂歷史沒有興趣，強烈建議不要選修！)
353066.schedule: 1. 古希臘藝術與人文，信仰：古歐洲在基督教傳入前的文化，音樂，文學，戲劇，跟人文背景 1st week: Introduction to Western Art Music—Greek origin as the foremost culture before Christianity entered Europe 2. 從基督教傳入，到中世紀：古歐洲承襲希臘時代以來的傳承，展現於壁畫，以及基督教傳入歐洲後對文化及藝術的影響；音樂記譜方式，表演方式，天主教會對社會的影響；拜占庭建築到哥德式大教堂，中世紀歐洲社會與歷史 2nd week: The Medieval Period--folk music, church music in relation to arts and culture 3. 中世紀到文藝復興音樂的演變 (舞蹈與民謠): 庶民文化與音樂 3rd week: From Medieval to Renaissance period--Madrigals, church music, dance music. 4. 文藝復興時期：宗教音樂由單一旋律演化為複音音樂，作曲家 雕塑家。畫家介紹。以義大利為首的時代。此時期受歡迎的樂器介紹；源於德，法，蘇格蘭宗教改革與英國王室的關聯 4th week: Renaissance period--from Monophony to Polyphony; Introduction to Italian composers, artists, and some of the most popular musical instruments; the Reformed Church and Martin Luther that not only changed the society and belief system but also aethesticism in arts. 5. 巴洛克時期：法國巴洛克 -- 英國巴洛克與法國巴洛克比較，王室音樂跟庶民音樂介紹；法王路易十四世與凡爾賽宮 5th week: Baroque--Louis XIV and his influence on French music,in comparison to English Baroque 6. 巴洛克時期: 義大利式協奏曲介紹；巴洛克時代小型管弦曲；宗教信仰不同形成南歐與北歐教堂建築文化迴異 6th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends--Corelli, Lully and Couperin, Introduction to Concerto Grosso 7. 巴洛克時期: 基本舞曲，組曲形式 -- 宮廷舞步與巴洛克芭蕾 7th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends continues--Vivaldi, Scarlatti, and Rameau--Court Dance and French Ballet 8. 巴洛克時期：德意志巴洛克 -- 韓德爾，泰雷曼，巴赫 8th week: Baroque--Comparison among Handel, Telemann, and J.S.Bach 9. 巴洛克時期：深度探討巴赫生平與作品 9th week: Baroque--J.S. Bach in-depth--his string works, orchestral music, choral music, keyboard music, and Fugues. 10. 期中報告 10th week: Midterm Report 11. 古典時期：啟蒙時代崛起，腓特烈二世 (普魯士) 對德意志音樂藝術的影響。波次坦忘憂宮介紹；盧梭之民約論，丹麥王室實現其理念；俄羅斯凱撒琳大帝對藝術的貢獻 — 聖彼得堡冬宮博物館介紹 11th week: Classical period (Classicism)--The Age of Enlightenment--Frederick the Great as a passionate patron of music and art; Danish royal house contributing Jean-Jacques Rousseau's ideology in Denmark; Catherine the Great and The Hermitage 12. 古典時期：德奧樂派 (第一代維也納樂派); 葛路克與哈布斯堡家族及其小公主，後來為法國波旁王朝最後的皇后瑪麗．安東尼；海頓，莫札特，貝多芬 (前期) 12th week: The First Viennese School; Gluck and Habsburg family; Marie Antoinette 13. 浪漫派時期：從貝多芬中期開啟德奧浪漫派 13th week: Romantic period--Beethoven and the beginning of Romantic era; how Schubert was influenced by Beethoven 14. 浪漫派時期：法國，北歐，波西米亞 -- 區域性的不同風格 14th week: The pinnacle of Romantic era--Chopin, Schumann, Brahms, Liszt, Tchaikovsky, to the late Romantic period 15. 浪漫派時期：國民樂派，俄羅斯音樂與十九世紀俄國芭蕾 15th week: A counterpart of Romantic style with Naionalism--Music by Bohemian and Russian composers; 19th Century Russian ballet and music 16. 二十世紀現代樂派：法國印象樂派，第二代維也納樂派；法國印象畫派與樂派的相輔相成；包浩斯學院，Art Deco (裝飾風藝術) Art Nouveau (新藝術運動) 介紹 16th week: Impressionist Music, The Second Viennese School and related art styles in the period 17. 後現代主義：音樂學界的實驗性音樂； Phillip Glass 獨創的極簡樂風；電腦與傳統樂器結合 17th week: The Contemporary Music--from Twelve- tone music (The 2nd Viennese School) to Existentialism, music of Minimalism, and experimental music; comparison with other genres 18: 期末考 18th week: Final Exam.

353067.objective: 本課程由全球化框架來檢視兩岸關係的演進、現況、及發展趨勢。 由政治、經濟、乃至社會心理層面分析海峽兩岸錯綜複雜的互動關係。 並檢視國際政治經濟體系中，美國與日本兩大國對兩岸關係的影響。 This introductory course on the complex cross-strait interactions will examine Taiwan’s role in the intricate web of international power politics; as well as the structure of hegemonic power rivalry, particularly Sino-US-Japan triangle, and its impact on cross strait relations. The material will cover the evolution, status quo, and developmental path of the cross strait relations in a global framework.

353073.objective: The mission of Institutional Research is to support the evidence-based decision-making in education institutions. Therefore, in this course, the classmates would be asked to learn the programming language to deal with the real data and provide solid evidence to the leadership. You would be asked to fully engage in the data analysis during this semester. By the end of this course, you should be able to conduct complicated data analysis with confidence. Meanwhile, you should be able to provide productive suggestions for your supervisor's consideration. This course not only prepare you as a qualified IR officers. It also lead you as a professional data analytician.
353073.schedule: Week 1: the introduction of the syllabus and course requirement Week 2: the foundation of Institutional research Week 3: the working environment in Stata Week 4: data cleaning & data manipulation Week 5: Project Task I Week 6: data visualization Week 7: data modeling: multiple regression, logistic regression, quantile regression Week 8: data reporting Week 9: Project Task II Week 10: team work in PIAAC data Week 11: team work in PISA data Week 12: team work in administration record data Week 13: Advanced topic I:panel data, fixed effect and random effect Week 14: Advanced topic II: instrument variable Week 15: quasi-experiment I: Difference in Difference, Synthetic Control Week 16: quasi-experiment II: Regression discontinuity, Coarsened Exact Matching, Propensity Score Method Week 17: Special talk: Geographic Information System, Social network analysis Week 18: Project Task III
353073.score_policy: 1.Project task I: 30% 2.Project task II: 30% 3. Project task III: 30% 4. class participation: 10%

353075.objective: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。 This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

353084.objective: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。 如果你想體驗創業前該具備的專業與過程，如果你想學習在未來不論是升學 (簡報設計、創業計畫書) 或就業 (Wix 網站、Line 官方帳號) 或探索自己 (行銷、財務)，任何一項能力都能讓你在未來年薪百萬甚至創業，因此這堂課絕對不是輕鬆可及的營養學分，但絕對是你人生經歷中的營養學分。 To encourage and help students use technology or business models, collaborate with school teachers or cross-school classmates, and jointly solve social or business problems through business methods, this course will be conducted in a sprint class format. We will invite teachers and industry professionals with entrepreneurial experience to help students progress weekly through workshops and entrepreneurship competition drills. The goal is to help students implement their entrepreneurial ideas, apply them to society, and bring about change. If you want to experience the professional skills and processes required before starting a business, or if you want to learn skills that will be valuable whether you pursue further education (presentation design, business plan writing), employment (Wix website, Line official account), or self-exploration (marketing, finance), any of these abilities can help you earn a million-dollar annual salary in the future or start your own business. Therefore, this course is not an easy elective but a valuable life experience.

353085.objective: 隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。 由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各 20 位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。 With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

353086.objective: 輔具是輔助器具的簡稱，舉凡日常生活，能使活動更容易、方便的各種用具皆屬之，正確的使用輔具可以改變身心障礙者或老年人原本有障礙的生活，走入社會，降低社會成本。本課程為專案導向課程，課程中除教授輔具設計基本概念，透過實際個案訪談分析目標對象，以工作坊形式找出使用者痛點，進而發展解決方案，提出適切的輔具資源，以幫助身心障礙者或老年人族群。 Assistive device is the abbreviation of auxiliary equipment. For everyday life, all kinds of utensils that make activities easier and convenient belong to it. Correct use of assistive device can change the life of people with physical and mental disabilities or the elderly who have obstacles, and enter the society and reduce Social costs. This is a project-oriented course. The course introduces the concept of auxiliary equipment; students can also analyze target audience through different case studies. During workshops, it helps students indicate users’ pain points and develop the solutions. The goal of this course is to come out with the resources to help people with disabilities or the elderly.

353087.objective: 課程將以體驗式教學訓練，提升學員表達技巧、舞台技巧、臨場反應。本課程主要目的在教授學生以設計思考思維與策略，運用主題式課程實戰小組簡報及個人簡報，快速釐清簡報製作及表達過程中重點，提升修課學員個人簡報製作能力及表達能力，幫助學生在未來創業及就業上以出色之個人簡報能力獲得面試者及投資者的青睞，領先於起跑點取得優勢。 The course will use experiential teaching training to improve students' expression skills, stage skills, and on-the-spot reactions. The main purpose of this course is to teach students establishing design thinking strategies. During the course practice group presentations and personal presentations training students to quickly clarify the key points in the process of presentation production and presentation, to improve the students' personal presentation production and presentation skills. Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. Students who finished this course will be favored by interviewers and investors with his excellent personal presentation skills. And he will gain an advantage over the starting point.

353088.objective: 透過課程訓練、實戰演練，以及組隊創業進行，從市場需求、商業模式規劃、量化問卷、價格與行銷等創業必修課讓學生了解創業老闆的真實樣貌，有效地訓練學生成為有機會在市場上生存的創業老闆。 Through course training, practical exercises, and team entrepreneurship, students are exposed to essential entrepreneurial subjects such as market demand analysis, business model planning, quantitative surveys, pricing, and marketing. These components provide students with insights into the realities of entrepreneurship, effectively equipping them with the skills needed to potentially thrive as entrepreneurs in the market.

353089.objective: 設計思考是利用新的設想、新的技術手段轉變成更新並且改進過後的服務方式。從社會的角度而言，服務的創新是創造和開發人類自身價值，提高和完善生存質量，改善社會生態環境的活動。因此，服務創新通過滿足物質需求、精神和心理需求，並提供解決問題的能力，保障人們的精神和心理上的健康，得到滿足感和成就感。 本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何提供改善對人類的服務。 以人的角度為出發設計出最好的設計

353089.objective: 設計思考是利用新的設想、新的技術手段轉變成更新並且改進過後的服務方式。從社會的角度而言，服務的創新是創造和開發人類自身價值，提高和完善生存質量，改善社會生態環境的活動。因此，服務創新通過滿足物質需求、精神和心理需求，並提供解決問題的能力，保障人們的精神和心理上的健康，得到滿足感和成就感。 本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何提供改善對人類的服務。 以人的角度為出發設計出最好的設計

353090.objective: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。 Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

353091.objective: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。 如果你想體驗創業前該具備的專業與過程，如果你想學習在未來不論是升學 (簡報設計、創業計畫書) 或就業 (Wix 網站、Line 官方帳號) 或探索自己 (行銷、財務)，任何一項能力都能讓你在未來年薪百萬甚至創業，因此這堂課絕對不是輕鬆可及的營養學分，但絕對是你人生經歷中的營養學分。 To encourage and help students use technology or business models, collaborate with school teachers or cross-school classmates, and jointly solve social or business problems through business methods, this course will be conducted in a sprint class format. We will invite teachers and industry professionals with entrepreneurial experience to help students progress weekly through workshops and entrepreneurship competition drills. The goal is to help students implement their entrepreneurial ideas, apply them to society, and bring about change. If you want to experience the professional skills and processes required before starting a business, or if you want to learn skills that will be valuable whether you pursue further education (presentation design, business plan writing), employment (Wix website, Line official account), or self-exploration (marketing, finance), any of these abilities can help you earn a million-dollar annual salary in the future or start your own business. Therefore, this course is not an easy elective but a valuable life experience.

The main purpose of this course is to teach students establishing design thinking strategies. During the course practice group presentations and personal presentations training students to quickly clarify the key points in the process of presentation production and presentation, to improve the students' personal presentation production and presentation skills. Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. Students who finished this course will be favored by interviewers and investors with his excellent personal presentation skills. And he will gain an advantage over the starting point.

353097.objective: 輔具是輔助器具的簡稱，舉凡日常生活，能使活動更容易、方便的各種用具皆屬之，正確的使用輔具可以改變身心障礙者或老年人原本有障礙的生活，走入社會，降低社會成本。本課程為專案導向課程，課程中除教授輔具設計基本概念，透過實際個案訪談分析目標對象，以工作坊形式找出使用者痛點，進而發展解決方案，提出適切的輔具資源，以幫助身心障礙者或老年人族群。 Assistive device is the abbreviation of auxiliary equipment. For everyday life, all kinds of utensils that make activities easier and convenient belong to it. Correct use of assistive device can change the life of people with physical and mental disabilities or the elderly who have obstacles, and enter the society and reduce Social costs. This is a project-oriented course. The course introduces the concept of auxiliary equipment; students can also analyze target audience through different case studies. During workshops, it helps students indicate users’ pain points and develop the solutions. The goal of this course is to come out with the resources to help people with disabilities or the elderly.

353098.objective: 隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。 由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各 20 位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。 With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

353130.objective: 本課程將介紹基本無人機系統架構，與如何整合 4G/5G 網際網路來開發新的應用。課程內容包括無人機原理與基本操作、開源機載控制軟體 (ArduPilot)、通訊協定 (MAVLink)、地面控制站 (Mission Planner)、飛行模擬與影像傳輸等、嵌入式 AI 影像辨識等。此外更將輔導學生考取無人機相關證照。 This course will the fundamentals of Unmanned Aircraft Systems, and how to integrate drones with 4G/5G network to create new applications. Students will learn UAV basic operations, open-source embedded control software (ArduPilot), communication protocol (MAVLink), ground control station (Mission Planner), VR simulation and video transmission, etc. Additionally, we will introduce advanced topics and new applications, such as combining 4G/5G networks to control multiple drones, training embedded AI models for object detection, etc.

353131.objective: 本課程讓學生深入瞭解射頻模組的基本架構及其在無線通訊技術中的應用，並且掌握人工智慧與深度強化學習的基本概念，學習如何利用人工智慧技術優化射頻模組性能，如增強信號強度和降低干擾。此外，課程將涵蓋電磁模擬軟體及其在射頻模組中的應用，並指導學生設置環境，編寫人工智慧演算法，實現自動化模擬與優化，最終培養獨立解決問題的能力。 This course enables students to gain an in-depth understanding of the basic structure of RF modules and their applications in wireless communication technology. It also covers the fundamental concepts of artificial intelligence and deep reinforcement learning, teaching students how to use AI techniques to optimize RF module performance, such as enhancing signal strength and reducing interference. Additionally, the course will introduce electromagnetic simulation software and its applications in RF module simulation, guiding students to set up the environment, write AI algorithms, and achieve automated simulation and optimization, ultimately cultivating the ability to solve problems independently.

353132.objective: 本課程主要目的在於使用各種深度學習的方法，應用在微波遙測資料上面。主要以案例的方式介紹各種應用，因此除了會說明核心的演算法之外，也會介紹使用的訓練資料集的格式、前處理等內容。課程前段會先回顧基本的遙測影像特性以及深度學習技術，包含 CNNs, RNNs, GANs 和 YOLOs 等，常見於遙測資料應用的方法。課程中段會已實際的範例說明上述幾種方法的使用情境與成效。課程最後會要求學生以文獻研讀的方式說明不同深度學習方法在微波遙測上的實例。 The primary objective of this course is to apply various deep learning methods to microwave remote sensing data. It introduces diverse applications primarily through case studies, covering not only core algorithms but also the format of training datasets and preprocessing techniques. The initial part reviews fundamental remote sensing image characteristics and deep learning techniques, including CNNs, RNNs, GANs, and YOLOs—methods commonly applied to remote sensing data. The middle part demonstrates the practical scenarios and effectiveness of these approaches through real-world examples. The final part requires students to conduct literature reviews, presenting case studies of different deep learning methods applied to microwave remote sensing.

353133.objective: 本課程旨在培養學生掌握人工智慧技術在通訊網路中的應用，特別是在衛星通訊系統和無線網路中的實踐。學生將學習通訊網路的基礎概念、衛星次系統、軌道力學與資料解析，並瞭解無線網路架構、資源分配及網路切片技術。此外，學生將掌握如何利用人工智慧和深度強化學習技術進行資源優化、訊號處理與異常檢測，並應用實驗平台進行模擬和實驗，最終具備設計、實施並優化通訊網路的能力。 This course aims to equip students with the skills to apply artificial intelligence techniques in communication networks, particularly in satellite communication systems and wireless networks. Students will learn the fundamental concepts of communication networks, satellite subsystems, orbital mechanics, and data analysis, as well as the architecture of wireless networks, resource allocation, and network slicing technologies. Additionally, students will master how to use artificial intelligence and deep reinforcement learning techniques for resource optimization, signal processing, and anomaly detection. They will also apply experimental platforms for simulations and experiments, ultimately gaining the ability to design, implement, and optimize communication networks.

353134.objective: 本課程介紹以 ARM CPU 為核心之嵌入式系統。內容包含：ARM CPU 基礎架構，ARM CPU 指令集，ARM 之 C 語言工具，ARM 發展環境，開發電路板，模擬器，Linux 驅動程式之撰寫及安裝，分散式網路架構，以及應用實例。 This course introduces small single-board computers serving as embedded systems and explains the architecture of X86 and ARM CPUs. This lecture will present the history of the ARM development environment, emulators, distributed network architectures, and industrial applications of ARM architecture. In the course, students learn to install Linux on development boards and write software to communicate with ARM processors. The exercises involve setting commands for the ARM cores and receiving signals from our embedded systems using C language tools.

353135.objective: 本課程為整合型課程，以多主題方式介紹當代與下世代先進材料化學技術，包含先進奈米合成技術、奈米微影科技、功能性催化材料化學、生醫材料化學、功能性高分子設計以及軟性元件製作等。本課程為跨系院課程，由多位教師共同授課，提供跨領域知識學習與培養學生跨領域思考。 This course is an integrated course that introduces emerging and next-generation advanced materials chemistry in a multi-topic approach, including advanced nanomaterials synthesis, nanolithography technology, catalytic materials chemistry, biomaterials chemistry, functional polymer design, and the production of soft electronic devices. It is an interdepartmental course, lectured by multiple teachers, and providing multidisciplinary knowledge learning.

353136.objective: 本課程從 IPCC 的氣候變遷評估報告出發，引導學生了解氣候變遷的重要性以及未來企業活動如何與氣候變遷結合，除著重介紹組織實體如何計算其營運活動的溫室氣體排放量外，亦介紹如何運用溫室氣體盤查數據設定組織轉型策略及淨零目標。本課程內容結合國際通用方法 GHG Protocol 與 ISO 14064-1:2018、IPCC 2006 與 2019 修訂之計算理論，並介紹我國環境部的計算要求以及與淨零目標設定、轉型風險相關之國際倡議，透過完整的計算理論與實務演練，來完成一份組織溫室氣體盤查與計算。 This course is based on the IPCC's Climate Change Assessment Report and aims to guide students in understanding the importance of climate change and how future cooperation activities can integrate with it. Apart from focusing on how organizations calculate the greenhouse gas emissions from operational activities, it also introduces how to utilize greenhouse gas inventory data to set transformation strategies and net-zero targets. The course integrates internationally recognized methods like the GHG Protocol, ISO 14064-1:2018, as well as IPCC 2006 and 2019 revisions for calculation theories. It also covers national calculation requirements from Taiwan's Ministry of Environment (MOENV) and international initiatives related to setting net-zero goals and transformation risks. Through comprehensive theoretical approach and practical application, students will complete an organizational greenhouse gas inventory and calculation.

353137.objective: This course is designed as the precursor course selected by seniors and graduate students. It covers the basic knowledge of the atmospheric boundary layer, bluff-body aerodynamics, aero-elasticity, the wind-resistant design of buildings, and the concept of wind-resistant design of bridges. National and international wind codes for buildings and bridges are introduced with practices based on wind tunnel test data. Other related wind issues are also conceptually introduced in this course.

353141.objective: 本課程從 IPCC 的氣候變遷評估報告出發，引導學生了解氣候變遷的重要性以及未來企業活動如何與氣候變遷結合，除著重介紹組織實體如何計算其營運活動的溫室氣體排放量外，亦介紹如何運用溫室氣體盤查數據設定組織轉型策略及淨零目標。本課程內容結合國際通用方法 GHG Protocol 與 ISO 14064-1:2018、IPCC 2006 與 2019 修訂之計算理論，並介紹我國環境部的計算要求以及與淨零目標設定、轉型風險相關之國際倡議，透過完整的計算理論與實務演練，來完成一份組織溫室氣體盤查與計算。 This course is based on the IPCC's Climate Change Assessment Report and aims to guide students in understanding the importance of climate change and how future cooperation activities can integrate with it. Apart from focusing on how organizations calculate the greenhouse gas emissions from operational activities, it also introduces how to utilize greenhouse gas inventory data to set transformation strategies and net-zero targets. The course integrates internationally recognized methods like the GHG Protocol, ISO 14064-1:2018, as well as IPCC 2006 and 2019 revisions for calculation theories. It also covers national calculation requirements from Taiwan's Ministry of Environment (MOENV) and international initiatives related to setting net-zero goals and transformation risks. Through comprehensive theoretical approach and practical application, students will complete an organizational greenhouse gas inventory and calculation.

353142.objective: The main goal of this course is to guide students in implementing and experimenting with multisensory feedback technologies from an application and design perspective. Through hands-on exercises and experiments, students will understand the capabilities of different feedback technologies regarding application and design considerations and learn heuristic evaluation, immersive scale, and semi-structured interviews of human-computer interaction systems to analyze and understand the performance of human-computer interaction systems (programming language: C++). In addition, this course will take the form of group exercises in the innovative ability to strengthen students' cross-field proposals through cooperative learning and prototyping skills. 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度，帶領同學進行多感官回饋技術的實作及實驗。從實作及實驗中學生將了解不同回饋技術在應用面上的可能性及其設計考量，並學習人機互動系統的啟發式評估、沉浸式量表、半結構式訪談，從而剖析及理解人機互動系統的表現 (程式語言：C++)。此外本課程將以小組實習方式來進行，期望藉由合作學習和雛型製作來強化學生跨領域提案之創新能力。

353178.objective: This course introduces students to the core concepts and methods of statistics, with a focus on learning how to use data effectively in the face of uncertainty. Key topics include data visualization, descriptive statistics, probability, statistical inference, and linear regression. Emphasis will be placed on building intuition and practical understanding rather than mathematical rigor. Students will develop the skills to make sense of data, draw meaningful conclusions, and communicate results with clarity and confidence. The tools and thinking developed in this course are valuable for making informed decisions and conducting research across a wide range of disciplines. They also form the foundation of many modern applications, including data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. Requirements and Expectations This is an English-medium course. English must be used at all times in class, including for homework, quizzes, exams, and all other course-related work. We will use NTU COOL to share course materials and announcements. You are expected to check both NTU COOL and your school email daily to stay informed and up to date. All cell phones and other communication devices should be turned off or silenced during class. Students may be cold-called to answer questions. Active and voluntary participation in discussions is highly encouraged

353181.objective: 「生成式 AI: 文字與圖像生成的原理與實務」是一門兼具理論深度與實作樂趣的課程，專為希望深入了解生成式 AI 的技術與應用的學生而設計。不論對 AI 的認識是基礎還是進階，都希望透過這門課程，帶領同學探索生成式 AI 的無限可能。學生將會學習神經網路、GAN、Transformer、大型語言模型、RAG、AI Agents、Diffusion Models 等技術，並運用工具如 OpenAI API、LangChain、HuggingFace 及 AISuite 等等，完成從文字生成到圖像生成的多樣應用。
353181.schedule: ** 配合政大課程 9/2 開課 ** 週次 1 課程介紹與生成式 AI 概述 課程目標與內容簡介，為什麼要研究生成式 AI, 介紹 Colab 平台的基礎操作。 週次 2 神經網路的概念 簡介神經網路的核心概念 (感知器、多層感知器)、激發函數與反向傳播，實作一個簡單的 MNIST 手寫數字分類。 週次 3 紅極一時的生成對抗網路 (GAN) 介紹曾經被當作生成式 AI 希望的生成對抗網路 (GAN), 包括 GAN 的生成原理、著名的應用範例，及為什麼暫時不再是主流的原因。 週次 4 大型語言模型原來這麼簡單 文字生成 AI 的基本概念，包括 RNN 及 transformers 有「記憶」的神經網路簡介，及 seq2seq 模型、詞嵌入等等原理。 週次 5 Transformers 全攻略 RNN 及 transformers 的數學基礎與架構，複習基本矩陣運算、瞭解注意力模式的原理。 週次 6 大型語言模型 (LLM) 的應用及倫理議題的挑戰 著名的大型語言模型 (LLM), 常見應用，及倫理議題的討論。 週次 7 打造自己的對話機器人 使用 AISuite, 用程式的方式打造自己的對話機器人。 週次 8 專家講座 學界或業界專家分享生成式 AI 相關實務主題。 週次 9 檢索增強生成 (RAG) 的原理及實作 RAG 的概念、資料檢索與生成的結合方法，實作基於 LangChain 的 RAG 系統 週次 10 Agentic AI 與 AI Agents 什麼是 AI Agents? 學習不同的 AI Agent 設計模式，並且運用 AISuite 實作 週次 11 變分自編碼器 (VAE) 開始的冒險旅程 解釋 VAE 的原理，及為什麼這相對簡單的模型，會成為圖像生成 AI 的重要想法，發展出目前重要圖像生成的 diffusion models 週次 12 文字生圖 AI 的原理及實作 Diffusion Models 的進階主題，包括 CLIP、排程器、LoRA 等概念。並且用 Hugging Face 的 diffusers 套件打造自己的圖像生成 AI Web APP。 週次 13 用 Fooocus 實現 Diffusion Models 的進階技術 介紹「理解」使用者輸入文字的 CLIP 模型，著名的圖像生成 AI 模型及運用方式 週次 14 生成式 AI 流行工具及應用範例 介紹主流生成式 AI 工具，及應用範例。 週次 15 生成式 AI 應用與發展趨勢 介紹生成式 AI 新近發展。例如我們介紹文字生成預測 token 的模型，還有圖像生成 diffusion models, 有「互相攻佔」對方地盤的現象。探討其中的原理和可能走向這個方向的原因。 週次 16 在 Gather.town 線上研討會型式的期末專題成果分享

353185.objective: 「生成式 AI: 文字與圖像生成的原理與實務」是一門兼具理論深度與實作樂趣的課程，專為希望深入了解生成式 AI 的技術與應用的學生而設計。不論對 AI 的認識是基礎還是進階，都希望透過這門課程，帶領同學探索生成式 AI 的無限可能。學生將會學習神經網路、GAN、Transformer、大型語言模型、RAG、AI Agents、Diffusion Models 等技術，並運用工具如 OpenAI API、LangChain、HuggingFace 及 AISuite 等等，完成從文字生成到圖像生成的多樣應用。
353185.schedule: ** 配合政大課程 9/2 開課 ** 週次 1 課程介紹與生成式 AI 概述 課程目標與內容簡介，為什麼要研究生成式 AI, 介紹 Colab 平台的基礎操作。 週次 2 神經網路的概念 簡介神經網路的核心概念 (感知器、多層感知器)、激發函數與反向傳播，實作一個簡單的 MNIST 手寫數字分類。 週次 3 紅極一時的生成對抗網路 (GAN) 介紹曾經被當作生成式 AI 希望的生成對抗網路 (GAN), 包括 GAN 的生成原理、著名的應用範例，及為什麼暫時不再是主流的原因。 週次 4 大型語言模型原來這麼簡單 文字生成 AI 的基本概念，包括 RNN 及 transformers 有「記憶」的神經網路簡介，及 seq2seq 模型、詞嵌入等等原理。 週次 5 Transformers 全攻略 RNN 及 transformers 的數學基礎與架構，複習基本矩陣運算、瞭解注意力模式的原理。 週次 6 大型語言模型 (LLM) 的應用及倫理議題的挑戰 著名的大型語言模型 (LLM), 常見應用，及倫理議題的討論。 週次 7 打造自己的對話機器人 使用 AISuite, 用程式的方式打造自己的對話機器人。 週次 8 專家講座 學界或業界專家分享生成式 AI 相關實務主題。 週次 9 檢索增強生成 (RAG) 的原理及實作 RAG 的概念、資料檢索與生成的結合方法，實作基於 LangChain 的 RAG 系統 週次 10 Agentic AI 與 AI Agents 什麼是 AI Agents? 學習不同的 AI Agent 設計模式，並且運用 AISuite 實作 週次 11 變分自編碼器 (VAE) 開始的冒險旅程 解釋 VAE 的原理，及為什麼這相對簡單的模型，會成為圖像生成 AI 的重要想法，發展出目前重要圖像生成的 diffusion models 週次 12 文字生圖 AI 的原理及實作 Diffusion Models 的進階主題，包括 CLIP、排程器、LoRA 等概念。並且用 Hugging Face 的 diffusers 套件打造自己的圖像生成 AI Web APP。 週次 13 用 Fooocus 實現 Diffusion Models 的進階技術 介紹「理解」使用者輸入文字的 CLIP 模型，著名的圖像生成 AI 模型及運用方式 週次 14 生成式 AI 流行工具及應用範例 介紹主流生成式 AI 工具，及應用範例。 週次 15 生成式 AI 應用與發展趨勢 介紹生成式 AI 新近發展。例如我們介紹文字生成預測 token 的模型，還有圖像生成 diffusion models, 有「互相攻佔」對方地盤的現象。探討其中的原理和可能走向這個方向的原因。 週次 16 在 Gather.town 線上研討會型式的期末專題成果分享

357697.objective: 本課程旨在培養學生掌握人工智慧技術在通訊網路中的應用，特別是在衛星通訊系統和無線網路中的實踐。學生將學習通訊網路的基礎概念、衛星次系統、軌道力學與資料解析，並瞭解無線網路架構、資源分配及網路切片技術。此外，學生將掌握如何利用人工智慧和深度強化學習技術進行資源優化、訊號處理與異常檢測，並應用實驗平台進行模擬和實驗，最終具備設計、實施並優化通訊網路的能力。 This course aims to equip students with the skills to apply artificial intelligence techniques in communication networks, particularly in satellite communication systems and wireless networks. Students will learn the fundamental concepts of communication networks, satellite subsystems, orbital mechanics, and data analysis, as well as the architecture of wireless networks, resource allocation, and network slicing technologies. Additionally, students will master how to use artificial intelligence and deep reinforcement learning techniques for resource optimization, signal processing, and anomaly detection. They will also apply experimental platforms for simulations and experiments, ultimately gaining the ability to design, implement, and optimize communication networks.

357698.objective: 本課程主要目的在於使用各種深度學習的方法，應用在微波遙測資料上面。主要以案例的方式介紹各種應用，因此除了會說明核心的演算法之外，也會介紹使用的訓練資料集的格式、前處理等內容。課程前段會先回顧基本的遙測影像特性以及深度學習技術，包含 CNNs, RNNs, GANs 和 YOLOs 等，常見於遙測資料應用的方法。課程中段會已實際的範例說明上述幾種方法的使用情境與成效。課程最後會要求學生以文獻研讀的方式說明不同深度學習方法在微波遙測上的實例。 The primary objective of this course is to apply various deep learning methods to microwave remote sensing data. It introduces diverse applications primarily through case studies, covering not only core algorithms but also the format of training datasets and preprocessing techniques. The initial part reviews fundamental remote sensing image characteristics and deep learning techniques, including CNNs, RNNs, GANs, and YOLOs—methods commonly applied to remote sensing data. The middle part demonstrates the practical scenarios and effectiveness of these approaches through real-world examples. The final part requires students to conduct literature reviews, presenting case studies of different deep learning methods applied to microwave remote sensing.

357699.objective: 本課程讓學生深入瞭解射頻模組的基本架構及其在無線通訊技術中的應用，並且掌握人工智慧與深度強化學習的基本概念，學習如何利用人工智慧技術優化射頻模組性能，如增強信號強度和降低干擾。此外，課程將涵蓋電磁模擬軟體及其在射頻模組中的應用，並指導學生設置環境，編寫人工智慧演算法，實現自動化模擬與優化，最終培養獨立解決問題的能力。 This course enables students to gain an in-depth understanding of the basic structure of RF modules and their applications in wireless communication technology. It also covers the fundamental concepts of artificial intelligence and deep reinforcement learning, teaching students how to use AI techniques to optimize RF module performance, such as enhancing signal strength and reducing interference. Additionally, the course will introduce electromagnetic simulation software and its applications in RF module simulation, guiding students to set up the environment, write AI algorithms, and achieve automated simulation and optimization, ultimately cultivating the ability to solve problems independently.

357725.objective: This course is designed to provide students with both the theoretical foundations and practical insights of digital transformation. It explores how emerging technologies reshape business models through innovative forms such as the sharing economy, FinTech, and user-generated content. By combining literature reviews, case studies, group discussions, and presentations, students will develop the ability to critically analyze digital transformation strategies and propose innovative business models. The course assessment includes a midterm team report and a final individual project, ensuring both collaborative and independent learning outcomes.

357729.objective: This course covers the electronic properties, circuit analyses, design methods and chip layout of the CMOS VLSI. The contents of this course include: Introduction to VLSI, CMOS manufacturing process, digital circuit design, MOS Transistor Theory, Circuit characterization, performance estimation, chip layout, Hspice simulation and Verilog HDL simulation.
357729.schedule: Week 1-2 VLSI Introduction. Week 3-4 Manufacturing Process. Week 5-6 Digital Circuit Introduction. Week 7 CMOS Transistor Theory. Week 8 Nonideal Transistor Theory. Week 9 Midterm Exam. Week 10-11 Wires. Week 12 Chip Layout. Week 13-14 SPICE simulation. Week 15 ModelSim simulation. Week 16 Quartus II simulation. Week 17 Case study. Week 18 Final Exam.

357732.objective: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文 ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐 / 應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。 Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice /application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

357737.objective: 本課程透過系列主題講座，帶領學員從多元視角理解當代國際局勢、外交發展與跨文化溝通策略。課程邀請外交官、國際事務專家、駐外代表及具實務經驗的講者分享全球趨勢、國際關係熱點議題與外交談判技巧，幫助同學建立宏觀國際視野與外交思維，強化其在多元文化背景下的溝通與協調能力。課程將以專題講座、互動對談與案例分析等形式進行，並引導同學反思台灣在全球脈絡中的角色與機會，培養具備國際素養與行動力的未來領導者。 This course, delivered through a series of thematic lectures, guides students in understanding contemporary international affairs, diplomatic developments, and cross-cultural communication strategies from diverse perspectives. Diplomats, international affairs experts, overseas representatives, and experienced practitioners will be invited to share insights on global trends, key international issues, and diplomatic negotiation skills. The course aims to help students develop a broad international outlook and diplomatic mindset, enhancing their ability to communicate and collaborate effectively in multicultural contexts. Through lectures, interactive discussions, and case analyses, students will be encouraged to reflect on Taiwan’s role and opportunities in the global landscape, cultivating internationally competent and action-oriented future leaders.

357743.objective: 本課程介紹電腦科學中圖形識別的基本原理與相關技術，使學生了解各種圖形識別的分類方法，經由對分類問題的分析，瞭解如何將輸入樣本依不同特性加以分類，並熟悉圖形識別系統之相關議題如：分割、特徵擷取、分類、後處理、訓練、監督 / 非監督式學習、機器學習，進而了解分類問題，增進其解決實際圖形識別分類問題的能力。課程內容包括下列課題：圖形識別概論，Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood, 非參數法學習，K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Positive Boolean Function 多分類器，Linear Discriminant Functions，高維資料分類，分類正確率評估 (Accuracy Assessments) 及其他重要的應用，例如：文件分析、生物辨識、影像監控、遙測影像分類、醫療診斷、資料探勘等概念，最後並透過相關論文的研讀及討論，了解近代圖形識別的最新發展趨勢。 The course includes: Introduction to Pattern Recognition, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood & Bayesian Parameter Estimation, Non-Parametric Classification - Density Estimation, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Multi-Classifier - Positive Boolean Function, Linear Discriminant Functions, Pattern Recognition of High Dimensional Data Sets, Pattern Recognition for Remote Sensing Images, Biometric Certification, Video Surveillance, Accuracy Assessments and Other Related Topics.

357744.objective: Course Description: This course offers an in-depth exploration into patent analytics. Participants will traverse topics such as research methodologies specific to patents, foundational aspects of patent law, the pivotal role of semiconductors in patenting, keyword-centric patent searches complemented by pertinent case studies, the integration of linguistics and logic in understanding patents, the practical applications of ChatGPT, and the utility of Natural Language Processing in patent data analysis. Course Topics: 1. Research Methodology in Patent Analytics: • Overview of innovation trends • Analyzing McKinsey and Gartner reports for patent insights 2. Basics of Patent Law: • Intellectual Property: Understanding the Basics • What makes an invention patentable? • Constructing and analyzing a patent claim • Understanding patent structures • The thin line between innovation and non-obviousness • Crafting an effective patent strategy 3. Semiconductors and Their Importance in Patenting: • Introduction to semiconductor processes, manufacturing, and devices • Deep dive into VLSI design, IP, MCU, CPU, GPU, firmware, OS, and software • A look at solid-state devices • Advanced Process Technologies (Refer to Advanced-Process-Technologies.pdf for detailed insights) 4. Keyword-driven Patent Search & Case Studies: • Patent cases on advanced devices: Planar FET, FinFET, GAA • Patent cases involving AI methodologies 5. Language, Logic, and Meaning in Patent Analysis: • Introduction to linguistics in patent analysis (Reference: https://chowkafat.net/Lingtopic.html) • Basics of semantics and its importance in patent comprehension • Deep dive into formal semantics and generalized quantifier theory • Deciphering the logical form and structure in patents • Introduction to propositional logic and its application in patent analysis • Unraveling predicate logic in patent contexts 6. Practical Applications using ChatGPT: • Using ChatGPT for instructional language and problem-solving in patent analytics • Case study: Constructing a GAA using ChatGPT • ChatGPT in research methodologies and patent search 7. Natural Language Processing (NLP) in Patent Analysis: • Understanding word embedding and word vectors • Techniques for determining similarity in patent documents using NLP
357744.schedule: W1 Research Methodology in Patent Analytics W2,3 Basics of Patent Law W4 Semiconductors and Their Importance in Patenting W5 Keyword-driven Patent Search & Case Studies W6 Language, Logic, and Meaning in Patent Analysis W7 Practical Applications using ChatGPT W8,9 Natural Language Processing (NLP) in Patent Analysis

357751.objective: 資料科學為最熱門的職業之一，各行各業對於數據分析的人才需求正在蓬勃發展，本課程在於培育從事資料科學或機器學習的人員來發展相關知識和技能。課程內容以線性代數、機率、統計學等工程數學為理論學習基礎，操作 Python 作為資料科學的實作工具，包括其相關 Python 基礎語法、各種資料型態、數據 可視化、開源工具等。接著學習利用 Python 取得數據資料，進而操作各種迴歸 分析來手動分析數據資料，並實作梯度遞減，決策樹等最佳化演算方法。最後則是介紹機器學習、深度學習等最新的 AI 演算方法來分析大數據並輔助決策。 Data Science has been ranked as one of the hottest professions and the demand for data practitioners is booming. This course is designed to develop people engaged in data science or machine learning to develop relevant knowledge and skills. You will understand how data science works based on mathematics, such as linear algebra, probability and statistics. Python is the best tool to learn how to conduct data science analyze data. Learn the basic language skills, common data types, visualization tools and extended modules for data grabbing and regression analysis. Gradient decent and decision tree for optimization will be covered. Finally, AI algorithm, machine learning, and deep learning, are introduced how data help in decision making.

357752.objective: This course introduces the concepts, techniques, and applications of machine learning. Topics mainly include Symbolists (e.g., Decision Tree), Connectionists (e.g., Artificial Neural Networks), Bayesians (e.g., Hidden Markov Model), Analogizers (e.g., kNN), and Evolutionaries (e.g., GA), Natural Language Processing and Speech Recognition. The lecture format will be a combination of slide presentation, chalk talk and computer demonstration. In addition to the theoretical study, students are guided to survey the related references, discuss and brainstorm by group, and conduct the practice projects, so that the capability of creativity and innovation can be developed during the course.

357771.objective: 隨著雲端運算服務的廣為使用及網際網路服務的發展，如何處理與儲存大數據，並探勘有用的知識是企業成功關鍵。本課程內容包括決策理論之基本觀念、如何處理與分析大數據、以及如何更進一步從大數據分析連接在真實世界裡相關決策問題應用。 With the development of cloud computing services and internet services, the ability to store big data and transform into applicable knowledge is critical. This course includes an overview of the basic concepts of decision theory, and how to handle and process big data with applications on the real-world decision problems.

357779.objective: 本課程主要在培養各類型段落、短文的撰寫能力，包括描寫、敘述、說明及議論性質文章。 This course is intended for university-level EFL writing students with the aim of increasing their fluency in English writing. To achieve this goal, students in this course will have ample opportunities to write varying types of English paragraphs, for instance, paragraphs of definition and paragraphs focusing on cause and effect relationships. In addition, they will have plenty of opportunities to write various kinds of short English essays, including descriptions, narratives, and argumentative writings.

Week 10: Refining research questions and thesis statements; creating an outline. Week 11: Drafting body paragraphs; integrating primary/secondary sources; citation styles (MLA/APA). Week 12: Peer review of drafts; revision strategies for clarity, style, and argumentation Week 13: Introduction to narrative writing Week 14: Narration planning: characters, setting, and conflict in narratives Week 15: Group project discussion Week 16: Group project discussion Week 17: Project development: peer feedback sessions Week 18: Final showcase of group digital narratives; course wrap-up and reflection

357784.objective: This course aims to explore how media influence our lives, culture, and social structures, while guiding students to reflect on their own roles within the media environment. The course is divided into four major sections, moving from the external to the internal dimensions of media—beginning with media consumption, then moving through media texts, and finally media production—to gradually build an understanding of how media operate. We will start by examining the role of the audience: how individuals consume, engage with, or even resist media. Next, we will analyze media texts—including, but not limited to, television, film, advertising, and magazines—to investigate how they “represent” (or distort) different aspects of our lives. We will then turn to the operations of media industries, considering how underlying economic and political structures shape media content. Finally, the course will extend to today’s new media landscape, focusing on the transformations and challenges brought about in the digital age. By integrating theory with case studies, this course encourages students to critically view, analyze, and engage with contemporary media culture, cultivating both media sensitivity and media literacy.
357784.schedule: - **Week 1. Course Introduction:** Media and Everyday Life; Media Production, Products, and Consumption. **Part I. Media Consumption: Audience or Agent** - Week 2. The Audience: Couch Potatoes or Active Viewers - Week 3. Participatory Culture in the Internet Age: Comments, Bullet Screens, Donations, Fandom - Week 4. Cancel Culture: Who Gets Canceled? How Does It Happen? **Part II. Media Products: Texts and Culture** - Week 5. Representation: Objective Reality vs. Media Reality - Week 6. Film and Television: Gender, Ethnicity, and Class - Week 7. Introduction to Semiotics and Narratology - Week 8. Advertising and Consumption: To be a better man? - Week 9. News and the Fourth Estate: Gatekeeping and Fake News **Part III. Media Production: Media Industries and Economic Structures** - Week 10. The Economic Features of Television: The Dual Product Market - Week 11. Film Production and Product Placement - Week 12. The Political Economy of Communication: Who Owns the Media? - Week 13. Alternative of Production: Public Media **Part IV. New Media and Media Convergence** - Week 14. How Do YouTube and Netflix Reshape the Traditional Media Ecology? - Week 15. Media Convergence: Digital Empire - Week 16. Returning to Consumption: From Audience to Agents - Week 17. Final Presentations - Week 18. Final Presentations

357788.objective: 面對科技發展日新月異，社會急驟變遷的新世紀，只習得專業上的一技之長，已不足以和協圓滿地實踐有意義的人生。有鑑於此，乃以生涯發展與生涯諮商的理論與研究為基礎，配合學生的發展，希翼能透過教育的歷程，使學生的專業知識能和未來的工作與生活規劃，產生有意義的聯結，進而為學生提供一個短程與長程的生涯發展與選擇的準備與指引。 授課內容包括生涯理念介紹、興趣、性格、價值觀探索，生 涯決定因素，生涯技巧，生涯角色調適，生涯選擇與規劃技 巧，生涯訪談，生涯高原調適，轉型期調適，性別、職業歧 視，雙生涯家庭，就業準備等主要生涯課題的研討與習作。 In face of a new century with continuous scientific development and rapid social changes, to learn one single professional skill is not enough to fulfill a meaningful life in a harmonic and satisfactory manner. In view of this, based on the theory and research of career development and consultation in association with the development of students, it is hoped to produce a meaningful linking between their professional knowledge and job and life planning through the course of eucation, and further to provide them a preparation and guide for short and long-range career development and choice. The contents of the course include the discussion and exercise related to major career topics such as introduction to the concept of career, the discussion of interest, character and value, decisive factors of career, skills of career, role adjustment in career, career choice and planning skill, career interview, uphill adjustment in career, adjustment in transit period, sex and occupation.

358129.schedule: 自主學習引導流程 一、目標定義階段–引導學生定義學習目標，發現自我學習問題和機會。 二、資料釐清階段–引導學生收集資料理解與分析學習問題，明確地回應自我學習的路徑。 三、解法發展階段–引導學生設計情境，創造、發明多種解決學習問題的解決方案。 四、實驗測試階段–引導學生經由所發展的解法 (解決學習問題)，以實驗測試，逐漸生成目標結果。 五、展示與回饋階段–引導學生完成成果並且公開，獲得使用者 / 社會的回饋。

358131.objective: 本課程是為了培養學生自主學習的能力，由學生主動提出自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題中，學習到思考與問題解決的能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習。學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定學習計畫，於開學前向辦公室提出申請。由專任老師擔任指導教師，審查及評核學期成績。 This course is to cultivate students' self-learning ability, and students take the initiative to put forward topics they are interested in. Students learn the ability to think and solve problems in specific topics. Teachers play the role of auxiliary guidance to guide students to learn from practice. Students formulate learning plans based on their interests and abilities, and apply to the office before the start of the semester. The full-time teacher acts as the instructor to review and evaluate the semester results.

358132.objective: 為培養學生自主學習能力，透過學生自發性蒐集資料擬定研究主題，由學生自行建構課程內容，從中學習規劃與執行專案實務，培育學生在特定主題研究中，學習到團隊合作、溝通表達、思考批判與問題解決等能力，由教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。本課程的評量以書面報告或口頭報告進行。 To help students cultivate the ability of self-learning, this course allows students to engage themselves in developing course content, to plan and to execute a real-world project. "Active learning" encourages students to learn by interaction, communication, collaboration, critically analyzing arguments, and problem-solving. Instructors will assist to guide and to support in the process of learning. Students are expected to develop a process to solve real-life problems collaboratively. Written reports and oral presentations are required for course evaluation.

358134.objective: (1) 藉由學生主動實現自己有興趣之主題，培養自我學習能力。 (2) 於特定的主題當中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。 (3) 教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習與成長。 (4) 學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定學習計畫，並於開學前提出申請，由專任教師指導，審查及評核學期成績。 (1) Develop self-learning skills by actively implementing topics of interest to students (2) Among the specific topics, the ability to think critically and solve problems is learned. (3) Teachers act as mentors and guide students to learn and grow from practice (4) Students set up learning plans according to their own interests and abilities, and apply before the school starts. They are supervised by full-time teachers to review and evaluate semester performance.

358137.objective: 為培養大學部學生自主學習能力，由學生主動積極創造並實現自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題之創造與實現中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。 學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定自主學習計畫，並於開學前向各系提出申請，由本系專任老師擔任指導教師，審查計畫及評核學期成績。 This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it. In this course, students are required to draw up self-learning plans based on their own interests and capabilities and then submit their plans to the departmental office for approval by the beginning of the semester.
